Technical Assistance Services (TAS)

Position Title: Head of Digital & Data

 Location: Kampala

Position Gap: One Vacancy

Activities

At all times the job holder will:

•\tDeliver the TEPU Digital Analytics services- act as mentor and support the digital, analytics & visualization

•\tEnsure that the tools are developed as TotalEnergies compliance framework.

•\tEnsure active participation in Citizen data sciences and other local initiatives to promote digital across the Affiliate.

•\tSpot opportunities across the business to implement the analytics & visualization to support the business workflows

•\tDevelop external capabilities in Digital working with the C&P and national content teams.

•\tWork with the HQ digital teams for the implementation

•\tConnect with external and within the company to understand the latest trends and how it can be applied across the business.

•\tAble to work with the business stakeholders for digital opportunity identification & delivery. 

•\tInterface with local & global IT for the delivery of the IT services required.

•\tDeliver & maintain the DMP for TEPU.

•\tRepresent TEPU in Data governance councils and put forward the TEPU needs.

•\tDefine and implement data KPIs ensuring quality, availability and governance.

•\tOperationalise & run the data governance councils in TEPU.

•\tMentor and support the data representatives across the various domains.

•\tRoll out of data management training programs for DMforT and DMforM.

Qualifications/Experience required

•\tA minimum BSc Hons Degree in data/technology disciplines in the industrial context.

•\tAt least 5years of experience in the oil & gas industry.

•\tA significant Data & Digital experience in the areas of Engineering & Operations data (minimum 10 years)

•\tProven experience in managing digital delivery and foundational data. 

•\tStrong experience in working in a fast pace evolving.

•\tA strong ability to work in a cross functional environment

•\tExcellent communication skills.

Aldelia is a global leading human resources company founded in 2005 and specialized in recruitment, outsourcing and payroll management services to blue-chip multinationals and fast-growing SMEs. The group operates in more than 30 countries across all industries and disciplines on four continents.

Our mission is to create a better future for people by delivering compliant, world-class and innovative HR solutions to the companies and communities we serve.

Aldelia is committed to promoting equity, diversity and inclusion in employment and service delivery. With over 150 employees and 1,500 contractors worldwide, our unparalleled pan-African footprint and wealth of local expertise give us a unique advantage to respond to clients’ needs proactively, providing tailor-made and successful recruitment solutions.

As a participant in the United Nations Global Compact, Aldelia Group is committed to aligning strategies and operations with universal human rights, labour, environment and anti-corruption principles, and taking actions that advance societal goals.

Aldelia est un leader mondial des ressources humaines fondé en 2005 et spécialisé dans le recrutement, l'externalisation et les services de gestion des salaires pour les multinationales de premier plan et les PME à croissance rapide. Le groupe est présent dans plus de 30 pays sur quatre continents, dans tous les secteurs d'activité et dans toutes les disciplines.

Notre mission est de créer un meilleur avenir pour les personnes en fournissant des solutions RH conformes, de classe mondiale et innovantes aux entreprises et aux communautés que nous servons.

Aldelia s'engage à promouvoir l'équité, la diversité et l'inclusion dans l'emploi et la prestation de services. Avec plus de 150 employés et 1 500 contractants dans le monde, notre empreinte panafricaine inégalée et la richesse de notre expertise locale nous donnent un avantage unique pour répondre aux besoins des clients de manière proactive, en fournissant des solutions de recrutement sur mesure et réussies.

En tant que participant au Pacte mondial des Nations unies, le groupe Aldelia s'engage à aligner ses stratégies et ses opérations sur les principes universels des droits de l'homme, du travail, de l'environnement et de la lutte contre la corruption, et à prendre des mesures qui favorisent la réalisation des objectifs sociétaux.

Role Overview

The FPSO QA/QC Lead is responsible for managing all Quality Assurance and Quality Control activities associated with the engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, testing and commissioning of the FPSO.

The role ensures full compliance with project specifications, international codes, quality requirements and inspection standards.

﻿

Key Responsibilities


Quality Management:

· Develop and implement the Project Quality Management Plan.

· Monitor contractor QA/QC performance.

· Review Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs).

· Coordinate audits and surveillance activities.

· Ensure proper management of NCRs, concessions and corrective actions.

· Supervise inspectors and quality coordinators.

· Monitor welding, coating, piping, structural and mechanical quality activities.

· Participate in FAT, SAT and commissioning inspections.


Reporting:

· Prepare quality dashboards.

· Monitor KPIs.

· Report quality performance to Project Management.

Qualifications

· Engineering Degree.

· Minimum 15 years QA/QC experience.

· Extensive FPSO construction experience.

· Certified Lead Auditor (ISO 9001 preferred).

Languages

· Fluent English.

Role Overview

TheFPSO Lead HVAC Engineeris responsible for the engineering, design review, procurement follow-up, construction support, testing, and commissioning of all Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems for a major FPSO development.


The role ensures HVAC systems comply with project specifications, international standards, HSE requirements, and operational performance objectives throughout all project phases.

Key Responsibilities


HVAC Engineering

· Lead all HVAC engineering activities for the FPSO package.

· Review HVAC philosophies, calculations, layouts and technical documentation.

· Validate contractor engineering deliverables.

· Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards and Company specifications.

· Support technical reviews and design optimization.


Construction & Commissioning

· Monitor fabrication and installation activities.

· Support FAT, SAT and commissioning activities.

· Coordinate resolution of technical issues during construction.

· Ensure mechanical completion and handover readiness.


Interface Management

· Coordinate with:

o  Process Engineering

o  Mechanical Engineering

o  Electrical Engineering

o  Instrumentation & Control

o  Marine Systems

o  Safety Engineering


HSE

· Promote HSE excellence throughout engineering and construction activities.

· Ensure HVAC systems comply with hazardous area requirements and fire & gas philosophies.

Qualifications

· Engineering Degree (Mechanical or HVAC Engineering)

· Minimum 15 years' experience in HVAC engineering.

· Minimum 10 years on FPSO or offshore production facilities.

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Instrumentation Commissioning Specialist to support and lead instrumentation and E&I activities during the pre-commissioning and commissioning phases of a large-scale industrial project in the Netherlands.

The role is highly field-oriented and requires a minimum of 10 years of on-site instrumentation experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for instrumentation calibration, loop checks, actuator commissioning, and related E&I pre-commissioning activities.

Short business trips to France, Germany, and Poland may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and perform instrumentation and E&I commissioning activities on site.
  • Perform calibration of pressure, temperature, flow, level, and other instrumentation.
  • Carry out actuator initialization, configuration, calibration, and functional testing.
  • Execute instrument and E&I loop checks and troubleshoot issues.
  • Support pre-commissioning and commissioning of rotating equipment.
  • Perform P&ID checks, flushing, blowing, inerting, and other pre-commissioning activities.
  • Read and interpret E&I documentation, including logic diagrams, wiring diagrams, loop diagrams, and instrumentation hook-ups.
  • Read and interpret P&IDs, piping isometrics, and related piping documentation.
  • Support DCS commissioning and I/O verification, with Yokogawa experience being particularly relevant.
  • Support commissioning of electrical shelters and electrical equipment.
  • Complete commissioning, quality, and inspection documentation.
  • Provide technical leadership and report progress, issues, and commissioning status to the project team.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 10+ years of hands-on, on-site instrumentation experience.
  • Strong experience in E&I commissioning and pre-commissioning.
  • Proven experience with instrumentation calibration, loop checking, and actuator commissioning.
  • Experience with DCS systems, preferably Yokogawa.
  • Experience with rotating equipment commissioning.
  • Experience reading E&I and piping documentation.
  • Experience with industrial pre-commissioning activities.
  • Ability to lead field activities and work independently.
  • Good knowledge of Google Workspace / Google Suite.
  • Strong communication and reporting skills.

Skills & Competencies

  • Instrumentation & E&I Commissioning: Strong hands-on field commissioning experience.
  • DCS & Yokogawa: Practical experience with DCS commissioning, I/O checks, and troubleshooting.
  • Pre-Commissioning: Good knowledge of P&ID checks, flushing, blowing, inerting, and equipment checks.
  • Documentation: Ability to read and interpret E&I and piping engineering documents.
  • Leadership: Able to coordinate and lead commissioning activities on site.
  • Teamwork: Comfortable working with multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Autonomy: Able to manage assigned activities independently and solve field issues.
  • Reporting: Accurate completion of commissioning records, quality documents, and progress reports.

Language

English: Fluent / Bilingual — mandatory.

The candidate must be able to communicate effectively in English with site teams, contractors, engineers, and project management.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for a hands-on and experienced commissioning professional with strong field expertise in instrumentation and E&I. The ideal candidate is autonomous, technically strong, safety- and quality-conscious, and comfortable taking a leadership role during commissioning activities.

Summary:

The Document Controller is responsible for the management and control of all documents within an organisation. This includes the registration, classification, storage, retrieval and distribution of important documents, such as contracts, reports, training manuals and other relevant materials. The Document Controller is also responsible for ensuring that all relevant information is up to date and accessible to those who need it. It is a key role in keeping the organisation running efficiently and ensuring compliance with regulatory and legal standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and organise all company documents.
  • Ensure that documents are up to date and correctly filed.
  • Collaborate with different teams to meet documentation needs.
  • Develop and implement document control processes.
  • Ensure compliance with documentation standards and regulations.
  • Provide support and training on document control practices.
  • Carry out regular document audits.
  • Maintain the confidentiality and security of documents.
  • Ensure documents are properly organised and secure
  • Check and edit documents and prepare them for distribution
  • Create effective and efficient document filing and organisation systems
  • Record document requests and retrieve documents as required
  • Distribute documents to the relevant recipients
  • Confirm delivery of documents to the appropriate staff
  • Carry out other tasks within the scope of the role.

Qualifications:

  • A pre-university or higher qualification in business administration, management or a related field
  • 2 years’ experience in document control or a similar role
  • Must have knowledge of document management software
  • Must have experience working with a wide range of file types
  • Must be able to locate and preserve paper documents
  • Proven ability to create and implement controlled document processes
  • Extremely organised and efficient
  • Able to work well under pressure and demonstrate excellent stress management
  • Must have a basic understanding of construction documents
  • Must have exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Must have a good command of the English language

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Subsea & Completions Supervisor to oversee and supervise complex subsea completion, well intervention, and associated offshore operations from a semi-submersible drilling rig.

The role is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective execution of subsea and completion activities while maintaining high HSE standards, operational integrity, and compliance with company procedures and industry requirements.

Key Responsibilities

HSE Leadership

  • Ensure all subsea and completion operations are conducted safely and in compliance with company HSE policies, procedures, and applicable regulations.
  • Demonstrate strong HSE leadership and promote a positive safety culture offshore.
  • Participate in HSE meetings, risk assessments, toolbox talks, and incident investigations.
  • Identify and report unsafe conditions and intervene when required.
  • Promote continuous improvement in HSE performance.
  • Ensure compliance with company Code of Conduct, Golden Rules, and operational standards.

Subsea & Completions Operations

  • Act as the senior supervisor responsible for subsea and completion operations offshore.
  • Supervise and coordinate daily activities with the Company Man, Drilling & Completion Superintendent, Subsea Superintendent, contractors, service companies, and logistics teams.
  • Provide operational support during technical or operational challenges.
  • Supervise subsea completion crews and third-party service personnel.
  • Ensure operations are executed according to approved programs, procedures, risk assessments, and Company requirements.
  • Monitor operational performance and proactively minimize Non-Productive Time (NPT).
  • Maintain effective communication with all relevant stakeholders and immediately escalate operational or HSE issues.

Technical Scope

The successful candidate should be experienced and autonomous in supervising:

  • Well Barrier and Well Control Operations (WBCO)
  • Subsea Landing String operations
  • Coiled Tubing operations
  • Slickline operations
  • Well Testing
  • ROV operations
  • Tubing Hanger installation
  • Subsea Xmas Tree installation
  • Open-water interventions, including EDP/LRP
  • Subsea completion and well intervention activities

Planning & Preparation

  • Participate in DWIP, REX, pre-operation meetings, toolbox talks, and risk assessments.
  • Review equipment and personnel requirements for upcoming operations.
  • Coordinate with offshore logistics teams to ensure timely availability of equipment and personnel.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational sequences, safety, and efficiency.
  • Anticipate operational risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures.
  • Perform QA/QC checks on company equipment delivered by service providers.
  • Ensure operational readiness before critical subsea and completion activities commence.

Contractor & Cost Management

  • Monitor the performance of third-party contractors, service companies, equipment, and personnel.
  • Provide performance feedback to the relevant Superintendents.
  • Follow up rental equipment and third-party personnel onboard the rig.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce operational costs while maintaining HSE and quality standards.
  • Maintain effective relationships with contractors and service providers.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Provide accurate operational data for End of Well and Well Handover Reports.
  • Maintain regular and reliable communication with the operational hierarchy.
  • Participate in post-operation debriefings and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain records of lessons learned and improvement opportunities.
  • Contribute to investigations and corrective actions following incidents or operational events.
  • Ensure lessons learned are implemented on subsequent operations.
  • Support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement across the organization.

Key Accountabilities

  • Maintain high standards of HSE and operational integrity.
  • Ensure safe and efficient execution of subsea and completion operations.
  • Meet drilling and completion performance objectives.
  • Minimize NPT and operational delays.
  • Optimize contractor, equipment, and personnel performance.
  • Ensure compliance with company procedures, specifications, guidelines, and manuals.
  • Support delivery of operational objectives within schedule and budget.
  • Capture and share subsea and completion know-how and lessons learned.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Engineering degree, Higher Technical Diploma, or equivalent qualification in drilling, completion, petroleum, mechanical, offshore, or related discipline.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in the oil & gas industry.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in a similar senior offshore supervisory position.
  • Strong experience in subsea completions and well intervention.
  • Experience working on offshore drilling rigs, preferably semi-submersible rigs.
  • Proven experience supervising multidisciplinary teams and third-party service companies.
  • Experience with complex/high-pressure wells and technically challenging subsea operations is highly desirable.

Certifications

  • Valid IWCF Well Control Certificate – Drilling.
  • Valid BOSIET / HUET.
  • Valid offshore safety and company-required certifications.
  • Familiarity with applicable offshore operational standards and Golden Rules.

Core Competencies

  • HSE Leadership
  • Subsea & Completions Operations
  • Well Intervention
  • Operational Risk Management
  • Problem Analysis & Decision Making
  • Contractor Management
  • Team Leadership
  • Planning & Organization
  • Communication & Reporting
  • Cost & Performance Management
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Teamwork & Collaboration
  • Ability to work autonomously under pressure

Language Requirements

  • Fluent English is mandatory.

Work Environment

  • Offshore semi-submersible drilling rig
  • Extended offshore rotations
  • Challenging and technically complex offshore operating environment
  • Multinational workforce and contractor environment

  • Monitor discipline progress closely, define corrective actions, and manage them to ensure timely completion of the design.
  • Work closely with Discipline Lead to coordinate and manage Process engineering interfaces with other disciplines and stakeholders.
  • Define, detail, and monitor Process interface parameters with other project disciplines.
  • Perform thorough, efficient, and timely review of Process discipline documents, identifying potential derogations from standards and challenging the design to achieve optimized and fit-for-purpose solutions.

  • Follow the maintenance program

Responsibilities:

  • To ensure the control, monitoring and analysis of the project’s costs and financial performance, guaranteeing the reliability of financial information, budget monitoring, the analysis of variances and support for decision-making by the Project Management and Finance Management teams.
  • To draw up and monitor the project’s activity plans, budget and forecasts.
  • Implement and ensure compliance with the management procedures defined by the Company and the Group.
  • Monitor the project’s actual costs, revenue, margins, productivity and cash flow.
  • Analyse the project’s financial and operational performance and report to management bodies.
  • Define, develop and monitor management indicators, dashboards and financial reports.
  • Propose corrective actions following analysis of variances between the budget, forecast and actual figures.
  • Provide technical support to project management in relation to cost control, economic analysis and forward-looking studies.
  • Analyse financial risks and alert senior management to potential impacts on the project’s results.
  • Contribute to improving the project’s financial performance and ensuring sound financial management.

Qualifications:

  • A degree or higher education qualification in Accounting, Finance, Management, Economics, Engineering, Management Accounting or a related field. Higher education qualifications equivalent to Bac +3 / Bac +5 will be an advantage.
  • A minimum of 3 to 4 years’ experience in management control, cost control, financial project control, financial management or similar roles. Experience in industrial projects, construction, Oil & Gas or EPC will be considered an advantage.
  • Knowledge of cost control.
  • Knowledge of general and cost accounting.
  • Proficiency in budgeting, forecasting, reporting and results analysis.
  • Ability to develop management indicators, dashboards and performance analyses.
  • Experience with SAP.
  • Good command of advanced Excel and reporting tools.
  • Ability to analyse variances, financial risks and corrective actions.
  • Rigour, attention to detail and reliability in producing financial information.
  • Organisational skills, ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.
  • Ability to communicate with operational teams and senior management.
  • Confidentiality, professional ethics, team spirit, proactivity and autonomy.
  • Business-level spoken and written English.

Ensure the Engineering Dossier is delivered with a robust Telecom engineering definition and a fit-for-purpose design that can be procured, fabricated, transported, installed, commissioned, and operated safely, meeting the requirements of project standards and Basis of Design.

Ensure, control, and coordinate the proper realization of the Telecom design in compliance with project specifications, procedures, schedule, quality, and safety requirements.

Plan, prepare, and lead Telecom discipline kick-off meetings with EPSCC Contractor in close coordination with Discipline Lead.

Identify, manage, and track Telecom engineering technical decisions; define clear action plans and secure timely agreement within the Engineering phase schedule.

Monitor discipline progress closely, define corrective actions, and manage them to ensure timely completion of the design.

Work closely with Discipline Lead to coordinate and manage Telecom engineering interfaces with other disciplines and stakeholders.

Define, detail, and monitor Telecom interface parameters with other EPSCC disciplines.

Perform thorough, efficient, and timely review of Telecom discipline documents, identifying potential derogations from standards and challenging the design to achieve optimized and fit-for-purpose solutions.

Ensure all Telecom-related project documents are reviewed and commented on in a timely manner and in accordance with project specifications and contractual requirements.

Identify opportunities for optimization and improvement to be implemented at an early stage of detailed design; promote and encourage value engineering proposals.

Promote fit-for-purpose design solutions to optimize planning, cost, and schedule.

Ensure, as far as possible, standardization of Telecom design solutions, particularly for wellhead platforms.

Ensure timely and clear responses to contractors’ and vendors’ requests for engineering design clarifications and technical queries.

Liaise with discipline engineers to identify and review potential deviations or derogations to project standards, ensuring deviation packages are mature submission and approval.

Consult the Telecom department on Telecom discipline derogation requests and interface with relevant review panels to secure the necessary approvals.

Ensure close coordination with other disciplines on all engineering, constructability, and operational matters.

Ensure that relevant feedback and lessons learned from previous similar projects are considered in design development.

Define, follow up, and evaluate Telecom discipline studies to be carried out by Contractors, ensuring completion in accordance with approved project gates and design maturity.

Assist in the preparation for and participation in project studies and reviews, including model reviews, HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, CHAZOP, constructability reviews, PRs, and other studies as required by Discipline Engineering Coordinators.

Provide technical clarifications and responses during internal project audit sessions and safety studies.

Monitor and report the maturity index of the Telecom discipline ahead of upcoming engineering gate reviews to ensure the Engineering Dossier achieves the required level of maturity.

Participate in weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc engineering meetings with Contractors as required.

Assist in the preparation of engineering progress reports, detailing Telecom discipline status, schedule, risks, and technical issues to ensure timely and accurate reporting to the discipline management team.

Identify potential risks and scope changes related to the Telecom discipline, perform impact assessments, and provide detailed information to Discipline Engineering Coordinators and Leads to support decision-making.

Identify, review, and assess Telecom-related engineering scope changes and ensure alignment with the approved Basis of Design and project standards, managing any changes in accordance with the project change management plan.

Monitor Telecom discipline progress, identify risks to scope or schedule, and define mitigation actions.

Assist Discipline Engineering Coordinators in the assessment of project change orders.


Support Discipline Engineering Coordinators in project risk management activities.

We are looking for an experienced Emerson DCS Expert to support the commissioning and start-up of a new ASU plant in Huelva.

● Optimize HMI graphics and alarm priorities.

● Support loop checks, SAT activities, and punch-list closure.

● Update logic diagrams, P&IDs, HMI screens, and commissioning documentation.

● Support preparation of SOPs and final DCS handover.

● Emerson DCS: Expert

● Reading of E&I Documentation: Confirmed

● Leadership: Advanced

● Autonomy: Advanced

● Teamwork: Advanced

● Google Suite: Advanced

● ASU Start-Up: Basic

● Minimum 3 years of hands-on Emerson DCS experience.

● ASU experience is an advantage.

Work Location: Huelva, Spain Work Mode: On-site

Technical Assistance Services (TAS)

Position Title: Surface Quality Surveillance Leader

Location: Kampala

Position Gap: One Vacancy

Activities

At all times the job holder will:

•\tTo adopt and to demonstrate an exemplary behavior with regard to Company \"Code of Conduct\" and HSE rules and regulations. To implement HSE rules and requirements within his area of responsibility, and to comply with HSE training requirements for the position.

•\tTo coordinate the Package Quality Surveillance activities. To ensure that Contractor Quality activities are planned and performed in accordance with Project requirements and Criticality Assessment/Surveillance Plan.

•\tTo define and develop a Package Surveillance program covering Contractors and Suppliers in coordination with concerned Package Managers, Project Quality Manager, Construction Manager and Engineering Manager.

•\tTo define and develop the Packages Surveillance Plans and the associated organization and means. To assist the Package Manager in anticipating and planning of Surveillance resources and availability of necessary inspection/surveillance tools for performance of Package surveillance activities.

•\tTo populate (with ITP information and updates) the digital tool selected by the project for the follow up and management of the inspection activities.

•\tTo coordinate the activities of Package Quality surveillance and of the Construction QC Leaders. To monitor the performance of QC activities by Contractors, Suppliers and Vendors.

•\tTo prepare the Surveillance services orders (using the digital tool) and to manage the inspection services contract for the package. To valid and sign then the related services time sheets.

•\tTo review Contractor's PO's to verify that QA/QC contractual requirements are satisfactory considered.

•\tTo participate when needed to KOM and PIM with subcontractors and vendors, and to specifically remind the Contractual commitments and Company expectations with regards to Quality.

•\tTo review and approve the Contractor's Quality Control plans and Inspection and Test Plans. To verify that Contractor QC program is in line with the Company expectations and requirements. To ensure that surveillance activities are planned in accordance with said procedures/plans and that Contactor QC surveillance/inspection is planned as agreed. To ensure that 3rd party surveillance activities are satisfactory considered. To Mark up Inspection and Test plans with Company surveillance points, with specific focus on Hold points.

•\tTo review and approve the other Quality related documents issued by the Contractors and Suppliers and to raise the necessary comments.

•\tTo give advice to Contractors', Subcontractors' and Suppliers on QA / QC activities for whole coherence and adequacy (format, document control and enforcement) to Quality Specifications and usual/satisfactory practices.

•\tTo witness the Quality Audits performed by the Contractor on their Suppliers. To participate in Contractor investigations of significant Quality failures or other work deficiencies.

•\tTo review inspection reports and other quality records and deliverables issued by Contractor on completed works and activities. To sign Quality records when needed on behalf of company.

•\tTo ensure that Material traceability requirements are properly implemented.

•\tTo use visits to worksites to liaise with resident project personnel, and to review any QC problems or reported difficulties.

•\tTo analyze and resolve issues and problems highlighted during the quality surveillance/ QC activities. To follow and expedite the remedial actions from Finding and observations during the Quality Audits or other Quality surveillance/QC activities.

•\tTo interface with Third Party Authority for Contractor/Supplier assessment of conformity. To ensure that certification requirements are fully implemented

•\tTo participate to regular Quality reviews and meetings with Contractor. To review quality KPI'S, improvement efforts, quality issues/failures, NCR trends.

•\tTo monitor and review the regular reporting issued by the Construction QC Leaders, to ensure adequate and timely reporting to Package management and Quality Manager.

•\tTo populate the Surveillance reporting system enabling reactivity in the management of Surveillance issues.

•\tTo raise weekly & monthly status reports to Packages Managers and Project Quality Manager on quality activities. To maintain and monitor the Package Quality indicators (KPI's).

•\tTo ensure confidentiality of all the documentation issued under his area of responsibility.

Qualifications/Experience required

Qualification:

•\tEngineer Degree or equivalent 

Experience: 

•\t10 years in the oil and gas industry, at least 5 years post qualification experience in QC/Inspection within Oil & Gas Industry with relevant Project experience.

Job Description : Senior Contracts Advisor

  • Le/la candidat(e) retenu(e) apportera son soutien tout au long du cycle de vie des contrats en :
  • Élaborant des plans visant à respecter la réglementation relative au contenu local.
  • Prospectant le marché et lançant des appels d’offres.
  • Négociant les contrats existants ou potentiels.
  • Préparant les justifications nécessaires à l’obtention des autorisations.
  • Assurant la gestion des contrats après leur attribution

Fonctions et responsabilités

  • Piloter les résultats commerciaux et contractuels au sein du domaine de portefeuille désigné.
  • Veiller à ce que les contrats, les bons de commande et les commandes sur appel soient conformes à la procédure de passation de marchés et d’approvisionnement.
  • Assumer la responsabilité du cycle de vie des contrats, notamment :
  • Stratégies par catégorie
  • Plans de passation de marchés
  • Appels d’offres / Demandes de devis
  • Pouvoir de signature des contrats
  • Plans de négociation
  • Plans d’évaluation des offres
  • Modifications contractuelles
  • Autres documents d’approbation associés
  • Identifier et exploiter en permanence les opportunités commerciales et d’économies au sein du portefeuille.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les principales parties prenantes afin de garantir l’exactitude des critères d’évaluation, des conditions générales et des dérogations.
  • Consulter les parties prenantes internes afin d’assurer une représentation et une visibilité adéquates des questions commerciales.
  • Veiller à ce que les aspects commerciaux et contractuels soient pris en compte suffisamment en amont lors de l’élaboration des stratégies par catégorie, des stratégies contractuelles et des calendriers de projet.
  • Veiller à la satisfaction des besoins de l’entreprise conformément aux exigences en matière de calendrier, de coûts et de qualité.
  • Compiler et suivre les informations sur le marché des fournisseurs.

Compétences et expérience

  • Le candidat retenu devra justifier :
  • D’une maîtrise bilingue du français et de l’anglais.
  • D’un diplôme en gestion, commerce, droit, ingénierie ou dans une discipline similaire.
  • D’au moins 10 ans d’expérience dans un poste de spécialiste de catégorie ou de conseiller en contrats.
  • De plus de 4 ans d’expérience dans l’industrie pétrolière et gazière
  • Expérience couvrant l’ensemble du cycle de vie des appels d’offres, en particulier au niveau des phases de stratégie et de pré-attribution.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite, orale et lors de présentations, à tous les niveaux, tant en interne qu’en externe.
  • Connaissance approfondie de la réglementation sénégalaise en matière de contenu local.
  • Compétences avérées en gestion d’équipe et en capacité d’influence.
  • Capacité à prendre des décisions efficaces dans des situations comportant des incertitudes et des risques, tout en prenant en compte et en conciliant les différents aspects commerciaux tels que les exigences techniques, les coûts et le calendrier.
  • Une approche enthousiaste, résiliente et flexible pour travailler sur des projets exigeants.
  • De solides compétences et une expérience en matière de négociation.

Diplômes et Qualifications

  • Diplôme de niveau BAC+5 minimum en droit des affaires, droit des contrats, droit international des affaires ou domaine juridique connexe
  • Une spécialisation ou formation complémentaire en droit de l'énergie, droit pétrolier et droit OHADA, financement de projets, ou arbitrage international constitue un avantage décisif

& Security Advisor"},"description":{"1":"

Principales missions et responsabilités du poste

Mission principale

La Société recherche un professionnel de la sécurité et de la gestion des urgences (SEM) basé au Sénégal, capable de jouer un rôle de premier plan tant dans la gestion des crises et des urgences (CEM) que dans les activités de sécurité.

Le candidat devra être capable de :

  • Diriger avec crédibilité les activités de gestion des crises et des urgences de sécurité.

1.     Développer et renforcer les capacités locales.

  • Jouer le rôle de conseiller de confiance auprès de l’entreprise tout au long du cycle complet de gestion des risques : Prévention, Préparation, Réponse et Reprise.
  • Apporter une solide expertise technique, en particulier dans le domaine de la gestion des crises et des urgences .
  • Travailler efficacement avec l’équipe de direction locale et au sein de l’environnement plus large du bureau de Dakar.
  • Conseiller les équipes opérationnelles et de direction sur les questions de sécurité, de gestion des crises et des urgences.

2.     Objectif du poste

  • Le titulaire du poste sera chargé de renforcer la résilience de l’organisation face aux incidents de sécurité et aux situations d’urgence.
  • Ses principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :
  • Fournir des conseils et un soutien spécialisé en matière de sécurité et de gestion des urgences (S&EM).
  • Développer les capacités de gestion de la sécurité, des crises et des urgences.
  • Veiller à la mise en œuvre de plans locaux adaptés.

3.     Principales responsabilités

  • Sécurité, risques et résilience
  • Développer les capacités de l’entreprise en matière de sécurité, de gestion des crises et des situations d’urgence au Sénégal.
  • Se tenir informé en permanence des menaces de sécurité et des risques d’urgence.
  • Mettre en œuvre des activités de prévention, de préparation, d’intervention et de rétablissement.
  • Fournir des conseils spécialisés aux sites, projets, employés, visiteurs et autres parties prenantes au Sénégal.
  • Organiser des séances d’information sur la sécurité à l’intention des visiteurs.

4.     Évaluation et planification

  • Élaborer et tenir à jour des évaluations des risques de sécurité.
  • Élaborer et fournir des conseils sur: les plans de gestion de la sécurité, les plans d’intervention d’urgence, le plan de l’équipe de gestion des incidents
  • Veiller à la mise en œuvre des plans et dispositifs de sécurité et de gestion des urgences.
  • Mener des activités de vérification des dispositifs de sécurité et de gestion des urgences.

5.     Gestion des urgences et des crises

  • Soutenir la réponse locale aux situations d’urgence et aux crises.
  • Veiller au développement et à la disponibilité des capacités de l’équipe de gestion des incidents.
  • Veiller à ce que les incidents et les menaces émergentes au Sénégal et dans l’ensemble de la région de l’Afrique de l’Ouest soient rapidement signalés et transmis aux instances supérieures.
  • Coordonner les bilans post-opérationnels à la suite d’incidents.
  • Soutenir la préparation et la planification des interventions en cas de déversements d’hydrocarbures.

6.     Formation et amélioration continue

Localisation : Antananarivo, Madagascar

Département : Ressources Humaines

Rattachement hiérarchique : Direction Générale

Périmètre : Madagascar

Le/la Responsable des Ressources Humaines (RRH) est chargé(e) de définir, déployer et piloter la politique Ressources Humaines de l’entreprise en cohérence avec sa stratégie et ses objectifs opérationnels.

Véritable partenaire de la Direction Générale et des managers, il/elle accompagne l’organisation sur l’ensemble des enjeux RH : recrutement, développement des talents, gestion des carrières, formation, administration du personnel, paie, relations sociales, performance et conformité réglementaire.

Il/elle veille également au maintien d’un climat social constructif et contribue activement au développement d’une culture d’entreprise favorisant l’engagement, la performance et la fidélisation des collaborateurs.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS

1. Stratégie et politique RH

  • Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique RH en cohérence avec les orientations stratégiques de l’entreprise.
  • Conseiller la Direction Générale sur les enjeux humains, sociaux et organisationnels.
  • Accompagner les managers dans la gestion et le développement de leurs équipes.
  • Participer aux projets de transformation et d’évolution organisationnelle.
  • Assurer une veille juridique, sociale et réglementaire permanente.
  • Identifier les risques RH et proposer les actions préventives ou correctives appropriées.

2. Recrutement et gestion des effectifs

  • Identifier et anticiper les besoins en ressources humaines en collaboration avec les managers.
  • Piloter et superviser les processus de recrutement.
  • Garantir la qualité et l’efficacité des processus de sélection et d’intégration.
  • Superviser l’intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs.
  • Piloter les processus de mobilité interne et de gestion des carrières.
  • Participer à l’élaboration des plans de succession pour les postes clés.
  • Suivre les effectifs et anticiper les besoins futurs de l’organisation.

3. Gestion des talents et performance

  • Piloter le processus d’évaluation de la performance.
  • Accompagner les managers dans la fixation et le suivi des objectifs.
  • Identifier les collaborateurs à fort potentiel et proposer des plans de développement adaptés.
  • Mettre en place des actions favorisant l’engagement et la fidélisation des talents.
  • Développer une culture de performance et de responsabilisation.

4. Formation et développement des compétences

  • Identifier les besoins en formation en collaboration avec les managers.
  • Élaborer et piloter le plan annuel de formation.
  • Superviser la mise en œuvre des actions de formation et en mesurer l’efficacité.
  • Développer des parcours de formation et d’évolution professionnelle.
  • Veiller à l’adéquation entre les compétences disponibles et les besoins actuels et futurs de l’entreprise.

5. Relations sociales et climat social

  • Piloter le dialogue social et maintenir des relations constructives avec les représentants du personnel.
  • Préparer et conduire les réunions et négociations sociales.
  • Prévenir, identifier et gérer les situations sociales sensibles ou conflictuelles.
  • Accompagner les managers dans la gestion des problématiques disciplinaires.
  • Veiller au respect des procédures internes et de la législation du travail.
  • Mettre en place des initiatives favorisant l’engagement des collaborateurs et un climat social positif.

6. Administration du personnel et paie

  • Superviser l’ensemble des processus d’administration du personnel, de l'entrée à la sortie des collaborateurs.
  • Garantir la conformité des contrats de travail, avenants et documents administratifs.
  • Superviser et contrôler le processus de paie réalisé par le prestataire externe.
  • Veiller à la conformité et à la fiabilité des déclarations sociales.
  • Superviser la gestion des congés, absences et autres éléments administratifs.
  • Garantir la tenue, la confidentialité et la mise à jour des dossiers du personnel.

7. Conformité juridique et droit social

  • Garantir l’application de la législation du travail et des procédures RH internes.
  • Assurer une veille régulière sur les évolutions légales et réglementaires.
  • Conseiller la Direction et les managers sur les questions de droit social.
  • Superviser la gestion des procédures disciplinaires et des éventuels contentieux sociaux.
  • Veiller à la conformité des pratiques RH avec les exigences légales et les politiques internes.

8. Reporting RH et indicateurs de performance

  • Développer et suivre les principaux indicateurs RH : effectifs, turnover, absentéisme, recrutement, formation, performance, etc.
  • Garantir la fiabilité et la mise à jour des données dans les outils et systèmes RH.
  • Préparer les reportings RH réguliers à destination de la Direction Générale et des interlocuteurs concernés.
  • Analyser les données RH afin d'identifier les tendances, risques et axes d'amélioration.
  • Formuler des recommandations permettant d'améliorer la performance RH et organisationnelle.

9. Management de l’équipe RH

  • Superviser, accompagner et développer les membres de l’équipe Ressources Humaines.
  • Définir les objectifs et priorités de l’équipe.
  • Organiser et optimiser la répartition des activités RH.
  • Développer les compétences de l’équipe et favoriser son autonomie.
  • Garantir la qualité du service RH apporté aux collaborateurs et aux managers.

PRINCIPAUX INTERLOCUTEURS

Internes :

  • Direction Générale
  • Managers et responsables de départements
  • Ensemble des collaborateurs
  • Fonctions Finance, Juridique et Administration
  • Équipes RH et fonctions support

Externes :

  • Administrations et organismes sociaux
  • Inspection du Travail et autorités compétentes
  • Prestataire de paie
  • Cabinets de recrutement
  • Organismes de formation
  • Conseils juridiques et autres partenaires RH

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Formation

  • Formation supérieure Bac+4/5 en Ressources Humaines, Gestion, Management, Droit Social, Sciences Sociales ou domaine équivalent.
  • Une spécialisation en droit social ou management des ressources humaines constitue un atout.

Expérience

  • Minimum 8 ans d’expérience professionnelle en Ressources Humaines.
  • Expérience significative dans une fonction de Responsable RH, HR Manager ou HR Business Partner Senior.
  • Expérience confirmée dans la gestion généraliste des Ressources Humaines.
  • Une expérience au sein d'un environnement structuré, international ou multisite constitue un avantage.
  • Expérience dans le management d’une équipe RH souhaitée.

Compétences techniques

  • Excellente maîtrise du droit du travail et de la législation sociale malgache.
  • Solide maîtrise de l’administration du personnel et des processus de paie.
  • Maîtrise des processus de recrutement, formation, Talent Management et gestion de la performance.
  • Bonne maîtrise des relations sociales et des procédures disciplinaires.
  • Capacité à construire et analyser des indicateurs et tableaux de bord RH.
  • Bonne maîtrise des outils SIRH, logiciels de paie et outils de reporting.
  • Bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Office, notamment Excel.

Compétences comportementales

  • Leadership et capacité à fédérer.
  • Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de communication.
  • Capacité d’écoute, de conseil et de médiation.
  • Sens de la négociation et capacité à gérer les situations sensibles.
  • Capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs de différents niveaux hiérarchiques.
  • Esprit d’analyse et capacité de prise de décision.
  • Organisation, rigueur et gestion des priorités.
  • Autonomie et proactivité.
  • Discrétion, intégrité et respect absolu de la confidentialité.
  • Orientation résultats et sens du service.

LANGUES

  • Excellente maîtrise du français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
  • Bonne maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais, permettant d’échanger avec des interlocuteurs internationaux.

OBJECTIFS CLÉS DU POSTE

Le/la Responsable des Ressources Humaines devra notamment contribuer à :

  • Professionnaliser et optimiser les processus RH.
  • Garantir la conformité juridique et sociale de l’entreprise.
  • Accompagner les managers dans la gestion de leurs équipes.
  • Attirer, développer et fidéliser les talents.
  • Renforcer la qualité du dialogue et du climat social.
  • Améliorer la fiabilité des données et du reporting RH.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Commissioning Expert with 10+ years of hands-on experience in complex industrial power systems.

The role will lead and coordinate the pre-commissioning, energization, testing, and grid integration of HV/MV electrical systems, ensuring safe commissioning, regulatory compliance, and successful handover to operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead commissioning of 380 kV HV GIS substations, power transformers, and MV distribution systems.
  • Manage pre-commissioning and energization of HV/MV switchgear, transformers, and electrical equipment.
  • Commission STATCOM systems, harmonic filters, and reactive power compensation equipment.
  • Oversee testing and energization of transformers and rectifiers for PEM and AEL electrolyzer systems.
  • Coordinate earthing measurements, protection testing, relay coordination, and grid compliance.
  • Lead electrical loop checks, functional testing, protection and interlock verification.
  • Coordinate electrical vendors, contractors, and site commissioning teams.
  • Manage Construction-to-Commissioning handover, punch-list clearance, and commissioning documentation.
  • Support PSSR and process start-up activities.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of electrical commissioning experience in complex industrial projects.
  • Expert-level experience with HV & MV systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HV GIS, substations, transformers, switchgear, and protection systems.
  • Experience with grid integration, energization, and reactive power compensation.
  • Experience leading commissioning teams and contractors.
  • Good understanding of E&I documentation, loop diagrams, wiring diagrams, and electrical drawings.
  • Experience with DCS/BPCS/SIS interfaces is an advantage.
  • Strong leadership, communication, reporting, and problem-solving skills.
  • High level of autonomy and ability to work in an international, multicultural environment.

KEY COMPETENCIES:

  • HV & MV Commissioning — Expert level
  • Electrical Equipment & Substation Commissioning — Confirmed
  • E&I Commissioning — Confirmed
  • Commissioning Management — Confirmed
  • Protection Systems & Grid Integration — Strong experience
  • Technical Reporting & Documentation — Advanced
  • Team Leadership & Coordination — Advanced
  • Autonomy & Problem Solving — Confirmed
  • International / Multidisciplinary Project Experience — Preferred

Title: DCS Commissioning Specialist

Job Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled DCS Commissioning Specialist to support and lead all DCS-related commissioning activities on an industrial project.

The successful candidate will have a minimum of 10 years of experience working with DCS systems, with proven hands-on experience with YOKOGAWA systems. The role requires strong technical expertise in DCS commissioning, troubleshooting, configuration verification, and coordination with E&I and loop-check teams.

Fluent English is mandatory.

Only candidates who meet the key technical requirements will be considered.

Key Responsibilities

● Lead and perform DCS commissioning activities throughout the project.

● Carry out DCS reception, energization, and functional checks.

● Verify DCS configuration against approved project specifications and documentation.

● Check control logic, sequences, alarms, interlocks, and functional requirements.

● Coordinate closely with the loop-check team to support commissioning activities and resolve DCS-related issues.

● Troubleshoot and debug DCS issues identified during commissioning.

● Make necessary modifications within the DCS to ensure compliance with project specifications, including:

○ Signal ranges

○ Sensor types

○ Functional logic

○ Alarms and interlocks

○ Control and monitoring functions

● Verify DCS interfaces with field instrumentation and other control systems where applicable.

● Complete and maintain all required quality and commissioning documentation related to on-site checks.

● Ensure commissioning activities are performed in accordance with project procedures, specifications, and HSE requirements.

● Support the commissioning team in identifying and resolving technical issues efficiently.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Essential Requirements

● Minimum 10 years of professional experience with DCS systems.

● Proven hands-on experience in DCS commissioning.

● Confirmed experience with YOKOGAWA systems.

● Strong experience in troubleshooting, debugging, and modifying DCS configurations.

● Ability to interpret technical and engineering documentation.

● Fluent English — mandatory.

● Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary commissioning and engineering teams.

Preferred Profile

The ideal candidate is:

● A senior commissioning professional with extensive DCS experience.

● Highly experienced with YOKOGAWA DCS platforms.

● Comfortable working directly on site and resolving commissioning issues independently.

● Able to coordinate effectively with loop-check, instrumentation, electrical, and commissioning teams.

● Detail-oriented and rigorous when completing commissioning and quality documentation.

● Able to work in an international, multidisciplinary environment.

● Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Selection Criteria

Candidates will be assessed based on their technical qualifications, relevant commissioning experience, DCS expertise, experience with YOKOGAWA systems, English proficiency, and overall suitability for the project.

The selection process may also consider factors such as relevant project experience, technical and commercial suitability, availability, delivery requirements, contractual considerations, and overall project risk.

Please note: Due to the specific technical requirements of this position, profiles that do not demonstrate the required 10+ years of DCS experience, YOKOGAWA experience, and fluent English will not be considered.

We are recruiting for one of our clients,

They are a leading supplier of Agricultural Inputs and some industrial chemicals. They are willing to expand their Industrial & Specialty Chemicals portfolio with a diverse range of products to serve multiple industries, including paints, inks, petrochemicals, mining and energy, cement, automotive, food & beverage, construction, water treatment, packaging, textiles, metals, pharmaceuticals, Agri commodities processing, soap, detergents, personal and home care, foundry, cosmetics, and many others. To expand their operations, they are seeking an experienced and driven B2B Sales Expert to join their team in Ivory Coast. This is an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in their growth and to work across multiple industrial sectors.

Job Description:

The B2B Sales Expert will be responsible for driving sales and business development efforts for our wide portfolio of industrial chemicals. This includes identifying new business opportunities and building relationships across diverse sectors such as petrochemicals, mining, energy, automotive, food & beverage, and more. The ideal candidate should have a proven track record in B2B sales of industrial chemicals, with a strong understanding of several industrial sectors. Experience selling to neighboring countries in West Africa is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to promote our industrial chemical products across various industries, including but not limited to:
  • Paints & Inks
  • Petrochemicals & Mining & Energy
  • Cement & Construction
  • Automotive & Food & Beverage
  • Water Treatment & Packaging
  • Textiles & Metals
  • Pharmaceuticals & Agri-commodities Processing
  • Soap, Detergents, Personal & Home Care, Cosmetics, and more.
  1. Target and acquire new B2B customers in Ivory Coast and potentially in neighboring countries, ensuring continuous growth in these markets.
  2. Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with clients, ensuring repeat business and customer satisfaction.
  3. Provide technical advice, support, and training to customers on the effective use of chemical products and applications.
  4. Lead negotiations, deliver compelling sales presentations, and close deals to achieve sales targets and business objectives.
  5. Collaborate with internal teams (technical, logistics, and marketing) to ensure seamless service delivery and customer satisfaction.
  6. Stay informed on market trends, competitor activities, and new product developments to maintain a competitive edge.
  7. Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to expand network opportunities and market presence.
  8. Report on sales performance, customer feedback, and market conditions to senior management on a regular basis.

Key Requirements:

  • Experience: 5+ Years of Proven experience in B2B sales of industrial chemicals, with a strong understanding of the sales process and customer relationship management across multiple industries such as mining & energy, construction, food & beverage, soap & detergents, pharmaceuticals, and others. Experience in at least a few of these sectors is essential.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of the applications of industrial chemicals in diverse industries, with the ability to communicate complex technical information effectively to customers.
  • Market Knowledge: Experience selling to clients in Ivory Coast and ideally in neighboring West African countries.
  • Sales Skills: Demonstrated ability to develop sales strategies, build relationships, and close deals effectively. Strong negotiation and presentation skills are required. Strong business acumen and ability to understand the unique needs of various sectors and tailor solutions accordingly.
  • Self-motivated: Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and thrive in a target-driven sales environment.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with fluency in French (English or other local languages is an advantage).
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt and learn quickly about new chemical products and market segments.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel frequently across Ivory Coast and neighboring countries to meet clients and explore new markets.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Cross-Industry Experience: Familiarity with multiple chemical sectors and the ability to pivot between different industries.
  • Regional Experience: Experience working in other Ivory Coast or other West African markets is crucial.
  • Technical or Engineering Background: A background in chemical engineering or related technical field can be a plus.
  • Regulatory Experience: Familiarity with the regulatory landscape of the Ivory Coast and neighboring countries regarding the import and sale of chemicals.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
  • Health insurance and wellness benefits.
  • Travel and accommodation allowances for business trips.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement within the company.
  • A dynamic work environment in a growing industry.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Technical Assistance Services (TAS) Coordinator to support the coordination and administration of external personnel for a major engineering project. This role is responsible for managing contractor mobilization, coordinating recruitment activities, administering framework agreements, and ensuring compliance with company procedures and project manpower requirements.

The successful candidate will work closely with HR, Procurement, Project Management, and external Technical Assistance agencies to ensure the timely and efficient mobilization of contractor personnel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the HR team in coordinating Technical Assistance (TA) personnel throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Administer and manage framework agreements with Technical Assistance providers.
  • Coordinate the end-to-end tendering process using the company's Vendor Management System (VMS).
  • Organize and coordinate interviews with hiring managers and project stakeholders.
  • Ensure contractor working conditions comply with company policies and contractual requirements.
  • Prepare procurement documentation, including Purchase Requisitions (PR) and Recommendations to Award (RTA), for service order issuance through SAP.
  • Manage contract extensions and renewals as required.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential contractor documentation in accordance with GDPR requirements.
  • Coordinate with Technical Assistance agencies to ensure timely processing of work visas and expatriate mobilization.
  • Maintain and update personnel databases and project manpower plans.
  • Monitor contractor mobilization and provide regular reporting to project stakeholders.
  • Ensure all activities are carried out in compliance with company procedures and quality standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
  • Experience in contractor administration, workforce coordination, HR operations, or technical assistance management.
  • Previous experience within engineering, EPC, energy, or industrial projects is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with procurement and contractor management processes.

Technical Skills

  • Experience with Vendor Management Systems (VMS), preferably Ulysse or similar platforms.
  • Working knowledge of SAP, particularly Purchase Requisitions and Service Orders.
  • Strong contractor administration and workforce planning experience.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel.

Key Competencies

  • Excellent organizational and coordination skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Professional handling of confidential information.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.

HSE Safety Officer

Contract Duration: 12 Months (Third-Party Contractor)

Location: South Africa

To provide Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) support to the GSC, Solutions and Services Business Units, as well as Front Office and Back Office functions, ensuring compliance with the group's HSE requirements, ISO management systems, legal obligations, and customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities

·       Support the implementation and maintenance of the group's HSE programs and procedures.

·       Provide HSE support to GSC, Solutions and Services activities, as well as Front Office and Back Office operations.

·       Projects HSE support

·       Support the implementation and continuous improvement of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 management systems.

·       Conduct risk assessments and support the implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

·       Contractor management – compliance evaluation, training and certification.

·       Review HSE documentation and ensure compliance with internal, legal, and customer requirements.

·       Support site inspections, audits, and HSE assessments.

·       Assist with incident reporting, investigations, and follow-up of corrective actions.

·       Deliver HSE awareness sessions and promote a positive safety culture.

·       Monitor contractor compliance with HSE requirements.

·       Support HSE reporting, data analysis, and performance tracking.·        

Minimum Requirements

·       National Diploma or Degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Management, or a related field.

·       Registered with SACPCMP as a Safety Officer or eligible for registration.

·       Minimum 3–5 years' experience in an HSE/Safety Officer role.

·       Working knowledge and experience in implementing and maintaining ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 management systems.

·       Knowledge of applicable South African HSE legislation and industry best practices.

·       Strong communication, stakeholder management, and administrative skills.

·       Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

·       Incident Accident investigation , Risk Assessor, Legal Liability and other relevant HSE qualifications

·       Ability to support multiple business functions and work independently.

Role Purpose

The Business Support Manager works directly with the CEO to coordinate cross-departmental projects, track execution against deadlines, and ensure the CEO has accurate, timely information to make decisions. This role acts as the operational backbone of the executive office ,turning strategic priorities into coordinated action across departments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and track multiple concurrent projects across departments, ensuring deadlines, deliverables, and dependencies are managed proactively.
  • Serve as a central point of coordination between the CEO's office and department heads, following up on action items and commitments.
  • Prepare accurate, well-structured management reports, dashboards, and briefing materials for the CEO and leadership team.
  • Build and maintain project trackers, timelines, and status reports; flag risks and delays before they become problems.
  • Support the CEO in preparing for meetings, including agendas, presentations, and follow-up documentation.
  • Coordinate logistics and information flow for cross-functional initiatives, working with finance, operations, and other departments as needed.
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive business information.
  • Take on ad hoc strategic projects and analyses as directed by the CEO.

Essential Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years' professional experience.
  • Minimum 3 years in business operations, project coordination, PMO, executive office support, or operations management.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple departments or workstreams simultaneously.
  • Proven experience preparing management reports and executive-level communications.
  • Strong project tracking and organizational skills, with high attention to detail.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and operate with discretion.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in engineering, oil & gas, construction, infrastructure, logistics, or manufacturing sectors.
  • Prior experience working directly with executive leadership (CEO, MD, or C-suite).
  • Experience with project management software (e.g., MS Project, Asana, Monday.com, Trello).
  • Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is an advantage.

Details:

Status: Permanent, 28*28 rotation

Start: At the soonest possible

Experience

  • Completion of Secondary education, trade course, or apprenticeship.
  • 10 years’ varied installation, maintenance, and repair experience at which 5 years’ experience as construction Supervisor level, within the Oil and Gas/ Petrochemical industry.
  • Working knowledge of computer applications software such as Microsoft Office and Oracle systems.
  • Good knowledge of English (Speak, Read, and Write).
  • Previous experience as supervisor.

Duties to be carried out:

  • Identify and develop work plans for review and approval.
  • Receive incoming work requests, discuss work required with the construction team, and estimate time, materials or spare parts required to complete the work.
  • Receive schedule of job, with appropriate \"Permit to Work\" and arrange for tools, diagrams and test equipment.
  • Report to Construction Superintendent for the day-to-day activities.
  • Conduct morning group safety meetings.
  • Coordinate and supervise all production supervision personnel.
  • Prepare daily construction report.
  • Assist to prepare Permit to Work (PTW).
  • Attend planning meetings and provide job status updates.
  • Compile all time sheet for the day and review time and work order etc. and forward to Construction Superintendent for further approval.

Job Details

Job Title: Lifting/Rigging Specialist

Department: Engineering

Reporting To: Sunrise Construction Manager

II

Job Purpose

Responsible for the supervision of day to day lifting and rigging activities at site. Review and endorse contractor’s lifting plan, Risk assessment. Ensure compliance and implementation of COMPANY lifting procedure at site. Carry out periodic inspection of all lifting equipment, lifting tools and tackles. Conduct periodic audits of contractors lifting equipment and personal certifications. In this capacity, the incumbent work alongside a limited number of COMPANY discipline construction supervisors to ensure adherence to project scope.

III

Dimensions

Number of Direct Staff: 0

Number of Indirect Staff (if applicable): 0.

Number of Direct or Indirect Contractors (if applicable): 0

IV

Key Result Areas (Key Accountabilities)

1. Contribute to COMPANY Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) performance by ensuring applicable HSE standards are known, understood and followed within the workplace. Ensure contractor’s awareness and performance are maintained at a high level.

2. Review and endorse contractors lifting plan and risk assessment. Assist as required to ensure contractor lift plans are suitable.

3. Coordinate and supervise lifting activities in accordance with the lifting plan, ensure that only certified and licensed crane operators are operating the crane or any other lifting equipment at site.

4. Check and ensure ground conditions are suitable for safe lifting operations.

5. Monitor day-to-day lifting and Rigging activities of the Construction Contractor.

6. Conduct periodic inspection of lifting equipment, lifting tools and tackles being used at site. Ensure the mandatory daily checks of all lifting equipment is done by the respective crew and log maintained. Monitor compliance and implementation of color coding of lifting equipment and tools at site.

7. Conduct or monitor all toolbox talks prior to any lifting operation at site.

8. Support Project Team to conduct necessary transportation and heavy lift studies before any critical equipment Transportation and installation at site.

9. Initiate and implement necessary control measures to avoid incidents related to simultaneous lifting operation involving multiple equipment at one location.

10. Work with Construction Contractor and coordinate with COMPANY other discipline Supervisors before performing any critical lifting operation at site to avoid last minute surprises.

Information Security Classification: Shared Confidential Page 3 of 4

V

Communication and Important Working Relationships

Internal Contacts:

Construction Superintendent, Construction Supervisors, Sunrise Program Construction Manager, Project Manager, Lead Construction Engineer, Technical Authority, Engineering Department, Operations and Maintenance teams.

External Contacts:

Construction Contractors and lifting vendors and subcontractors.

VI

Knowledge, Skills, Experience and Job Related Competencies

Educational Qualifications:

 A degree or technical diploma in Mechanical Engineering.

 Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations (LOLER) Certification.

Experience Profile:

 10+ years onshore oil and gas construction industry experience.

 5+ years’ experience in power plant, gas plant and pipeline construction.

 Experience with cranes, lifting tools and tackles.

Information Security:

 Employees shall read, understand, and comply with DPE’s Information Security Policies, Standards, and Procedures.

 Employees shall promptly report any suspected or actual information security incidents to their respective line manager or the IT Department.

 Employees shall protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of COMPANY information assets.

Competencies/Skills/Others:

 Ability to prepare lifting plans and conduct risk assessments for lifting and associated works.

 Ability to supervise, monitor all lifting operations independently, and implement safe lifting practices at site.

 Engage with all stakeholders in a positive and collaborative manner.

 Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings related to equipment installation.

 Conversant with lifting standards followed in the industry.

 Ability to interact with multi discipline and multi culture Construction crew.

 Strong safety and environmental ethic.

 Must have the temperament to work effectively with multi-national team.

 Well organised and methodical.

 Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

 A valid United Arab Emirates driving license or the ability to obtain one.

Objectivo Principal

O principal objectivo desta função é apoiar o Superintendente de Operações na supervisão de todas as actividades operacionais, de manutenção, HSSE e administrativas nos armazéns de lubrificantes sob a gestão da Puma Energy Moçambique.A função é responsável por liderar a equipa do armazém, garantindo a recepção, armazenamento, manuseamento e expedição segura e eficiente de lubrificantes embalados, mantendo um controlo rigoroso de stocks e assegurando o cumprimento das políticas, procedimentos e normas de HSSE da empresa.

Responsabilidades

Operações

  • Garantir que a recepção de lubrificantes embalados provenientes de camiões (principalmente com origem na África do Sul) seja realizada em estrita conformidade com os processos e procedimentos da empresa, incluindo a verificação de quantidades, estado das embalagens, exactidão da documentação e todos os requisitos aplicáveis de segurança e ambiente.
  • Coordenar com os departamentos de Abastecimento e Transporte para assegurar a entrega atempada e completa dos produtos no armazém, de acordo com os volumes e calendários acordados.
  • Supervisionar as operações diárias do armazém, incluindo arrumação dos produtos nos locais designados, armazenamento organizado, preparação de pedidos, preparação de encomendas e carregamento de camiões para entregas a clientes e transferências internas para outros armazéns de lubrificantes em Moçambique.
  • Garantir que o manuseamento dos produtos seja realizado de forma segura, utilizando métodos e equipamentos aprovados (manuseamento manual, porta-paletes e empilhador a diesel).
  • Assegurar que as operações de expedição para clientes e transferências entre armazéns sejam executadas de forma segura, correcta e em total conformidade com os termos contratuais de entrega e procedimentos da empresa.
  • Garantir o registo correcto e completo de todas as actividades de recepção, movimentação de stock e expedição, utilizando os formulários e sistemas oficiais da empresa.
  • Antecipar e monitorizar potenciais problemas operacionais (rupturas de stock, limitações de espaço, disponibilidade de equipamentos e problemas de documentação), propondo soluções práticas de forma atempada.

HSSE (Saúde, Segurança, Protecção e Ambiente)

  • Cumprir integralmente todas as regras e procedimentos da empresa relacionados com segurança, ambiente, saúde, protecção e prevenção de incêndios.
  • Promover uma forte cultura de HSSE e elevados padrões de desempenho dentro da equipa do armazém.
  • Participar nos simulacros periódicos de emergência realizados no local.
  • Responder a situações de emergência (incêndio, derrames de produtos, incidentes médicos) de acordo com o Plano de Resposta a Emergências do local e as instruções do Coordenador da Emergência.
  • Como membro activo da equipa de resposta a emergências do local, conhecer plenamente a utilização correcta de todos os equipamentos de emergência e combate a incêndios disponíveis.
  • Comunicar regularmente situações de quase acidente, actos inseguros e condições inseguras utilizando as ferramentas e canais apropriados da empresa. Comunicar imediatamente qualquer incidente ou acidente ao Gestor de Operações e ao Gestor de HSSE.
  • Garantir que qualquer intervenção de manutenção (interna ou externa) seja precedida por uma avaliação formal de riscos e, quando aplicável, pelo processo formal de Permissão de Trabalho (PTW).
  • Garantir que todos os equipamentos de HSSE no local sejam devidamente mantidos, registados e monitorizados quanto aos níveis de stock, estado de conservação e datas de validade.

Manutenção

  • Desenvolver e executar um plano específico de inspecção para o armazém de lubrificantes e os seus equipamentos (empilhador, porta-paletes, estruturas de armazenagem, portas, iluminação, equipamentos de combate a incêndios, etc.), em coordenação com a gestão de Operações, e implementá-lo de forma rigorosa.
  • Criar e utilizar listas de verificação adequadas para as actividades de inspecção e manutenção do armazém.
  • Garantir que a limpeza do armazém e os padrões de organização sejam mantidos sempre ao mais alto nível.
  • Supervisionar pequenas intervenções de manutenção em total conformidade com as normas de HSSE da empresa.

 Administração e Controlo de Stocks

  • Garantir o registo completo e correcto de todas as actividades de recepção, movimentações internas e expedição nos sistemas de gestão de stocks da empresa.
  • Liderar e realizar contagens regulares de stocks e reconciliações. Comunicar imediatamente quaisquer ganhos ou perdas anormais identificados durante os exercícios diários, semanais ou periódicos de gestão de stocks.
  • Apoiar os departamentos de Abastecimento, Finanças e Operações nas reconciliações de stocks e nos exercícios de inventário físico dos armazéns de lubrificantes.
  • Apoiar o Gestor de Operações na criação e manutenção de painéis de controlo (dashboards) simples e Indicadores-Chave de Desempenho (KPIs) que demonstrem melhoria contínua na excelência operacional, precisão de stocks e níveis de serviço.
  • Garantir que todos os equipamentos fixos e móveis existentes no local sejam devidamente mantidos e registados no inventário de activos do armazém.
  • Garantir que as actividades operacionais não essenciais (por exemplo, abastecimento do gerador, fornecimento de água e energia, horas de funcionamento dos equipamentos) sejam devidamente registadas.

Qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada de 3 a 5 anos em operações de armazém, preferencialmente no manuseamento de produtos petrolíferos embalados, lubrificantes, produtos químicos ou outros bens industriais similares. Experiência na recepção e expedição de mercadorias por camião constitui uma vantagem.
  • Diploma técnico ou equivalente em Logística, Gestão de Armazéns, Engenharia Industrial, Manutenção ou área relacionada constitui uma vantagem.
  • Capacidade de interagir eficazmente com a gestão a todos os níveis, bem como com contactos externos, especialmente transportadores e clientes.
  • Fortes capacidades analíticas para identificar problemas, investigar variações e propor soluções práticas de forma autónoma.
  • Profissional com experiência prática, orientado para resultados, com forte enfoque na excelência operacional, precisão e satisfação do cliente.
  • Capacidade de colaborar eficazmente com equipas multifuncionais e multiculturais.
  • Disponibilidade para estar contactável fora do horário normal de trabalho, quando necessário. Poderão ser necessárias deslocações ocasionais dentro de Moçambique para apoiar outros armazéns de lubrificantes ou actividades comerciais.
  • Conhecimentos de software empresarial geral e capacidade de aprender novas aplicações; domínio do Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook). Experiência com sistemas de gestão de stocks ou de armazém constitui uma vantagem.
  • Fluente em português. Conhecimentos de inglês constituem uma forte vantagem.
