de Armazém de Lubrificantes"},"description":{"4":"

Objectivo Principal

O principal objectivo desta função é executar as operações diárias do armazém de lubrificantes embalados, sob a orientação do Supervisor do Armazém de Lubrificantes. O Operador é responsável pela recepção, manuseamento, armazenamento, preparação de encomendas (picking), carregamento e expedição de produtos de forma segura e eficiente, utilizando métodos manuais, porta-paletes e empilhador a diesel.A função também apoia o controlo rigoroso de stocks através de contagens físicas e da correcta documentação, assegurando o cumprimento integral de todas as normas e procedimentos de Saúde, Segurança, Protecção e Ambiente (HSSE) da empresa.

Responsabilidades

Operações

  • Receber lubrificantes embalados provenientes de camiões (principalmente da África do Sul). Verificar as quantidades, o estado das embalagens e a documentação de acordo com as guias de remessa, sob orientação do Supervisor.
  • Descarregar camiões de forma segura utilizando o empilhador a diesel, porta-paletes ou através de manuseamento manual, conforme apropriado.
  • Armazenar os produtos recebidos nos locais correctos, assegurando o empilhamento adequado, a correcta etiquetagem e a manutenção dos padrões de organização e limpeza do armazém.
  • Preparar e separar encomendas para entregas a clientes e transferências para outros armazéns de lubrificantes em Moçambique, de acordo com as listas de preparação de pedidos ou instruções do Supervisor.
  • Carregar camiões de forma segura e correcta, garantindo que os produtos estejam devidamente acondicionados e que a documentação esteja completa antes da expedição.
  • Operar o empilhador a diesel como operador principal, realizando verificações diárias antes da utilização e comunicando imediatamente quaisquer avarias ou defeitos identificados.
  • Utilizar porta-paletes e executar tarefas de manuseamento manual de cargas de forma segura e eficiente.
  •  Registar correctamente todos os movimentos (recepção, transferências internas e expedições) nos formulários ou sistemas da empresa, conforme instruções recebidas.

HSSE (Saúde, Segurança, Protecção e Ambiente)

  • Cumprir integralmente todas as regras, procedimentos de HSSE e práticas de trabalho seguro da empresa em todos os momentos.
  • Utilizar correctamente todos os Equipamentos de Protecção Individual (EPI) obrigatórios durante a permanência no local de trabalho.
  • Participar activamente nas reuniões de segurança (toolbox talks), reuniões de segurança e simulacros de emergência.
  • Comunicar imediatamente ao Supervisor qualquer situação de quase acidente, acto inseguro, condição insegura, incidente ou acidente.
  • Responder a situações de emergência (incêndio, derrame, ferimentos) de acordo com o Plano de Resposta a Emergências do local e as instruções do Coordenador da Emergência ou do Supervisor.
  • Nunca operar equipamentos que apresentem defeitos ou para os quais não possua autorização ou formação adequada. Interromper qualquer actividade que aparente ser insegura e comunicar ao Supervisor.
  • Manter uma boa organização e limpeza do armazém, garantindo que os kits de contenção de derrames e os equipamentos de combate a incêndios permaneçam acessíveis e em boas condições.

Cuidados com os Equipamentos e Organização do Armazém

  • Realizar inspecções diárias antes da utilização do empilhador a diesel e dos porta-paletes. Comunicar imediatamente ao Supervisor quaisquer defeitos ou necessidades de manutenção identificadas.
  • Manter o empilhador limpo e garantir que este seja estacionado de forma segura, com a chave removida quando não estiver em utilização.
  • Apoiar nas actividades básicas de organização e pequenas tarefas de limpeza, mantendo o armazém limpo, organizado e livre de riscos de tropeços.
  • Apoiar o Supervisor durante as inspecções programadas e actividades de manutenção, conforme solicitado.

Position Summary

We are seeking a qualified Welding & Materials Engineer to support engineering studies and construction activities within the DIVERS Project. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, the successful candidate will provide technical expertise in welding engineering, materials, and non-destructive testing (NDT), while working closely with multidisciplinary project teams and subcontractors.

The role involves supporting both engineering and construction phases, ensuring compliance with client specifications, industry standards, and project quality requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, review, and implement welding procedures and project-specific technical documentation.
  • Evaluate client specifications, technical requirements, and project documentation.
  • Review and assess technical bids to support subcontractor selection.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to subcontractors throughout project execution.
  • Review subcontractor manufacturing documentation, including: Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS)
  • Welding books and fabrication procedures
  • Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) procedures
  • Investigate and resolve welding and fabrication non-conformities.
  • Support construction sites through technical assistance and periodic site visits.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, and client requirements.

Required Qualifications

Education & Certifications

  • ESSA Welding Engineer and/or International Welding Engineer (IWE) certification.
  • Strong knowledge of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods.

Experience

  • Experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Experience supporting engineering studies, fabrication, and construction projects.
  • Experience working with subcontractors and fabrication yards is highly desirable.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong technical knowledge of welding engineering and metallurgy.
  • Ability to interpret technical specifications and international standards.
  • Experience with fabrication quality control and NDT processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Willingness to travel for onshore and offshore assignments.

SURF Lead Flowlines Engineer

The Venus Project is a very deep-water greenfield oil development located in West Africa and managed by Company’s GPI Venus team. The project is focused on defining the subsea production and injection system in challenging deep-water conditions, covering the phases of pre-project studies, FEED, Call for Tender, and full project execution.

The project’s objectives include:

  • Optimizing reserves and reducing costs
  • Accelerating schedules
  • Minimizing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions
  • Ensuring high technical quality and strict H3SE compliance

The SURF Flowline Lead Engineer will play a key role in ensuring the successful design, engineering, procurement, fabrication, installation, and pre-commissioning of rigid flowlines, spools, jumpers, and associated subsea structures.

Missions/Service Dimensions

The service holder will be responsible for all the flowline engineering activities and technical matters related to the project, as part of the project team.

This will include but not be limited to reviewing, approving, preparing and managing all studies during Pre- project and FEED, Call For Tender and EPCI phases for rigid flowlines, rigid spools and rigid jumpers, and associated structures, equipment and ancillaries, for a very deep water oil greenfield project.

The Service Provider will be leading the design and engineering activities, and be supporting the procurement,fabrication, installation and pre-commissioning activities.

The Service Provider will provide support to the SURF Technical Manager and the SURF team and liaise with

other project teams (SPS).

Activities


HSE & Ethics Compliance

  • Ensure that all SURF contractor activities and technical documentation align with Company’s H3SE & quality standards.
  • Promote and enforce H3SE best practices and compliance with safety regulations.
  • Demonstrate exemplary adherence to Company’s Ethics & Code of Conduct.

Engineering & Technical Oversight

  • Lead flowline engineering activities from Pre-Project, FEED, Call for Tender, to EPCI phases.
  • Ensure compliance with Company’s specifications, industry regulations, and international standards for:
  • Rigid flowlines
  • In-Line Tees (ILTs)
  • Flowline End Terminations (FLETs)
  • Rigid spools and jumpers
  • Ancillary subsea equipment
  • Supervise contractor technical activities and validate engineering deliverables.
  • Oversee procurement, fabrication, construction, testing, and pre-commissioning.

Tender Preparation & Supplier Management

  • Prepare and deliver the technical package for the SURF EPCI Call for Tender.
  • Evaluate technical offers, lead technical clarifications with bidders, and ensure timely contract award.
  • Ensure contractor compliance with project specifications and requirements.
  • Support contract negotiations, technical reviews, and final recommendations.

Fabrication, Installation & Pre-Commissioning

  • Supervise all testing and qualification activities (SWT, CDT, FAT, EFAT, SIT).
  • Ensure proper execution of installation preparation, pre-commissioning, and commissioning activities.
  • Coordinate with SURF suppliers and major contractors to ensure QA/QC compliance.
  • Act as technical referent for all flowline, spool, and jumper-related issues.

Project Coordination & Interface Management

  • Ensure coordination with SPS, Installation, Operations teams, and Interface Managers.
  • Participate in HAZID, HAZOP, risk assessments, design reviews, and constructability reviews.
  • Ensure proper document management and compliance with Company’s procedures.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Provide regular updates and escalate risks, concerns, or deviations to the Technical Manager.
  • Identify opportunities for optimization to improve project execution.
  • Gather lessons learned and provide feedback to Company headquarters for future projects.

Qualifications & Experience Required

Education :Master’s degree in Engineering

Experience : At least 15 years in engineering & execution (procurement, fabrication, construction, installation, pre-commissioning) for rigid flowlines, spools, and jumpers in deep-water projects

Industry Experience : At least 10 years in large offshore oil & gas SURF projects

Technical Expertise :

  • Good experience in detailed engineering and execution phases related to rigid flowlines, spools, and jumpers in deep water
  • Strong knowledge of rigid flowlines, rigid spools, rigid jumpers, FLETs, ILTs
  • Expertise in flowline deep offshore engineering
  • Previous experience on very deepwater projects
  • Good knowledge of relevant codes (DNV), and preferably of Company’s General Specifications, procedures, and policies
  • Experience working in a complex and multicultural environment

Soft Skills:

  • Positive, proactive, and pragmatic mindset
  • Ability to work in large, multidisciplinary teams
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a multicultural environment |

Languages:

  • Fluent in English (mandatory), French (preferred)

Mobility:

  • Willingness to travel to Contractor engineering sites, fabrication yards, and offshore locations as required

Directeur des Ressources Humaines

Rattaché directement à la Direction Générale – Membre du Comité de Direction

Périmètre: Groupe – +300 collaborateurs – Encadrement direct : Équipe RH

Dans un contexte de développement, de structuration et de digitalisation, le DRH définit et met en œuvre la stratégie RH afin de soutenir la performance globale, accompagner les transformations organisationnelles et garantir un climat social serein.

MISSIONS PRINCIPALES

1. Définition et pilotage de la stratégie RH

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie RH en cohérence avec la stratégie du Groupe.
  • Conseiller la Direction Générale sur les enjeux RH, sociaux et organisationnels.
  • Participer aux comités de direction.
  • Être le relais stratégique entre la Direction et les équipes.

2. Optimisation des politiques RH

  • Piloter les politiques de recrutement, intégration, formation, mobilité, performance et fidélisation.
  • Superviser les recrutements.
  • Piloter la GEPP/GPEC.
  • Développer la marque employeur.
  • Accompagner les managers.
  • Piloter les évaluations et le développement des talents.

3. Management de la fonction RH

  • Manager et structurer l'équipe RH.
  • Développer les compétences RH.
  • Mettre en place des méthodes de travail performantes.

4. Climat social & QVT

  • Maintenir un climat social positif.
  • Déployer les politiques QVT.
  • Prévenir les risques psychosociaux.
  • Favoriser l'engagement et le dialogue social.

5. Digitalisation & Reporting

  • Piloter la digitalisation RH et le SIRH.
  • Mettre en place des tableaux de bord RH.
  • Assurer un reporting stratégique à la Direction Générale.

6. Rémunération & avantages sociaux

  • Définir la politique de rémunération.
  • Garantir l'équité interne et la compétitivité externe.
  • Piloter les négociations salariales.

7. Conformité & relations sociales

  • Garantir la conformité légale.
  • Piloter le dialogue social.
  • Gérer les situations sensibles.
  • Représenter l'entreprise auprès des partenaires institutionnels.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

  • Formation: Bac+5 en Ressources Humaines, Droit Social, Gestion, Management ou équivalent.
  • Expérience: Minimum 10 ans d'expérience RH, dont une expérience significative en tant que DRH ou DRH Adjoint.
  • Compétences techniques
  • Expertise en droit du travail.
  • Vision stratégique RH.
  • Maîtrise du recrutement, développement des talents, rémunération et SIRH.
  • Conduite du changement et management d'équipes.
  • Qualités personnelles
  • Leadership et influence.
  • Communication et écoute.
  • Éthique, confidentialité et diplomatie.
  • Résilience et capacité à gérer des situations complexes.

SURF Engineering Leadership & Technical Delivery 

  • Provide senior‑level subsea engineering expertise.

  • purging, cleaning, and remediation activities. 
  • Develop engineering inputs for removal procedures, work packs, SIMOPS planning, and 
  • offshore execution sequences. 
  • Support ROV intervention engineering, equipment specification, tooling interfaces, and 
  • offshore support requirements. 

Interface Management & Multi‑Discipline Coordination 

  • Coordinate SURF interfaces with structural, marine, pipeline, construction, and

Documentation, Reporting & Regulatory Compliance 

  • Prepare subsea engineering deliverables including basis of design, calculations, 
  • drawings, specifications, and technical reports. 
  • Ensure subsea documentation aligns with Equinor governing documents and meets all 
  • U.S. regulatory requirements.  
  • Support audits, technical assurance reviews, and close‑out documentation for subsea

Our esteemed client is actively seeking a highly skilled and experienced SPS/SURF Interface Lead to join our client's pioneering team.

  • Provide expert technical guidance and support to procurement, fabrication, and installation teams, ensuring successful integration offshore.

Required Skills and Qualifications

We are thrilled to offer an exceptional opportunity for a talented SPS System Engineer to become a vital part of our client's project.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement Subsea Production Systems (SPS) solutions, ensuring optimal performance and reliability for critical oil and gas operations.

  • Develop comprehensive technical documentation, including specifications, operating procedures, and maintenance manuals.
  • Stay abreast of the latest industry trends, technologies, and regulatory requirements in subsea engineering to drive continuous improvement.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (e.g., Mechanical, Electrical, Petroleum, Ocean) or a related technical discipline.
  • Proven experience as an SPS System Engineer or in a similar role within the oil and gas sector, specifically with subsea production systems.
  • Strong understanding of SPS architecture, components, and functionalities, including control systems, hydraulics, and electrical interfaces.
  • Proficiency with relevant engineering software and simulation tools.
  • In-depth knowledge of industry codes, standards, and best practices applicable to subsea operations (e.g., API, DNV, ISO).
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen eye for detail.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, capable of thriving in a team-oriented environment.
  • A proactive approach to challenges and a commitment to delivering high-quality engineering solutions.

Benefits and Additional Information: For disclosure to selected candidates.

FPSO Marine System Engineer

CFT Reference:

                                                                                     

Missions / Service dimensions

The service holder will oversee all design, engineering and construction activities performed by FPSO Contractor and its vendors related to the hull systems

The service holder will be responsible for Interface with Classification Society on all engineering matters related to hull systems

 

Activities

 

The FPSO Marine System Engineer is expected to perform the following activities:

§ Ensure that documents issued comply with project specifications, Class rules, international standards and regulations

§ Verify that documents align with the overall operating philosophy and functional requirements in relation with field operations representatives.

§ Contribute to the technical evaluation of hull systems engineering, procurement, construction, installation and review/approval of deliverables from the FPSO Contractor and its Vendors

§ Participate in project meetings and reviews (i.e. design reviews, Interface meetings, HAZIDs / HAZOPs / technical reviews, constructability reviews, workshops) during the engineering, construction, pre-commissioning and commissioning phases

§ Interact and coordinate with other disciplines such as Process, Piping, Electrical, Mechanical, HVAC, Instrumentation, ICSS, Structure, Corrosion to ensure robust and optimized design of the hull systems in compliance with the project specifications

§ Liaise with Topsides discipline engineers and Safety lead engineers to ensure inter-disciplines checks

§ Follow up on interfaces issues pertaining to hull systems and facilitate their resolution.

§ Monitor closely the Classification Society activities on all technical matters related to the hull systems, ensure all comments from Class are properly addressed by Contractors and Vendors (through the contract) for a timely issuance of the Class and Flag required Certificates.

§ Prepare project documentation as needed

§ Support the procurement team by following up the technical activities of Vendors providing equipment related to hull systems

§ In coordination with QA/QC team participate as needed to the ITP definition, witness hold points at vendor fabrication site and attend FAT for equipment related to hull systems

§ Attend onboard tests for marine systems

§ Assist and report to hull manager, highlighting areas of concern, costs and schedule deviations

§ Propose positions to the Hull manager regarding deviation, exemption or modification requests

§ Liaise with head office specialists for arbitration / resolution of technical issues when required

§ Contribute to the project’s lessons learned by liaising with head office specialist on a regular basis (regular meetings) and issuing a close out report related to the aforementioned activities

Context & Environment

§ International and multi-cultural environment.

§ Position permanently based in EPSCC Contractor premises.

§ Frequent mission aboard.

Duration / Location

·     Starting date:         September 2026

·     Duration:                1 year to 4 years after FPSO contract Award

·     Renewable:           Yes

·     Location:                At Contractor engineering and Construction site

·    Status:                   Residential

Qualifications & Experience required

§ Diploma: Bachelor or Master degree of Engineering.

§ Professional experience: >10 years. Specialist in Hull systems for Oil & Gas platform with proven experience in FPSOs.

§ Required skills:

o   Strong knowledges and experience in hull systems for FPSOs and offloading operations

o   Strong knowledge of International O&G standards (in particular IMO) and Bureau Veritas classifications rules, OCIMF recommendations...

o   Excellent teamwork skills

o   Excellent organizational skills and commitment to meeting deadlines

o   Problem solving skills for complex and integrated processes

o   Fluent in English.

Location: Contractor Engineering & Construction Site (Residential)

Position Summary

The FPSO Marine Systems Engineer is responsible for overseeing the design, engineering, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning activities related to the FPSO hull systems. Acting as the primary technical focal point for marine systems, the role ensures compliance with project specifications, classification society requirements, international regulations, and industry standards while coordinating closely with the FPSO Contractor, vendors, multidisciplinary engineering teams, and Classification Society.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical oversight of all engineering, procurement, construction, installation, and commissioning activities related to FPSO hull systems.
  • Review and approve engineering deliverables produced by the FPSO Contractor and equipment vendors, ensuring compliance with project specifications, international standards, Class rules, and regulatory requirements.
  • Serve as the primary interface with the Classification Society for all engineering matters related to hull systems and ensure timely closure of comments to obtain Class and Flag certifications.
  • Ensure hull system designs align with the overall operating philosophy and functional requirements in collaboration with field operations representatives.
  • Participate in technical reviews, design reviews, HAZIDs, HAZOPs, constructability reviews, interface meetings, workshops, and project review sessions throughout engineering, construction, pre-commissioning, and commissioning phases.
  • Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams including Process, Piping, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, ICSS, HVAC, Structural, and Corrosion disciplines to ensure integrated and optimised marine system design.
  • Work closely with Topsides engineers and Safety specialists to ensure effective interdisciplinary coordination and interface management.
  • Identify, monitor, and resolve technical interface issues related to hull systems.
  • Support procurement activities by providing technical oversight of vendors supplying hull system equipment.
  • Collaborate with QA/QC teams to define Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), witness fabrication hold points, and participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs).
  • Attend onboard commissioning activities and marine system performance testing.
  • Monitor project progress, identify technical, cost, and schedule risks, and report concerns to the Hull Manager.
  • Evaluate and provide technical recommendations regarding deviations, exemptions, and modification requests.
  • Coordinate with TotalEnergies Head Office specialists to resolve complex technical issues and ensure alignment with company standards.
  • Contribute to project close-out activities by documenting lessons learned and preparing technical reports.

Working Environment

  • International and multicultural project environment.
  • Residential assignment based at the FPSO EPC Contractor's engineering and construction facilities.
  • Regular offshore and onboard missions during construction, commissioning, and testing phases.
  • Close collaboration with Contractor engineering teams, vendors, Classification Society, and TotalEnergies technical specialists.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical, Marine, Naval Architecture, Offshore, or related Engineering discipline.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry.

Job Title:

Executive Ass/Admin

Duration:

Full Time

Reports To:

MD

Executive Assistant

The Executive Assistant shall provide high-level administrative, operational, and coordination support to the Executive, ensuring the efficient management of the Executive Office and timely execution of business priorities.

Executive Support

Executive Assistant

The Executive Assistant shall provide high-level administrative, operational, and coordination support to the Executive, ensuring the efficient management of the Executive Office and timely execution of business priorities.

Executive Support

  1. Manage the Executive's calendar, appointments, meetings, and travel arrangements.
  2. Screen and prioritize emails, calls, correspondence, and meeting requests.
  3. Draft, proofread, and prepare professional correspondence, reports, presentations, and other documents.
  4. Maintain confidentiality of all business information and executive communications.

Project Coordination

  1. Maintain and monitor project action registers, schedules, and key milestones.
  2. Follow up with internal teams, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and stakeholders to ensure timely completion of assigned actions.
  3. Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas, record minutes, and track action items through to completion.
  4. Assist in monitoring project deliverables, approvals, and critical deadlines.

Board and Corporate Administration

  1. Coordinate Board and Executive Committee meetings, including scheduling, meeting packs, agendas, and minutes.
  2. Maintain corporate records, contracts, approvals, and executive documentation.
  3. Liaise with legal advisers, company secretaries, and other professional service providers as required.
  4. Track corporate governance, regulatory, and compliance deadlines.

Stakeholder Coordination

  1. Act as a central point of coordination between the Executive and internal and external stakeholders.
  2. Coordinate meetings with government agencies, clients, investors, consultants, and business partners.
  3. Maintain stakeholder contact databases and communication records.
  4. Organize executive visits, workshops, conferences, and business events.

Office Administration

  1. Arrange travel, visas, accommodation, transportation, and meeting logistics.
  2. Maintain electronic and physical filing systems and document registers.
  3. Process invoices, expense claims, purchase requests, and administrative documentation.
  4. Ensure office records and executive files are accurate, organized, and up to date.

Executive Office Management

  1. Monitor priorities, commitments, and deadlines, providing proactive reminders and follow-up.
  2. Conduct research and compile information to support executive decision-making.
  3. Prepare executive dashboards, status reports, and briefing notes.
  4. Coordinate special projects and perform additional duties assigned by the Executive.

General Responsibilities

  1. Demonstrate professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment in all interactions.
  2. Maintain a high level of confidentiality regarding company information.
  3. Build effective working relationships with colleagues, clients, government officials, and external stakeholders.
  4. Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and office efficiency.
  5. Perform any other duties reasonably assigned by the Executive to support the objectives of the Company.

Summary:

The Senior Trade Finance and International Operations Specialist is responsible for managing and supervising complex processes relating to trade finance and international financial operations, as well as supporting import and export operations, ensuring regulatory compliance, the efficient execution of transactions and the mitigation of associated risks.

Responsibilities:

  • To ensure the structuring, issuance, amendment and settlement of import and export letters of credit.
  • To manage documentary collection transactions, bank guarantees and standby letters of credit (SBLCs).
  •  Analyse, validate and monitor international trade documentation, issuing technical opinions in accordance with current legislation, foreign exchange regulations and ICC rules.
  • Identify, assess and mitigate commercial, foreign exchange, operational and documentary risks associated with international transactions.
  • Process international payments, SWIFT messages and related operational enquiries.
  • Manage and reconcile Nostro and Vostro accounts.
  • Ensure the monitoring of foreign exchange transactions and compliance with the directives of the Bank of Mozambique and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare regulatory reports and support the definition of internal procedures and controls.
  • Provide technical advice to clients, commercial departments and internal teams on structuring trade finance and international trade solutions.
  • Provide technical coordination of operational activities and participate in digital transformation and process optimisation initiatives.
  • Maintain operational relationships with corporate clients, correspondent banks and regulatory bodies.

Qualifications:

  • A degree in Business Administration, Economics, International Trade, Management, Finance or related fields.
  • At least 5 years’ experience in trade finance and international trade operations within the banking sector or other financial institutions.
  • In-depth knowledge and practical experience in applying the rules and publications of the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC), including UCP 600, ISBP, URC 522, URDG 758 and ISP98.
  • Solid knowledge of Mozambican foreign exchange legislation and related regulations.
  • Proficiency in Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (AML/CFT) standards.
  • Experience in managing and monitoring operational, commercial, foreign exchange and documentary risks.
  • Strong ability to analyse documentation and validate international trade transactions.
  • Ability to negotiate, resolve problems and make decisions in complex international financial transactions.
  • Experience in using SWIFT, Core Banking systems and specialised trade finance platforms.
  • Ability to provide technical coordination and guidance to operational teams.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written Portuguese and English (recommended, given the international nature of the role).

Job Details

Job Title: Mechanical Commissioning Supervisor

Business/Department: Onshore Operations

Reporting To: Commissioning Superintendent

II Job Purpose

Lead, supervise and coordinate all mechanical commissioning activities associated

with brownfield and greenfield projects to ensure safe, efficient and timely project

delivery in accordance with engineering deliverables, from Tie-in construction,

pre-commissioning, through start-up and handover.

Responsible for the planning, execution and supervision of mechanical precommissioning,

tie-ins, commissioning, testing, troubleshooting and start-up

activities. Ensure commissioning activities are completed in accordance with work

packs, approved procedures, project schedules, company standards and

regulatory requirements.

Provide technical leadership and day-to-day supervision of commissioning

foreman, technicians, contractors and vendor representatives, ensuring all

activities are carried out in accordance with the company Health, Safety,

Environment and Operational Integrity (HSEOI) policies and procedures.

III Dimensions

Number of Direct Staff: 1

Number of Indirect Staff (if applicable): 0

Number of Direct or Indirect Contractors (if applicable): 18

IV Key Result Areas (Key Accountabilities)

1. Act as the mechanical discipline focal point for commissioning activities within

assigned project scopes.

2. Supervise commissioning foreman, technicians, contractors and vendor

personnel performing mechanical commissioning activities.

3. Ensures tie-ins are completed as per commissioning work pack,

4. Responsible for, but not limited to, all planning, Control of Work, Task

and Operational Risk Assessment, Resources management, Shutdown

windows and approvals, contingencies and recovery time when tie-in to

live system for the scope of work assigned to his team.

5. Plan and coordinate daily commissioning activities in accordance with

approved commissioning schedules and priorities.

6. Ensure commissioning activities are executed in accordance with approved

Commissioning Work Packs (CWPs), procedures, method statements and

engineering documentation.

7. Raise technical queries, in formal technical language, for action by the

discipline focal point.

Mechanical Commissioning Supervisor DP-HR-01141 Rev 1

Information Security Classification: Shared Confidential Page 3 of 5

8. Review commissioning procedures, work packs, test records and

commissioning dossiers.

9. Ensure all commissioning activities are performed safely and in compliance

with Company HSEOI requirements and Permit to Work Procedure.

10. Lead risk assessments for mechanical commissioning work scopes.

11. Take ownership of permit requirements, isolations, ICCs and associated

documentation.

12. Plan and supervise commissioning activities for rotating equipment, pumps,

compressors, gas turbines, valves, pressure relief systems, utility systems,

package equipment, piping systems, mechanical skids and associated

ancillary equipment.

13. Supervise testing, flushing, leak testing, pressure testing, run testing,

vibration monitoring, alignment verification, performance testing, SATs,

integrated testing and start-up activities.

14. Manage commissioning punch lists and coordinate close-out activities.

15. Lead troubleshooting and fault-finding activities associated with rotating

equipment, valves, package equipment, piping systems and mechanical

process equipment.

16. Coordinate and supervise vendor commissioning activities.

17. Interface with Construction, Operations, Maintenance and Engineering

personnel.

18. Accept handover of equipment from Construction and deliver handovers to

Operations for mechanical discipline.

19. Ensure commissioning records, mark-ups and handover documentation are

completed accurately.

20. Provide daily progress updates and technical feedback to the Commissioning

Superintendent.

21. Mentor and develop commissioning foreman technicians.

22. Provide comprehensive shift and end-of-rotation formal written handovers.

23. Complete a face-to-face handover with back-to-back colleague at the end of

rotation.

24. Deputise for the Commissioning Superintendent when required.

25. Participate in PTW audits and champion STAR interventions.

26. Complete the required training for any emergency response duty as directed

by the company. Duties include, but are not limited to, Emergency Response

Team leader and member.

27. Maintain certification as a Performing Authority as required.

28. Drive company vehicles, as directed, to DPE work locations and third-party

sites within the UAE. Comply with company and UAE Authority rules and

procedures for safe driving.

Mechanical Commissioning Supervisor DP-HR-01141 Rev 1

Information Security Classification: Shared Confidential Page 4 of 5

V Communication and Important Working Relationships

Internal Contacts:

Commissioning Superintendent, Commissioning Supervisors, Commissioning

Engineers, Maintenance Supervisors, Construction Supervisors, Operations Shift

Supervisors, Operators, Planners, Control of Work Team.

External Contacts:

Contract foreman and technicians, Field Services Representative (FSRs),

suppliers, support contractors.

VI Knowledge, Skills, Experience and Job-Related Competencies

Educational Qualifications:

 3-year diploma or apprenticeship in Mechanical Engineering

Experience Profile:

 8-10 years' industrial mechanical experience in the oil and gas industry, of which

3 years should be in a supervision or leadership role.

 Experience commissioning rotating equipment including pumps, compressors and

gas turbines.

 Experience commissioning valves, pressure relief devices, package equipment

and mechanical process systems.

 Experience performing flushing, leak testing, pressure testing, alignment

verification, vibration monitoring and performance testing.

 Experience supporting plant start-up activities and commissioning modifications

on live operating oil and gas facilities.

 Strong understanding of mechanical integrity, process safety and commissioning

requirements.

 Conversant with international standards from ASME, API, NACE etc. for

mechanical discipline.

Information Security:

 Employees shall read, understand, and comply with DPE’s Information Security

Policies, Standards, and Procedures.

 Employees shall promptly report any suspected or actual information security

incidents to their respective line manager or the IT department.

 Employees shall protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of DPE’s

information assets.

Competencies/Skills/Others:

 Excellent English Language written and oral communication skills.

 Competent in using Microsoft Office applications, Word, Excel, and Outlook

 Maintain a valid UAE driving license.

 Possess maturity and sound judgement for evaluating risk, providing

recommendations, and making decisions.

  •  Experience in the use of computer-based project completions systems.

Sales Manager

Location: Cameroon

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Sales Manager to lead and accelerate our sales operations in Cameroon. The successful candidate will have extensive experience in heavy machinery, construction equipment, industrial equipment, commercial vehicles, automotive, or related sectors, with a strong understanding of the local market and a proven ability to drive sustainable business growth.

Reporting to senior management, the Sales Manager will be responsible for developing and executing the commercial strategy, leading a high-performing sales team, expanding market share, strengthening customer relationships, and achieving ambitious revenue and profitability objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Business Development

  • Develop and implement the company's sales strategy to achieve revenue, profitability, and market share objectives.
  • Identify new business opportunities across key industries including construction, mining, transport, infrastructure, logistics, manufacturing, and industrial sectors.
  • Expand the company's customer base while strengthening relationships with existing clients.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities.

Sales Leadership

  • Lead, coach, mentor, and develop the sales team to achieve individual and collective performance objectives.
  • Establish clear sales targets, KPIs, and performance management processes.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
  • Organize regular sales training, coaching sessions, and performance reviews.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key accounts, strategic customers, OEMs, distributors, dealers, and business partners.
  • Represent the company during customer meetings, negotiations, industry events, and trade exhibitions.
  • Ensure exceptional customer satisfaction throughout the sales process and after-sales support.

Market Intelligence & Performance Analysis

  • Analyze market dynamics, customer trends, and competitive positioning.
  • Prepare regular sales forecasts, business reports, pipeline analysis, and strategic recommendations.
  • Monitor sales performance against targets and implement corrective actions where necessary.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the after-sales, service, parts, finance, marketing, and operations teams to ensure seamless customer support and successful project delivery.
  • Support pricing strategies, promotional campaigns, and product launches.
  • Contribute to budgeting, forecasting, and annual business planning.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) is considered an advantage.
  • Minimum 15 years of progressive sales experience, including at least 5 years in a senior sales leadership position.
  • Mandatory experience within one or more of the following sectors:Heavy Machinery
  • Construction Equipment
  • Earthmoving Equipment
  • Mining Equipment
  • Industrial Equipment
  • Commercial Vehicles
  • Trucks & Buses
  • Automotive
  • Agricultural Machinery
  • Material Handling Equipment
  • Proven track record of delivering sustained sales growth and managing large commercial portfolios.
  • Strong experience managing key accounts, dealer networks, distributors, or OEM partnerships.
  • Excellent negotiation, leadership, and people management skills.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office; CRM and ERP experience is highly desirable.
  • Fluent in both French and English (written and spoken).

Preferred Industry Background

Candidates with experience gained in companies operating in sectors such as:

  • Heavy Equipment
  • Construction Machinery
  • Mining Equipment
  • Industrial Equipment
  • Commercial Vehicles
  • Automotive Distribution
  • Agricultural Equipment
  • Fleet Solutions
  • Equipment Rental
  • OEM or Dealer Networks

will be particularly valued.

Personal Attributes

  • Inspirational and hands-on leader.
  • Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen.
  • Results-driven with a demonstrated ability to exceed sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Customer-centric approach with excellent relationship-building abilities.
  • Highly organized with strong planning and execution capabilities.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities.
  • Able to thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

Key Success Indicators

  • Achievement of annual sales and profitability targets.
  • Growth in market share and customer portfolio.
  • Expansion into new market segments and strategic accounts.
  • High-performing, engaged, and motivated sales team.
  • Increased customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Effective collaboration across commercial and operational functions.

Summary

The Project Administrator acts as the client's on-site representative, providing administrative, coordination, and operational support to ensure efficient project delivery. Responsibilities

  • Ensure records are accurate and audit-ready.

  • Coordinate logistics, travel, and site access.
  • Maintain a professional, organized work environment.
  • Plan and manage VIP visits, site tours, and official engagements.
  • Prepare itineraries and briefing materials.
  • Ensure high standards of protocol, presentation, and confidentiality.
  • Assist with requisitions, purchase orders, and vendor coordination.
  • Track procurement activities and deliveries.
  • Support invoice verification and payment processes.
  • Maintain accurate financial records.
  • Support reporting on progress, schedule, and key metrics.
  • Ensure compliance with project procedures and policies.
  • Assist audits and project close-out documentation.

Qualifications

  • Degree/Diploma in Business, Project Management, Construction, or related field.
  • 3—5 years of project administration experience (construction preferred).
  • Familiarity with document control systems and scheduling tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera).
  • Proficiency in MS Office and project systems (e.g., Procore, SAP, Aconex).

Job Purpose

Provide Information Management (IM) knowledge across business units in policy, process, people and technology. Support the implementation of Information Management strategies, ensuring compliance with standards and procedures while enabling modern, secure ways of working. The role is responsible for managing both electronic and physical records, ensuring proper information lifecycle management, and supporting governance across enterprise platforms. The position also includes physical archive and records handling activities, including warehouse visits and archival operations 

Key Result Areas (Key Accountabilities)

1. Understand challenges related to Records Management in the organisation and participate in setting and delivering enterprise-wide Information Management strategies and framework for managing the company’s electronic and physical information and aligning core business activities to ensure regulatory compliance.

2. Drive initiatives required to make improvements to Records and Information Management and defining target maturity level; developing an initiative roadmap with timelines and responsibilities; and developing the business case for implementation of the Strategy.

3. Support digital and automation initiatives and provide specialist advice on Information Management, including advice on and promotion of collaborative work and assessment and management of information-related risk.

4. Drive IM automation to increase efficiency in data flow both internally and externally to partners and contractors and establish paperless environment whilst maintaining quality and control.

5. Conduct compliance audits to ensure Information Management processes are applied by all functional departments ofcompany; conduct current state assessment, provide recommendations and support implementation plan to achieve compliance with policies and improve efficiency and productivity.

6. Ensure users are in compliance with Information Management policies and procedures when managing Information.

Experience Profile:

  • 7+ years of Information Management experience in a similar sized orgnization.
  • User adoption and Change Management experience.
  • Experience in both electronic and physical records management
  • Defining and Managing Information and Data Governance.
  • Customer Service Delivery experience. Document and Information Management Systems experience.

Package Control Lead"},"description":{"0":"

Position Summary

The Onshore Package Control Lead is responsible for planning, coordinating, supervising, and controlling all project control activities within the assigned onshore package, ensuring successful delivery of major EPC/EPSCC projects in accordance with company procedures, industry best practices, contractual obligations, and HSE requirements.

The role provides leadership across project controls disciplines, including contracts administration, cost control, planning and scheduling, document control, reporting, and change management while coordinating multiple contracts and interfaces throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Project Controls & Coordination

  • Lead and coordinate all project control activities within the onshore package.
  • Provide cross-functional coordination with Project Controls, Contracts, Procurement, Planning, Cost Control, and Document Control teams.
  • Coordinate the execution of multiple contracts, including the main EPSCC contract and supporting local contracts.
  • Support the mobilization and demobilization of project personnel and oversee manpower planning activities.

Cost Management

  • Support the preparation, review, and periodic revision of package budgets and long-term forecasts.
  • Monitor project expenditures and cost performance throughout execution.
  • Identify cost deviations and recommend corrective actions to maintain budget objectives.
  • Ensure robust cost control systems and reporting processes are implemented and maintained.

Planning & Scheduling

  • Coordinate the development, maintenance, and optimization of integrated project schedules.
  • Monitor project progress against approved baselines.
  • Review contractor schedules and performance, identifying risks and recovery opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate progress measurement and timely reporting.

Contract Administration & Change Management

  • Manage post-award contract administration through project close-out.
  • Monitor contractual compliance and ensure proper administration of contract obligations.
  • Review contractor claims, variation orders, change requests, and instructions.
  • Assess commercial impacts on cost and schedule and maintain accurate change logs.
  • Support contract negotiations and dispute resolution when required.

Progress & Invoice Verification

  • Review contractor progress reports and validate completed work.
  • Verify contractor invoices against contractual requirements and approved progress.
  • Ensure timely certification and payment processes.

Risk Management

  • Monitor contractor risk registers and facilitate regular risk review meetings.
  • Track mitigation actions and ensure effective implementation of risk management plans.
  • Escalate significant project risks impacting cost, schedule, or project objectives.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare and coordinate regular project control reports for management.
  • Ensure accurate, timely, and high-quality reporting across all project control disciplines.
  • Coordinate document control activities, including document review cycles and Master Document Register (MDR) management.
  • Support internal audits and project assurance reviews.
  • Capture lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

HSE Responsibilities

  • Comply with all Health, Safety, Security, and Environmental (HSSE) policies, procedures, and management system requirements.
  • Promote a strong safety culture across all project activities.
  • Ensure safe working practices are followed by project personnel and contractors.
  • Report unsafe conditions, incidents, anomalies, and near misses.
  • Participate in safety meetings, toolbox talks, emergency drills, and training programs.
  • Exercise Stop Work Authority whenever there is an actual or potential threat to personnel, facilities, or the environment.

Project Environment

The role supports the delivery of a large-scale onshore oil and gas development package that includes:

  • Gas treatment and processing facilities.
  • Utilities, buildings, and permanent accommodation facilities.
  • Multiple onshore pipelines with complex crossings.

Contexte

Dans le cadre d’un projet de « Contrôle et surveillance des travaux de réhabilitation et de modernisation des infrastructures électriques de Bujumbura densification, électrification des quartiers périphériques de Bujumbura et renforcement du réseau MT 30 kV dans tout le pays « Marché Principal », le Client souhaite s'adjoindre les services de 2 prestataires expérimentés comme Expert en sauvegarde environnement et social pour l’assister dans la gestion du projet

 Description de la mission

La mission de chaque expert en sauvegarde environnementale et sociale consiste en ce qui suit :

 1.      En phase préconstruction :

· Recueil et analyse des études d’avant-projet relatives aux volets environnemental et social : EIES et PAR.

·        Vérification sur site de la qualité des bases de données pour les estimations des EIES et PAR

·        Actualisation et chiffrage des EIES et des PAR des lots 2, 3, 4 et 5.

·        Coordination avec les experts techniques pour la validation des tracés des réseaux HTA et BT.

·        Rédaction intégrale des 2 PGES pour le lot 5 d’une part et les lots 2, 3, 4 d’autre part

·        Contribution à la rédaction des rapports préliminaires.

·        Contribution à la rédaction des pièces écrites des DAO au format Banque mondiale

·        Contribution à la réponse aux demandes de clarification en phase de lancement des DAO

·        Contribution à l’évaluation technique des offres pour la réalisation et la rédaction du rapport d’évaluation des offres.

2.      En phase construction :

·        Vérification et approbation des PGES du chantier produits par les entreprises.

·        Suivi et supervision de la mise en place des mesures de sauvegarde environnementales et sociales sur site.

·        Rédaction du volet de suivi environnemental et social dans les rapports contractuels : mensuels, trimestriels et thématiques.

·        Assure les visites d’inspection périodiques de chaque chantier en cours.

·        Vérification du respect de l’exécution des mesures du PAR et de l’intermédiation sociale pendant la réalisation du chantier.

·        Appuyer l’ensemble des équipes pour le reporting des incidents et des points d’alerte E&S relevés sur site.

·        Participation à la gestion des accidents sur le périmètre des projets.

·        Suivi qualitatif et financier des enveloppes du PAR et sa cohérence avec la liste du PAP : Personnes Affectées par le Projet.

 3.      Tâches transverses :

·        Contribuer à la rédaction des livrables et des rapports contractuels du projet.

·        Renseigner les fiches de contrôle au format.

·        Participer aux réunions d’équipe, aux réunions de chantier et aux réunions client à la demande du chef de mission.

·        Participer aux visites et inspections de terrain.

·        Gestion de la communication avec les entreprises exécutantes sur les volets E&S.

·        Renseigner les fiches de temps du projet.

Start Up Support Senior Production Well Pads Services (Day/Night)

CFT reference

CFT-TILENGA-TEPU-UPST-249

Frame contract reference

PRD-OP-03

Number of submissions

6 Dimension There is no equivalent project of such an industrial drilling magnitude in a remote and sensitive area within the Company today. The Tilenga oilfields are partly situated in a protected National Park, partly beneath the river Nile wetlands area, and within densely populated area in a rural and remote part of Uganda. Activities exposed to the risk of major incidents with severe potential consequences due to local environment and important presence of NGO’s. Factory Drilling with a well delivered every 4 days using 3 drilling rigs simultaneously will necessitate standardization of equipment and procedures, strict enforcement of Drilling & Well instructions, safe and efficient logistic management on site. The project is focused on delivering the lowest possible cost, which requires challenging TotalEnergies design concepts as well as substantially challenging the TotalEnergies referential. Heavy and waxy oils will be produced from 29 well pads, (with 9 located in a national park) and treated in a Production Center of 200,000bopd oil capacity and 650,000 bwpd of water treatment capacity. Reservoir pressure maintenance is ensured either by water injection and by polymer water injection depending on the reservoir’s characteristics. The project also includes an extended interconnecting network with temperature preservation. LPG extraction, storage and tankers loading facilities are part of the CPF facilities. Multicultural environment Ugandan rules and regulations, administrative requirements and technical authorizations as well as international codes for onshore plant will apply. Due to staggered development on CPF, it is expected that SIMOPS (Operations vs Construction), will occur on CPF. Reporting line in organization SU Support Supv / Production Supervisor(s) (Well Pad Activities Main Activities

• Well pad start-up preparation: Prepare detailed procedures to cover all steps of the start-up sequence. Prepare Pre-Start-Up Check lists.

• During commissioning phase :

• Attend Operational Tests Procedures. Contribute to troubleshooting during the same. Contribute to punch listing. Follow up on punch list clearance.

• Coordinate with OJT coordinator and trainers and take actively part in On Job Training Sessions with trainees / future junior operators, involving them in all preparation tasks. Contribute to evaluation of competencies of trainees to identify gap and requirement for further training.

• Ensure trainees become familiar with procedures and routine operations. Train them on specific operations (Cellar CSE, pigging …).

• Prepare system for first start-up after Handover. Carry out line-walks of CPF as per procedures ensuring systems are safe to start.

• Well systems start-up:

• Lead the activities on field during start-up phase, with assistance from Junior operators, ensuring strict adherence to procedures.

• Report about any abnormal conditions during start-up and act immediately to keep process safe and under proper conditions.

• Well operation and performance and ESP (ESCPC): Operate wells and ESP (ESCPC) safely and efficiently. Understand processes in the well regarding flowing, wax and sand sedimentation, gas and water flows and others. Be able to calculate general parameters and estimate correctness of well operations. Troubleshoot in field and arc immediately as soon as abnormalize identified. Ensure optimized operation implementing adjustments under direction of the Production Supervisor and engineering team.

• Well work and start-up operations: Prepare well for well interventions such as slick line, wire line, coiled tubing and work over operations. Take part in well handover process. Carry out line-walks of pad as per procedures ensuring wells and pads are safe to restart. Start process in first oil and after shutdowns. Perform well start-up and clean-up after drilling and work over as same as after dewaxing and others well interventions from in-field side. Assist CRO with monitoring and adjustment operation parameters start-up of the wells for defined pads. Report about any abnormalize during start-up and act immediately to keep process safely and proper conditions.

• Well pad operation: Operate equipment on well pads and lake water including pumps, compressors, chemical injection packages and others. Report and correct all identified deviations in collaboration with the team. Directs truck operations on site such as steam truck and vacuum etc. Perform all other tasks related to his field of production activities on request of Production Supervisor.

• Critical operations including pigging: Be sure all operation implemented safely with all required documentation with sufficient approvals. Perform the operation strictly following instructions and procedures and request changes as soon as it is required following management of change procedure. Train junior operators on this critical task.

• Emergency and safety: Be fully aware of the Emergency Response Plans and act as ERT member as assigned. Ensure all operations are performing safely, stop any unsafe operations and report to the supervisor. Be sure that the system works properly and safely. Understand all safety equipment in operations and operate it in case of process safety incidents including integrity failure.

• PTW: Act as an operation and isolating authority and on site for PTW system. Prepare isolation certificates according to work management system. Lead operations and make sure all operations are in compliance with safety and regulatory standards. All control measures are sufficient and implemented in place. Perform all isolations and zero energy confirmation procedures mentioned in PTW and isolation certificate. Perform gas testing for PTW

• Maintenance: Perform maintenance L1 and L2. Prepare equipment for intervening maintenance and lead the operations. Take part in solving the problem from the operation side. Be sure all equipment is properly maintained on time and ready for operation.

• Routing operations: Regularly daily safety and process rounds, sampling, monitoring, in-filed observation, housekeeping and other routing activities on well pad and water lake station. Check on a regular basis chemical injection efficiency and rates. Ensure all operations are performed on time and according to planning.

• Lessons Learned System: Participate in Lesson Learned System. Register new events properly with corrective mitigations.

• Notifications: Identify unnormal behavior of operating equipment and prepare notifications for MNT. Keep informed Prod SPV. Also, offer new solutions for the operation and process, get information for request for modification.

• Reporting and documentation: Prepare and provide regular in-field production reports regarding well pads, wells operation and equipment and water lake station in time and precisely. Carry out precisely all operation on site in a logbook. Participate in the update of PI&D’s and other operational documents as required

• Clear communication: Work closely with team. Keep CRO, Prod SPV and others informed of operation on site as required. Ensure good quality and accurate shift and rotation handovers are compiled and communicated with B2B. Ensure LO/LC Valves, LTI’s, disturbed hydrocarbon lines register is updated as required

• Leadership: Act as an owner of installation for coworkers and contractors. Be involved in operations on site and take active participation as for normal operation as for troubleshooting in field. Be an example for others on the side in terms of safety. Act as a technical leader on site for site operators focusing on in-field newcomers and share information you have with colleagues. Context and environment

The Tilenga oilfields are partly situated in a protected National Park, partly beneath the river Nile wetlands area, and within densely populated area in a rural and remote part of Uganda. Activities exposed to the risk of major incidents with severe potential consequences due to local environment and important presence of NGO’s.

Factory Drilling with a well delivered every 4 days using 3 drilling rigs simultaneously will necessitate standardization of equipment and procedures, strict enforcement of Drilling & Well instructions, safe and efficient logistic management on site. The project is focused on delivering the lowest possible cost, which requires challenging TotalEnergies design concepts as well as substantially challenging the TotalEnergies referential.

Multicultural environment: Contractors/subcontractors are anticipated to be located in various parts of the world. Ugandan rules and regulations, administrative requirements and technical authorizations as well as international codes for onshore plant will apply.

Accountabilities

Prepare start-up procedures. Prepare systems for start-up.

• Starting up the well pad safely

• Sharing experience with new-comers

• Safe and strict compliance with work management systems and operational procedures.

• Keep process ongoing safe and act immediately in case of emergency.

• Monitor personnel, equipment, and ongoing activities in the whole site with focus on HSE aspects of working teams.

• Minimize short falls for production and injection.

• Keep reporting up to date.

• Clear communication regarding process and safety in condition of shifts and rotations.

• Operating and isolating authority onsite and certified gas tester duty.

• Ensure a safe and efficient restart of equipment after shutdown.

• Member of the ERT acting in multiple roles depending on specific training completion (FiFi, Rescue, Stretcher Team, Confine Space Rescue, etc.).. Qualifications/Experience required

• Diploma of Higher Education or BTCE. Education on operational safety, production operations, well operations

• Minimum Professional experience > 7 years, and 2 years in similar position

• Ability to use sound rational judgement in decision-making.

• Familiar with DCS

• Familiar with MC Office

• Good knowledge of TotalEnergies HSE Safety Rules, SIMOPS, PTW System, or equivalent in Oil & Gas industry.

• Ability to work under pressure and stressful conditions.

• Ability to use Breathing Apparatus – Cascade and / or Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus

• Adaptability and ability to work in an international environment.

• Good communication skills. Clear and concise reporting both verbal and written,

• Fluent in English (>3.5).

• Valid medical certificate per company standards.

Reservoir pressure maintenance is ensured either by water injection and by polymer water injection depending on the reservoir’s characteristics. The project also includes an extended interconnecting network with temperature preservation. LPG extraction, storage and tankers loading facilities are part of the CPF facilities. Multicultural environment Ugandan rules and regulations, administrative requirements and technical authorizations as well as international codes for onshore plant will apply. The Tilenga oilfields are partly situated in a protected National Park, partly beneath the river Nile wetlands area, and within densely populated area in a rural and remote part of Uganda. Activities exposed to the risk of major incidents with severe potential consequences due to local environment and important presence of NGO’s.

•\tImplement store policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with company standards.

•\tDrive sales by providing exceptional customer service, promoting products, and upselling when appropriate.

•\tAnalyze sales data to identify trends, customer preferences, and areas for improvement.

3. Customer Service :

•\tEnsure a high standard of customer service is maintained at all times by training and supervising staff.

•\tAddress customer complaints, concerns, and returns in a professional and timely manner.

•\tCreate a welcoming and customer-friendly store environment, focusing on a positive shopping experience.

4. Staff Management and Development:

•\tRecruit, train, and onboard new store employees, ensuring they understand company policies and product knowledge.

•\tProvide ongoing coaching, training, and development to improve team performance.

•\tSchedule shifts and manage labor costs to ensure staffing levels are optimal for peak periods and store needs.

•\tConduct performance reviews, set goals, and provide feedback to team members.

5. Inventory and Merchandising :

•\tMaintain accurate inventory levels and manage stock rotation to reduce shrinkage and improve stock turnover.

•\tOversee visual merchandising, ensuring displays are attractive and align with company standards.

•\tCollaborate with the merchandising team to implement promotions and seasonal displays.

•\tEnsure all products are tagged, priced, and labeled correctly according to company standards.

6. Financial Management :

•\tPrepare and manage the store's budget, including controlling operating costs and maximizing profitability.

•\tTrack and report on store expenses, sales figures, and other financial metrics.

•\tImplement cost-saving initiatives without compromising customer experience or store operations.

7. Health, Safety, and Compliance :

•\tEnsure the store complies with all health, safety, and regulatory requirements, including fire safety and sanitation standards.

•\tMonitor store conditions and ensure it remains clean, organized, and safe for both employees and customers.

•\tConduct regular stock audits to minimize shrinkage and ensure inventory accuracy.

8. Marketing and Promotion :

•\tWork with marketing teams to implement local marketing strategies, promotions, and loyalty programs.

•\tPromote in-store events and new product launches to drive foot traffic and sales. •\tMonitor the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and promotions, adjusting strategies as needed.

9. Technology and Systems :

•\tUse point-of-sale (POS) systems to manage sales, process transactions, and track customer data.

•\tEnsure all team members are trained on the POS system and any other relevant software/tools.

•\tAnalyze sales and inventory data through store management software to identify opportunities for improvement.

10. Reporting :

•\tPrepare regular reports on sales performance, inventory levels, staffing, and customer satisfaction.

•\tReport to senior management on store progress, challenges, and achievements.

•\tUtilize sales and customer feedback data to adjust strategies and improve store performance.

  • Fluent French & English
  • Must Have Retail Experience

Maintenance & Inspection (M&I) Campaign Coordinator

CFT reference

CFT-TILENGA-TEPU-UPST-230

Frame contract reference

MIN-M-SV-00

Number of submissions

3

Reporting line in organization

Maintenance & Inspection Superintendent

Activities

M&I Planner & Campaign Coordinator responsible for:

M&I activity planning:

 Participate in the daily review meeting of SAP (UNISOL) notifications.

 Prepare and organize the intervention schedule based on UNISOL planning, task priority, and material availability.

 Supervise the preparation and readiness of upcoming M&I activities in close coordination with trade supervisors (SPVs).

 Report progress and highlight blocking points to the M&I Superintendent.

 Monitor M&I KPIs to ensure optimal organizational efficiency and identify potential deviations.

 Act as the site focal point for CMIMS coordination, under the supervision of the M&I Superintendent.

 Ensure synergy and alignment between maintenance and inspection activities.

Wellpads campaign coordination:

 Prepare and organize the intervention schedule for well pad campaigns, based on UNISOL planning, priorities, and material readiness.

 Pay particular attention to critical equipment such as AGC units, ESP VSDs, MPFMs, and Fired Heaters, GTG Packages

 Identify and escalate any constraints or missing materials that could impact campaign efficiency.

OPERATIONS.

Reporting to the M&I Superintendent, the M&I Planner & Campaign Coordinator is responsible for planning, organizing, and coordinating preventive maintenance and inspection activities across CPF (Central Processing Facilities) and wellpad facilities.

The role ensures operational readiness (PTW, Ressources, tools, spare parts,etc), campaign efficiency, and data integrity through CMIMS (SAP/UNISOL) systems.

Context and environment

There is no equivalent project of such an industrial drilling magnitude in a remote and sensitive area within the Group today.

The Tilenga oilfields are partly situated in a protected National Park, partly beneath the river Nile wetlands area, and within densely populated area in a rural and remote part of Uganda. Activities exposed to the risk of major incidents with severe potential consequences due to local environment and important presence of NGOs. Factory Drilling with a well delivered every 4 days using 3 drilling rigs simultaneously will necessitate standardization of equipment and procedures, strict enforcement of Drilling & Well instructions, safe and efficient logistic management on site. The project is focused on delivering the lowest possible cost, which requires challenging TOTAL design concepts as well as substantially challenging the TOTAL referential.

Multicultural environment: Contractors are anticipated to be in various parts of the world. Ugandan rules and regulations, administrative requirements and technical authorizations as well as international codes for onshore plant will apply.

The project FID was signed on Q1-2022 with a start of drilling operations on Q2 2022 and a Ready for Start-up (RFSU) target of July 2026.

Accountabilities

 M&I CPF & Wellpads Preventive activities schedule issuance

 CMIMS reporting and Notification/Work order tracking and close follow up

 Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and lessons learned.

 Assist in the training and onboarding of new planners or supervisors on CMIMS and planning protocols.

Qualifications/Experience required

Qualification: Minimum HND / associate degree or equivalent in industrial maintenance, engineering, or related field

Experience:

 Minimum 5 years as a planner or campaign coordinator in similar industrial environments (FPSO, O&G plant).

 Strong command of SAP CMIMS and planning tools.

 Proficiency in Office 365 suite.

 Familiarity with TotalEnergies HSE policies is a plus.

L’évolution rapide des technologies numériques et de l’intelligence artificielle (IA) constitue une opportunité majeure pour renforcer la gouvernance, accélérer le développement économique et améliorer la prestation des services publics. Le Togo se positionne à l’avant-garde de cette transformation en déployant une stratégie ambitieuse de transformation numérique visant à moderniser les secteurs clés, renforcer les infrastructures numériques et établir le pays comme un hub régional de l’innovation et de l’entrepreneuriat.

À travers un accompagnement stratégique, une exécution ciblée et une mobilisation des acteurs clés, ce travail vise à traduire des ambitions audacieuses en solutions évolutives et à fort impact, garantissant des bénéfices durables pour les citoyens. L’objectif est d’accélérer l’adoption d’initiatives numériques transformatrices, de renforcer les capacités institutionnelles et d’assurer le leadership du Togo dans l’économie numérique africaine.

 Résumé du Poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Conseiller(e) Principal(e), Transformation Digitale & Technologique, doté(e) d’une vision stratégique et d’une expertise technique approfondie, afin d’offrir un accompagnement stratégique et technique de haut niveau au Gouvernement du Togo. Ce rôle clé vise à façonner et accélérer la transformation numérique du pays en intégrant l’intelligence artificielle (IA), les technologies émergentes et l’innovation fondée sur les données pour moderniser les secteurs clés.

En tant que partenaire de confiance du gouvernement, le/la Conseiller(e) Principal(e) pilotera l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre de stratégies numériques d’envergure, garantissant leur alignement sur les priorités nationales et leur conformité aux référentiels internationaux. Une expertise approfondie en gouvernance numérique, politique de l’IA et adoption des technologies par le secteur public sera essentielle pour assurer la pertinence et la pérennité des réformes.

Opérant au plus haut niveau gouvernemental, le/la Conseiller(e) Principal(e) jouera un rôle de catalyseur de collaboration, en mobilisant une expertise intersectorielle pour le développement des politiques, l’exécution stratégique et la structuration de l’écosystème numérique. Il/elle travaillera en étroite coordination avec les institutions gouvernementales, le secteur privé et les partenaires de développement pour renforcer la gouvernance numérique, attirer les investissements et positionner le Togo comme un hub d’innovation technologique.

Ce poste à fort impact et à haute responsabilité représente une opportunité unique de concilier stratégie et exécution, en traduisant les ambitions numériques du Togo en progrès concrets, évolutifs et mesurables, bénéficiant à l’administration, aux entreprises et à la société dans son ensemble.

Ce poste est proposé sous contrat de 24 mois, renouvelable en fonction de la performance et de la disponibilité de financement. Basé à Lomé, Togo, il est ouvert aux candidats locaux et internationaux, avec un accompagnement à la relocalisation pour ceux basés à l'étranger.

 Responsabilités Clés

·       Conseiller les hauts responsables gouvernementaux sur la transformation numérique, la gouvernance de l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et les technologies émergentes.

·       Piloter des initiatives numériques favorisant la croissance économique et l’amélioration des services publics.

·       Développer et renforcer les partenariats nécessaires à la réussite de ces initiatives : administrations publiques, secteur privé, partenaires au développement, bailleurs de fonds et écosystème technologique au sens large.

·       Traduire les tendances mondiales en matière d’IA et d’économie numérique en recommandations stratégiques exploitables par les décideurs.

·       Assurer le suivi des performances des politiques publiques et identifier les ajustements nécessaires.

·       Accompagner et encadrer les équipes gouvernementales tout en favorisant une culture de l’innovation et de la prise de décision fondée sur les données probantes.

 Profil Recherché

  • Au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans le conseil stratégique, la transformation numérique du secteur public ou la direction de programmes technologiques complexes (une expérience dans le secteur public est indispensable).
  • Diplôme de niveau Master en administration des affaires, administration publique, politiques technologiques, gouvernance numérique, intelligence artificielle, science des données ou domaine équivalent.
  • Expérience avérée dans le conseil auprès de hauts dirigeants gouvernementaux sur les questions de transformation numérique, de politiques relatives à l’IA et de gouvernance des données, avec des réalisations concrètes à l’appui.
  • Expérience pratique dans la conception, le déploiement ou la gestion de solutions technologiques à grande échelle.
  • Bonne maîtrise des enjeux éthiques, réglementaires et de gouvernance liés à l’intelligence artificielle.
  • Excellentes compétences en diplomatie, négociation et gestion des parties prenantes.
  • Maîtrise courante du français et de l’anglais, avec une aisance à évoluer aussi bien dans un environnement ministériel, en conseil d’administration que lors de sommets internationaux.
