Résumé du poste

Le Chef de projet est responsable de la gestion quotidienne des activités de construction sur un ou plusieurs chantiers, en veillant à l’exécution conformément aux exigences de périmètre, de délai, de budget, de qualité et de sécurité. Le rôle est centré sur la coordination des activités de construction par spécialité (ex. : génie civil, structure, CVC/plomberie/électricité, finitions). Il implique une planification détaillée, la supervision des opérations sur site, la coordination des sous-traitants et la résolution générale des problèmes afin de garantir le bon déroulement du projet. Le Chef de projet assure l’exécution du plan de travail du projet, le contrôle qualité et le reporting d’avancement, tout en contribuant à la logistique, au suivi des coûts et à la mobilisation des parties prenantes, avec le soutien du Directeur de projet et/ou du Directeur de production.

Responsabilités principales

1. Exécution sur site et planification

  • Gérer les activités quotidiennes de construction sur site, en garantissant la conformité avec les spécifications de conception, le délai, le budget, la qualité et les normes de sécurité.
  • Élaborer et maintenir le calendrier détaillé des travaux, en suivant l’avancement et en traitant de manière proactive les retards.
  • Superviser les infrastructures et la logistique sur site, y compris l’implantation, les accès, les réseaux et le stockage, afin de soutenir des opérations sûres et efficaces.

2. Coordination des sous-traitants et des équipes

  • Superviser les sous-traitants, les équipes du site et les activités de construction par spécialité, en garantissant le respect des objectifs de productivité, de budget, de qualité et de sécurité.
  • Coordonner la résolution des demandes techniques, des clarifications et des modifications de conception en collaboration avec le Directeur de projet et/ou le Directeur de production et les équipes d’ingénierie.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes RH et administratives pour maintenir la discipline sur site, l’assiduité et la coordination de la main-d’œuvre.

3. Contrôle du budget et des coûts

  • Suivre l’utilisation du budget et les dépenses du site, en signalant au Directeur de projet et/ou au Directeur de production les risques de coûts, les variations et les impacts financiers potentiels.
  • Contribuer aux stratégies et tactiques d’optimisation des coûts définies conjointement avec le Directeur de projet et/ou le Directeur de production.

4. Reporting et communication

  • Préparer et soumettre des rapports d’avancement réguliers au Directeur de projet et/ou au Directeur de production, conformément aux procédures établies par l’entreprise.
  • Remonter au Directeur de projet et/ou au Directeur de production les problèmes du projet qui s’écartent significativement du plan pour obtenir soutien et résolution.
  • Définir, avec le Directeur de projet et/ou le Directeur de production, les stratégies visant à optimiser la performance des activités de production.
  • Soutenir le Directeur de projet et/ou le Directeur de production dans les communications externes avec les clients, les autorités et les parties prenantes locales lorsque cela est nécessaire.

5. Gestion des modifications et soutien aux achats

  • Assister, le cas échéant, à la préparation, à l’examen et à la négociation des avenants, réclamations et travaux supplémentaires.
  • Suivre l’état d’avancement des achats, les articles à délai de livraison long et les matériaux critiques, en coordination avec les équipes d’approvisionnement et les équipes du site.

6. Qualité, HSE et conformité

  • Imposer le respect total des politiques et procédures HSE sur le site.
  • S’assurer que la documentation du site est précise et à jour, y compris les rapports d’avancement, les registres d’inspection, les permis et les pointages.
  • Diriger et animer des réunions de coordination régulières avec les contractants et les équipes internes pour examiner l’état d’avancement, traiter les risques et garantir l’alignement.

Pour les besoins du recrutement

Qualifications requises

  • Diplôme de niveau Baccalauréat en génie civil, gestion de la construction ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Minimum 7 à 10 ans d’expérience dans des postes de gestion de projet de construction.
  • Capacité avérée à diriger des équipes pluridisciplinaires et à gérer des sous-traitants.
  • Expérience démontrée en planification logistique de chantier, contrôle budgétaire et gestion de calendrier.
  • Maîtrise de l’anglais et de la langue locale du site du projet.

Compétences clés

  • Planification de l’exécution et coordination quotidienne des travaux.
  • Résolution technique de problèmes et interprétation des conceptions.
  • Contrôle des coûts et suivi des ressources.
  • Application des règles HSE et excellence opérationnelle.
  • Communication claire et mobilisation des parties prenantes.
  • Supervision d’équipe et résolution de problèmes en temps réel sous pression.

Environnement de travail

  • Basé à temps plein sur le ou les chantiers, nécessitant une présence quotidienne sur le terrain.
  • Supervision directe des sous-traitants, des ouvriers et de l’équipe interne de construction.
  • Interactions régulières avec les équipes d’approvisionnement, d’ingénierie, HSE et administratives.
  • Évolue dans des environnements de projet dynamiques et intenses, en particulier lors des étapes critiques et des inspections.

  • Attentive and service focused.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and English.

Vacancy - Field Construction Superintendent (Utilities)

Location: Mozambique

Planned start date: Sep 2026

Duration: 6 months to 1 YEAR

DEADLINE: 1st July 2026

Qualifications/Experience required

• Degree in Engineering or another relevant subject required with either an advanced degree or professional qualifications preferred.

• Extensive Industry Experience: Minimum 15 years of relevant industry experience, with at least 5 years in a superintendent or equivalent leadership role overseeing multidisciplinary teams on large-scale projects.

• Project Type Experience: Minimum 10 years’ experience on greenfield projects. Experience in LNG liquefaction (preferred), petrochemical, refinery, or gas processing/feedstock plants, and pipelines is essential.

• Comprehensive Project Knowledge: Full understanding of areas critical to the success of large, complex projects—including safety, environmental management, work organization, scheduling, quality management, organizational competency, and reputational risk mitigation.

• Leadership and Safety Culture: Demonstrated strong HSE culture and safety leadership. Proven ability to lead by example and foster a culture of safety and continuous improvement.

• Communication and Decision-Making Skills: Effective communication and leadership skills, with the capability to influence critical decisions and foster collaboration among diverse teams.

• Language Proficiency: Strong English written and verbal communication skills required. Proficiency in Portuguese or French is advantageous.

• Regulatory and Standards Knowledge: In-depth understanding of international and construction codes, standards, and regulations (e.g., API, ASME, ISO, NFPA).

• SIMOPS Experience: Demonstrated experience managing SIMOPS (Simultaneous Operations) and complex commissioning transitions.

• Documentation and Handover: Experience ensuring proper documentation, as-built records, and smooth handover of completed work packages to operations and commissioning teams.

Responsibilities:

• Lead by example to foster a culture of safety within both Client and EPC Contractor teams, demonstrating a thorough understanding of HSE principles.

• Ensure full compliance with all applicable Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) requirements throughout all work activities, promoting a safe and healthy work environment.

• Support the Area Manager in all delegated responsibilities pertaining to the Pipeline and Utilities team.

• Ensure the team consistently meets performance standards and fulfils all corporate requirements.

• Promote team spirit, encourage collaboration, and build trust among team members.

• Immediately report or communicate any incidents occurring within the assigned area.

• Monitor all construction activities within the area in accordance with project requirements and construction procedures, through to final system handover to the Commissioning team, with a particular focus on Company responsibilities.

• Cultivate strong working relationships with the EPC Contractor for daily management and effective resolution of critical issues.

• Facilitate the development and review of execution plans, method statements, and other relevant procedures to ensure alignment with project strategies and the safe, high-quality, and timely completion of works.

• Maintain a visible presence on site to visibly demonstrate commitment to safety, quality, and construction oversight, enabling direct contact with Contractor and Subcontractor teams.

• Review EPC Contractor construction progress, provide input to internal construction reporting systems, identify schedule deviations or risks, and propose appropriate mitigation measures to management and the EPC Contractor.

• Support management by supplying input and coordination for overall site management within the area of responsibility.

• Assess current and anticipated issues, identify potential risks using technical expertise and experience, and propose or influence technical and organizational solutions, including the integration of lessons learned and best practices.

• Oversee the physical execution of all phases, including precommissioning and the transition to commissioning activities, including during SIMOPS (Simultaneous Operations).

• Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of the EPC Contractor’s construction management processes.

• Attend all necessary construction planning meetings to ensure thorough follow-up on issues and action resolutions.

• Coordinate with quality department to oversee quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) processes to guarantee that all works meet the required standards and specifications.

• Support the planning and execution of site emergency drills and participate in incident investigations as required.

• Ensure proper documentation and handover of completed work packages and as-built records to the operations/commissioning teams.

• Promote continuous improvement by encouraging feedback and innovation within the team and among contractor personnel.

Position: Senior Well Site Geologist

Start date:

- 1st position: end September 2026

- 2nd position: end October 2026

Duration: 12 month

Location: mainly on rig offshore in Namibia, but not limited, with potential stays in Windhoek, Luderitz or Walvis Bay.

Regime: rotational 4 x 4 weeks, with option to extend / adjust if requested by COMPANY. To work all consecutive days (week days, weekends, public holidays).

Educational Qualifications / certified for:

 GEOSCIENCE diploma: BTS (BAC+2) geology orientation or higher (with relevant experience in Operations Geology)

 Subsurface Geology for Operations Geologist and Well Site Geologist certificate from I.F.P (INSTITUT FRANCAIS DU PETROL)

 BOSIET, including EBS (emergency breathing system)

 Offshore medical certificate

 Language: English: Advanced-Proficient, mandatory.

Experience:

 Minimum 10 YEARS in the position of senior well site geologist

 IN WELL TYPES as: EXPLORATION AND APPRAISAL, DEEP OFFSHORE, VERTICAL AND DEVIATED, SIDETRACKS, HIGH TEMPERATURE-PRESSURE WELLS.

 IN OPERATIONS as: logging while drilling, coring, extensive wire line acquisition (Open hole: conventional logs, imagery, magnetic resonance, rotary side wall cores, pressure points-sampling-IPTT, vertical seismic profile. Cased hole: cement evaluation), DST, side track, plug & abandon.

Required skills & competencies:

 Specific industry software:

o GRAVITAS, Gemstone, SQMT

 Technical skills:

o Strong geology fundamentals: Sedimentology, stratigraphy, structural geology

o Formation evaluation & petrophysics understanding

o Real-time data quality control, interpretation and integration (cuttings, gas, logs, pressures, gains-losses, depth control, lag time, efficiency of equipment’s)

o Deep knowledge of:

 Drilling operations

 Mud logging

 Logging technologies (LWD/WL)

 Coring

 Not deep but very involved: Fluid systems (mud, cement, brine)

 Operational and offshore specific skills

o Ability to work under pressure in 24/7 drilling environments

o Strong understanding of:

 Well delivery process

 Offshore logistics & constraints

o High adaptability to remote, harsh offshore conditions

 Analytical, decision-making and soft skills

o Rapid interpretation and decision-making in real time

o Strong risk assessment capability

o Ability to integrate multiple data sets quickly

o Soft skills: attention to detail, problem solving mindset, strong organization and reporting discipline

o Fully comply to the Code of conduct and HSE policies, rules and procedures of the company.

 Communication and leadership

Intitulé : Directeur / Directrice des Opérations

Rattachement hiérarchique : Direction Générale

Notre client, acteur majeur du secteur de l'énergie et de la distribution de produits stratégiques, recherche un(e) Directeur(trice) des Opérations pour piloter l'ensemble de ses activités opérationnelles.

Le poste couvre la supervision des opérations industrielles, de la logistique, de la maintenance des infrastructures, de la sécurité des opérations ainsi que l'amélioration continue de la performance sur plusieurs sites d'exploitation.

Le titulaire du poste aura pour mission de garantir l'excellence opérationnelle, la conformité réglementaire, la maîtrise des risques et l'optimisation durable des performances techniques et financières.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS

Pilotage de la performance opérationnelle

  • Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie opérationnelle de l'entreprise.
  • Garantir la continuité et la qualité des opérations sur l'ensemble des sites.
  • Développer et suivre les indicateurs de performance (KPI).
  • Mettre en place des outils de reporting et d'aide à la décision.
  • Optimiser les processus afin d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle et la rentabilité.
  • Piloter les budgets d'exploitation et les plans d'amélioration continue.

Santé, Sécurité, Environnement et Conformité

  • Assurer la conformité des activités avec les exigences réglementaires et normatives.
  • Développer une culture forte de sécurité et de prévention des risques.
  • Superviser les audits, inspections et plans d'actions correctifs.
  • Garantir la mise en œuvre des politiques HSE.
  • Gérer les situations de crise et coordonner les plans d'urgence.

Logistique et Supply Chain

  • Superviser les opérations d'approvisionnement, de stockage et de distribution.
  • Assurer la fiabilité et la fluidité des flux logistiques.
  • Optimiser les niveaux de stocks et les coûts associés.
  • Veiller à la performance des partenaires logistiques et prestataires.
  • Identifier les opportunités d'amélioration des schémas logistiques.

Maintenance et Gestion des Actifs

  • Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de maintenance des actifs.
  • Garantir la disponibilité et la fiabilité des équipements critiques.
  • Superviser les programmes de maintenance préventive et corrective.
  • Assurer le respect des exigences techniques et réglementaires.
  • Contribuer à la modernisation et à l'amélioration continue des infrastructures.

Gestion des Projets et Investissements

  • Piloter les projets d'amélioration, de modernisation et d'expansion.
  • Superviser les budgets d'investissement (CAPEX).
  • Coordonner les intervenants internes et externes.
  • Participer à l'évaluation et à la priorisation des projets stratégiques.
  • Garantir le respect des délais, budgets et objectifs fixés.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Formation

  • Diplôme d'Ingénieur ou Bac+5 en Génie Industriel, Énergie, Mécanique, Supply Chain ou discipline équivalente.
  • Une formation complémentaire en management ou gestion des opérations constitue un atout.

Expérience

  • Minimum 12 à 15 ans d'expérience dans des environnements industriels complexes.
  • Expérience confirmée dans la gestion d'opérations multi-sites.
  • Solide expérience dans les secteurs de l'énergie, des hydrocarbures, de l'industrie lourde, de la logistique industrielle ou d'activités à risques.
  • Expérience avérée en management d'équipes multidisciplinaires.

COMPÉTENCES CLÉS

Techniques

  • Gestion d'opérations industrielles complexes.
  • Maintenance d'actifs critiques.
  • Supply Chain et logistique industrielle.
  • Gestion des risques et conformité réglementaire.
  • Pilotage de projets d'investissement.

Managériales

  • Leadership et conduite du changement.
  • Gestion de la performance.
  • Français & Anglais
  • Capacité à fédérer des équipes pluridisciplinaires.
  • Prise de décision en environnement exigeant.
  • Gestion de crise et résolution de problèmes.

Personnelles

  • Forte orientation résultats.
  • Esprit analytique et stratégique.
  • Excellentes capacités de communication.
  • Sens de l'organisation et rigueur.
  • Intégrité et sens des responsabilités.

Sumario

O objectivo principal do(a) Analista de Dados Júnior é apoiar a recolha, tratamento, organização e análise de dados relacionados com as operações e portefólios da Instituição, contribuindo para a produção de informação fiável e atempada que suporte a monitoria do desempenho institucional e a tomada de decisão.

Responsabilidades:

  • Recolher, organizar e manter actualizadas as bases de dados relativas às operações garantidas, portefólios cobertos e demais informações relevantes para a actividade da Instituição.
  • Apoiar a validação, consistência e qualidade dos dados, efectuando verificações e controlos regulares da informação recebida.
  • Produzir relatórios periódicos, mapas de acompanhamento e indicadores de desempenho para apoio à gestão e reporte institucional.
  • Apoiar a elaboração e actualização de dashboards e ferramentas de monitoria do portefólio.
  • Realizar análises estatísticas, financeiras e operacionais de suporte à monitoria do desempenho das garantias e do portefólio da Instituição.
  • Apoiar a monitoria da evolução da carteira de garantias, incluindo indicadores de utilização, concentração, incumprimento e recuperação.
  • Colaborar com as diferentes áreas internas e instituições financeiras parceiras na recolha, consolidação e tratamento de informação relevante.
  • Apoiar a preparação de informação e dados para reportes internos, auditorias, supervisores, financiadores e outros stakeholders.
  • Identificar inconsistências, lacunas ou oportunidades de melhoria na qualidade e gestão dos dados institucionais.
  • Assegurar a organização e manutenção dos arquivos electrónicos e bases de dados sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Executar outras actividades compatíveis com a função e necessárias ao adequado funcionamento da área.

Qualificações:

  • Licenciatura em Estatística, Matemática, Ciência de Dados, Finanças, Economia, Gestão, Informática ou áreas afins.
  • Formação complementar em análise de dados, business intelligence ou estatística será considerada uma vantagem.
  • Experiência mínima de 2 a 4 anos em análise de dados, reporting, monitoria de portefólios ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência no sector financeiro, banca, seguros ou fundos será considerada uma vantagem.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados será valorizado.

70b1c35a5330","title":{"0":"Change Project: S2C Transformation Program – CLM Deployment

Job Overview

As part of a major digital transformation initiative, we are seeking an experienced Change Management & Adoption Lead to support the deployment of a Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) solution within the Source-to-Contract (S2C) procurement process.

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving user adoption, managing organizational change, and ensuring the successful implementation of new processes, tools, and ways of working across impacted business functions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Impact Assessment & Business Analysis

  • Identify and analyze impacted stakeholder groups, personas, and user communities.
  • Document and formalize current (\"As-Is\") and future (\"To-Be\") business processes.
  • Conduct impact assessments across organization, processes, tools, and user practices.
  • Evaluate adoption challenges, risks, and change complexity.

2. Change Management Strategy & Execution

  • Define and implement the change management and adoption strategy, including communication, training, and engagement plans.
  • Co-design adoption roadmaps with Product, IT, and Business teams.
  • Adapt change approaches to local contexts, subsidiaries, and user populations.

3. Stakeholder Management

  • Map and engage key stakeholders, including sponsors, managers, key users, and digital champions.
  • Build and animate local change networks and communities.
  • Act as the primary interface between central project teams and local business stakeholders.

4. Change Deployment & User Enablement

  • Design and deliver communication, training, and engagement activities.
  • Develop change management deliverables such as communication kits, user guides, training materials, and support documentation.
  • Facilitate workshops, training sessions, and awareness campaigns.
  • Support end-users and key users throughout the adoption journey.

5. Adoption Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and track adoption and usage KPIs.
  • Establish reporting and monitoring mechanisms.
  • Collect, analyze, and act upon user feedback.
  • Recommend and implement corrective actions to maximize adoption and business value.

6. Governance & Coordination

  • Establish and facilitate change governance structures, steering committees, and regular change forums.
  • Coordinate change activities with Product Owners, Business Process Owners, and project teams.
  • Ensure alignment between change management activities and overall project objectives.

7. Knowledge Management & Best Practices

  • Capture lessons learned and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Contribute to the sustainable embedding of new behaviors, processes, and tools within the organization.

Required Skills & Experience

Functional Skills

  • Change Management (Expert)
  • Digital Transformation (Advanced)
  • Procurement Processes (Source-to-Contract / S2C) (Advanced)
  • Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Solutions (Advanced)

Professional Experience

  • Proven experience leading change management initiatives within large-scale digital transformation programs.
  • Strong expertise in user adoption, stakeholder engagement, communication, and training.
  • Experience working with procurement transformation projects and CLM implementations.
  • Ability to operate effectively in complex, multicultural, and international environments.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Analytical mindset with a structured approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to influence and drive engagement across multiple organizational levels.

Languages

  • English: Fluent (mandatory)
  • French: Professional proficiency preferred

 Behaviours   

 Performance,      Efficiency,            Teamwork,          Diligence,           Congeniality, Analytical, Organized.

Job Description - Finance & Administration Coordinator

 Position: Finance & Administration Coordinator (Full-time, Part-time to be considered)

Location: Morocco - Marrakesh/Ouarzazate area

Work Mode: Hybrid role (Office + Site visits as required)

Languages: Fluent French (Moroccan dialect required); working level of English

Experience: 2 - 5 years of experience in accounting, finance, administration, or similar functions within Morocco

Reporting: Directly reporting to CCAO/CFO

 Key Responsibilities:

 •       Maintaining accurate accounting records and supporting day-to-day financial administration

•       Preparing and submitting all statutory declarations, tax filings, and government-required reports in accordance with Moroccan regulations

•       Coordinating with external accountants, auditors, tax advisors, lawyers, banks, and government authorities

•       Monitoring cash movements and maintaining up-to-date records of company expenditures

•       Preparing monthly financial summaries and management reports

•       Tracking project expenditures and preparing cost reports for specific activities, projects, construction works, equipment purchases, and operational programs

•       Assisting management with budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities

•       Supporting procurement and operational teams with financial information and expenditure tracking

•       Maintaining corporate records and assisting with company administration matters

•       Monitoring compliance with local regulatory, tax, and corporate obligations

•       Supporting the preparation of documentation required for audits, financing activities, and corporate transactions

 Required Skills & Profile: 

•       Strong understanding of Moroccan accounting, tax, and statutory reporting requirements

•       Practical experience with bookkeeping, accounting systems, and financial administration

•       Ability to prepare management reports and analyze project costs

•       Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

•       Ability to communicate effectively with management, lawyers, accountants, banks, and government authorities

•       Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications

•       Experience in mining, construction, industrial, or project-based environments would be considered an advantage

•       Preferred Qualifications:

o  Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field

o  Experience working with international companies or foreign investors

o  Familiarity with project cost tracking and reporting

o  Knowledge of English sufficient for communication with international management and external stakeholders

de Gestão de Risco Sénior"},"description":{"4":"

Sumário

O objectivo principal do Técnico de Gestão de Risco Sénior é assegurar a implementação e monitoria do quadro de gestão de riscos, promovendo a identificação, avaliação, mitigação e acompanhamento dos riscos inerentes às actividades da instituição, incluindo riscos financeiros, operacionais, de crédito, de conformidade e reputacionais, contribuindo para a sustentabilidade, solidez e boa governação da instituição.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter o quadro de gestão integrada de risco da instituição, abrangendo riscos de crédito, operacionais, financeiros, reputacionais, de conformidade e outros riscos relevantes para a instituição.
  • Identificar, avaliar, monitorar e reportar os riscos associados às operações de garantia, carteiras, processos internos e actividades institucionais.
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores de risco, limites de exposição e mecanismos de mitigação, assegurando alinhamento com o apetite ao risco definido pela instituição.
  • Desenhar, implementar e monitorar controlos internos destinados a fortalecer a eficácia operacional, a fiabilidade da informação e a conformidade com requisitos legais, regulamentares e políticas internas.
  • Realizar análises e revisões independentes de risco sobre carteiras garantidas, operações, processos e estruturas de mitigação de risco.
  • Monitorar o cumprimento das políticas internas de risco, procedimentos operacionais e requisitos prudenciais aplicáveis.
  • Elaborar relatórios periódicos de risco destinados à Direcção Executiva, Conselho de Administração, Comités especializados e entidades reguladoras.
  • Apoiar os processos de tomada de decisão através da produção de análises de risco e recomendações técnicas.
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento da cultura institucional de gestão de risco, controlo interno e prudência operacional, incluindo acções de formação e sensibilização internas.
  • Acompanhar a implementação de medidas correctivas relacionadas com deficiências de controlo e exposições de risco identificadas.
  • Manter articulação com auditoria interna, compliance, áreas operacionais e parceiros relevantes em matérias relacionadas com gestão de risco.

Qualificações:

  • Licenciatura em Finanças, Gestão de Risco, Economia, Contabilidade, Auditoria ou áreas afins (Pós-graduação ou Certificação.
  • Profissional em Risco, Auditoria constitui vantagem.
  • Experiência entre 4 a 6 anos de experiência progressiva em gestão de risco ou auditoria, em instituições financeiras, reguladores ou instituições de financiamento ao desenvolvimento.

ABOUT THE JOB

Vous êtes passionné(e) par le monde de l’aviation, du tourisme, de l’hospitalité et du voyage ? Ce poste est pour vous !

Notre client recherche pour son agence basée à Madagascar un Directeur d’Agence de voyage et Tour-opérateur pour piloter la performance de l’agence en assurant à la fois sa croissance, sa rentabilité et l’expérience client.

Responsabilités

  • Définir et piloter le plan annuel pour atteindre les objectifs de chiffre d’affaires et de rentabilité sur la destination.
  • Piloter les opérations réceptives et émettrices, en veillant au respect des procédures et à l’image professionnelle de l’entreprise
  • Développer le business en construisant des relations solides avec les clients internationaux et les partenaires locaux incluant banques, les prestataires er les autorités locales
  • Conduire la transformation digitale de l’agence en intégrant les outils data et IA afin d’améliorer la performance commerciale et opérationnelle
  • Encadrer et motiver les équipes pour offrir une expérience client exceptionnelle
  • Stimuler les ventes en proposant des produits et services adaptés aux besoins du marché et en augmentant la présence locale
  • Optimiser la chaîne de valeur (hébergement, transport, activités, partenaires) pour offrir une expérience client unique et fluide
  • Maîtriser les coûts en respectant les budgets et en optimisant les ressources locales
  • Garantir un haut niveau de satisfaction client en pilotant les opérations et les standards de service
  • Piloter les KPI clés (revenus, marges, satisfaction client) et mettre en place des plans d’action correctifs

Profil Recherché

  • Diplôme en tourisme, gestion hôtelière, management ou domaine connexe
  • 8 à 10 ans d’expérience dans le secteur du tourisme, dont une expérience significative dans la gestion de destinations et les opérations touristiques entrantes et sortantes
  • Excellente connaissance du marché touristique local et international
  • Solides compétences en négociation, organisation et gestion d’équipe
  • Sens aigu du service client et de la résolution de problèmes
  • Capacité à prioriser et prendre des décisions à fort impact dans un environnement exigeant et en constante évolution
  • Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais (autres langues appréciées)

Job Details

Job Title: Senior Mechanical Engineer

Business/Department:  Production Support Team (Offshore Operations)

Reporting To:  Maintenance Team Lead

 Job Purpose

Supporting offshore operations with mechanical maintenance activities and projects including, but not limited to, building maintenance/refurbishment, complex piping and structural repairs, helideck upgrades and in-line inspection (ILI).

Experience Key Result Areas

1. Deliver no harm (People, Asset, Environment and Reputation), accountable for embedding safety leadership culture for self, team members and contractor for all maintenance activities. Promote strong behavioral safety interactions culture.

2. Deliver project/maintenance activities within budget and actively explore opportunity for cost optimization, increase in safety, reliability, productivity, and efficiency as part of our long-term strategy.

3. Initiate Management of Change (eCAF) prior to any modifications. Follow up with the Design Office and Engineering Teams to ensure drawings are issued prior to the implementation of any project.

4. Responsible for ensuring contracts are in place, material procurement and fabrication.

5. Preparation of work pack information including, but not limited to, drawings, procedures, and commissioning information.

6. Accountable for all logistical requirements related to any project, including vessel support, material movements and vendor mobilization.  

7. Willing to travel offshore for extended periods of time to oversee the execution of all projects.

8. Maintain up to date records and timelines of ongoing projects. Ensuring drawings and procedural records are updated upon completion

9. Define in-line inspection strategies including tool selections such as Ultrasonic testing (UT), Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL), and Electromagnetic Acoustic Transducer (EMAT) or other.

10. Review and authorize ILI work method statements (WMS), work-packs and risk assessments. Taking full ownership and accountability of inspection scopes managing form inception to completion in compliance with company pipeline inspection standards - API, ASME, ISO. 

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years’ experience supporting mechanical engineering for offshore operations.
  • Demonstrated experience with ILI inspection planning, tool operation and data interpretation.
  • Strong knowledge of ASME B31.4/B31.8, API 579, NACE SP0102 and other relevant standards.

Other Competencies / Skills / Others

  • Strong communication skills.
  • Embrace and operate within a dynamic, operationally focused environment.
  • Ability to operate / integrate across all levels of the organization.
  • Excellent English language written and oral communication skills.
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite; including MS Project, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

Carbon Program Manager

Location: Uganda

Commitment: Full-Time

Travel: As necessary

Reporting To: Chief Executive Officer

About the Role

The Carbon Program Director leads the development, technical execution, and end-to-end delivery of large-scale nature-based carbon initiatives across Uganda. This senior leadership role combines full ownership of carbon project development from feasibility through validation and issuance with direct oversight of the Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) function that underpins high-integrity carbon accounting. The role ensures that all projects meet stringent requirements under Verra VCS, Gold Standard, ART TREES, GCF, and Uganda's national carbon policies, and that field data collection is robustly integrated with remote sensing to deliver auditable, verification-ready results. The ideal candidate combines strategic and commercial leadership with deep technical MRV expertise, driving projects that deliver climate, community, and biodiversity outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy, Development & Commercial Leadership

  1. Define and implement the carbon project development strategy for Uganda, ensuring alignment with national climate goals and NDCs.
  2. Secure funding and partnerships (corporate buyers, investors, NGOs) to scale project pipelines
  3. Oversee end-to-end project cycles: feasibility studies, methodology selection, PDD preparation, validation, and issuance.
  4. Ensure projects meet all technical, financial, and legal requirements for carbon certification.
  5. Mitigate risks (leakage, reversals, policy changes) through robust planning and portfolio management.
  6. Represent the company with government agencies, investors, research institutions, carbon-market players, and local communities.
  7. Monitor evolving carbon standards and policy (e.g. Paris Agreement Article 6, Uganda's NDCs and National Carbon Registry).

Methodology & Technical Governance

  1. Own methodology selection and application across the project portfolio, ensuring compliance with Verra, UN REDD+ scheme, Gold Standard, and ART TREES.
  2. Calculate baseline emissions and project removals using IPCC-compliant Tier 2/3 models and uncertainty analysis.
  3. Ensure alignment of all projects with Uganda's National Carbon Registry requirements and international accounting rules.

Monitoring, Reporting & Verification (MRV)

  1. Develop and own end-to-end Monitoring Plans compliant with applicable methodologies.
  2. Design field data collection protocols for forest carbon stocks, soil carbon, and project boundaries.
  3. Integrate remote sensing data with ground measurements for Tier 2/3 reporting.
  4. Implement QA/QC systems for field data and spatial datasets to ensure data integrity.
  5. Prepare verification-ready documentation, including Monitoring Reports and supporting evidence.
  6. Deploy mobile data collection tools (e.g. KoBoToolbox, Field Maps) for field teams.
  7. Automate analysis using Python/R scripts and Google Earth Engine.
  8. Utilize drones and sensor technologies to enhance measurement precision.
  9. Serve as primary liaison for third-party validators/verifiers (e.g. DNV, TÜV), addressing verification findings and implementing corrective actions.

Team Leadership

  1. Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams (carbon scientists, MRV specialists, GIS analysts, legal advisors, community engagement officers).
  2. Foster partnerships with research institutions and integrate innovative approaches (remote sensing, AI for MRV) to enhance project quality.

Required Expertise & Qualifications

  • 10+ years in nature-based carbon project development, with 5+ years in leadership roles.
  • Proven track record of successfully validated VCS/Gold Standard projects (REDD+ or AFOLU preferred).
  • Hands-on experience implementing MRV systems for forest carbon projects (REDD+ mandatory)
  • Deep knowledge of carbon methodologies and MRV frameworks REDD+, Verra, Gold Standard and IPCC Tier 2/3 biomass equations and uncertainty analysis.
  • Expert in geospatial tools such QGIS, ArcGIS Pro, and Google Earth Engine.
  • Field experience with forest inventory protocols (permanent plots, allometrics).
  • Strong financial acumen (carbon credit pricing, off-take agreements, ROI analysis).

Education & Certifications

  • Master's or PhD in Environmental Science, Forestry, Geomatics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Professional certifications from Verra VCS-approved MRV training and/or GHG Accounting certification (e.g. GHG Management Institute); project management (e.g. PMP) a plus.
  • Examples of past work samples (e.g. PDDs, Monitoring Plans, validation/verification reports, or code repositories).

Required Competencies

  • Balances commercial viability with climate and community impact.
  • Obsessive about data integrity and methodological rigour.
  • Navigates complex regulatory and field-level challenges, troubleshooting technical issues innovatively.
  • Builds trust with diverse stakeholders (governments, NGOs, investors, local communities) and translates complex MRV concepts for varied audiences.
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with evolving carbon markets and in remote field conditions
  • Committed to transparent, high-integrity carbon accounting.
  • Knowledge of forest ecosystems (tropical high forest, woodlands).

Why Join Us?

You will:

  • Create socioeconomic opportunities through high-impact projects.
  • Work with a global team of experts.
  • Access to competitive compensation and benefits.

& Logistics Manager"},"description":{"0":"

Store & Logistics Manager

Reports to: Country Manager

Location: Kigali, Rwanda

About the Role

The Store & Logistics Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management of warehouse operations, stock control, and logistics coordination. This role acts as a critical operational bridge between local operations, logistics partners, and the teams. The objective is to ensure efficiency, avoid delays and penalties, and guarantee stock integrity.

Key Responsibilities

Warehouse & Stock Management

  • Ensure accurate inventory management and reconciliation
  • Maintain real-time stock visibility
  • Ensure proper storage conditions
  • Supervise receiving, storage, and dispatch

Logistics Coordination

  • Act as link between local operations, partners, and UK logistics team
  • Ensure all documentation is shared with partners
  • Track shipments and resolve delays
  • Avoid penalties and ensure smooth delivery

Process Compliance & Financial Discipline

  • Ensure all outgoing goods are fully paid
  • Enforce PO, PR, and approval workflows
  • Work with finance to validate payments
  • Ensure full traceability

Documentation & Accuracy

  • Ensure all logistics documents are accurate and complete
  • Maintain delivery notes and records

Efficiency & Cost Optimization

  • Improve operations and reduce delays
  • Optimize logistics costs

Coordination & Communication

  • Act as coordination point between teams
  • Ensure smooth communication flow

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 7+ years experience in warehouse/logistics
  • Experience in import/export and clearing processes
  • Strong stock control knowledge
  • Understanding of financial processes (PO/PR)
  • Strong organization and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work under pressure
  • Excellent communication skills

Profile

  • Hands-on and operational
  • Highly reliable and structured
  • Strong accountability
  • Proactive mindset
  • Comfortable with field and corporate environments

Sales Representative – Agribusiness (Field-Based) - Northern Part of Rwanda

Open to Locals Only!!!!

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly driven, field-oriented Sales Representative with a strong agricultural background to aggressively develop sales within an assigned region.

This role is for a sales hunter: someone who enjoys being in the field, opening doors, convincing agro-dealers and farmers, building long-term relationships, and consistently pushing volumes.

The successful candidate will be given a company vehicle, will carry selected products, and will be expected to take full ownership of sales growth in their territory.

 Key Responsibilities

Sales & Business Development

- Develop and grow sales of the products portfolio (crop protection, fertilizers, seeds, irrigation solutions)

- Prospect, onboard, and manage agro-dealers, stockists, cooperatives, and key farmers

- Push sales volumes through regular field visits, product demonstrations, and follow-ups

- Convince customers through strong product knowledge and commercial negotiation

- Organise sales either directly from stock in the vehicle or via customer/company transport

 Territory Management

Lead Civil Project Engineer – Job Description

Position Title

Lead Civil Project Engineer

Professional Area / Family

Engineering – Civil & Structural Engineering

Job Description

The Lead Civil Project Engineer is responsible for coordinating and supervising all Civil Engineering activities during EPC project execution and bidding phases, ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, company procedures, project schedules, quality standards, and approved manhours budgets.

The role combines technical project leadership with departmental coordination responsibilities, ensuring efficient resource allocation, technical consistency, engineering quality, and successful project delivery throughout the full project lifecycle.

The Lead Civil Project Engineer acts as the main focal point between Civil Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, Construction, Vendors, Clients, and Subcontractors.

________________________________________

Duties and Responsibilities

Project & Engineering Management

•\tLead and supervise Civil Engineering activities during Bid and Project execution phases. 

•\tCoordinate the preparation and issuance of all Civil discipline deliverables including specifications, datasheets, calculations, reports, drawings, BOQs, and 3D model deliverables. 

•\tEnsure that engineering deliverables are issued according to project schedule and within approved manhours budget. 

•\tReview and comment on contracts, technical annexes, and project specifications, highlighting discrepancies or technical clarifications. 

•\tDefine and implement Civil Design Criteria, methodologies, engineering procedures, and guidelines. 

•\tMonitor engineering progress, quantity variations, and budget performance, reporting deviations and proposing corrective actions. 

•\tEnsure compliance with corporate procedures, international standards, project specifications, and Quality Management Systems. 

•\tCoordinate interfaces between Civil Engineering and other disciplines to ensure proper flow of technical information. 

Team Leadership & Coordination

•\tSupervise and coordinate Civil Engineering specialists, designers, and external engineering resources. 

•\tAssign engineering tasks and manage workload distribution within the Civil discipline team. 

•\tMentor junior engineers and support technical and professional development within the department. 

•\tSupport staffing planning and identify resource, competency, or outsourcing needs. 

•\tPromote collaboration, teamwork, and effective communication across multidisciplinary project teams. 

Technical Responsibilities

•\tReview and approve Civil and Structural engineering calculations and deliverables. 

•\tEnsure proper application of Civil Engineering standards related to: 

o\tFoundations and structural calculations 

o\tBuildings and steel structures 

o\tGeotechnical and geological assessments 

o\tVibrating machine foundations 

o\tStructural installation and constructability 

o\t3D modeling and TEKLA/SmartPlant integration 

•\tSupport FEED verification activities and assess technical risks during bid phase. 

•\tMonitor design discrepancies between bidding and detailed engineering phases. 

Procurement & Vendor Management

•\tSupport Procurement activities including preparation and review of: 

o\tRFQ documentation 

o\tTechnical Bid Evaluations (TBE) 

o\tVendor technical clarifications 

o\tKick-Off Meetings (KOM) 

•\tReview and verify Vendor and Subcontractor engineering documentation. 

•\tEvaluate subcontracting engineering quality and monitor outsourced activities. 

•\tCoordinate technical interfaces with Vendors and Suppliers. 

Construction & Site Support

•\tProvide technical assistance during procurement, construction, commissioning, and site activities. 

•\tSupport field engineering activities including technical queries, modifications, and document mark-ups. 

•\tAssist site teams during project implementation and resolve technical issues when required. 

Bid & Commercial Support

•\tParticipate actively in bid preparation activities. 

•\tPrepare manhours estimates and supervise Civil discipline bill of quantities. 

•\tContribute to risk assessment and development of mitigation strategies. 

•\tSupport project budgeting and cost control activities. 

________________________________________

Work Experience Requirements

•\tDegree in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification. 

•\tMinimum 8–10 years of experience in Civil/Structural Engineering within EPC projects. 

•\tMinimum 3–5 years of experience in a lead or coordination role. 

•\tProven experience managing the full lifecycle of EPC projects. 

•\tStrong knowledge of Civil and Structural Engineering principles, standards, methods, and tools. 

•\tExperience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities and engineering teams. 

•\tExperience with international projects and multicultural environments is considered an asset. 

________________________________________

Technical Competencies

•\tCivil & Structural Design 

•\tFoundation Design 

•\tStructural Steel Design 

•\tGeotechnical & Geological Engineering 

•\tFEED Verification 

•\tProcurement Engineering 

•\tVendor & Subcontractor Coordination 

•\tEngineering Planning & Scheduling 

•\tBudget & Manhours Control 

•\tRisk Management 

•\tField Engineering Support 

•\t3D Modeling / TEKLA / SmartPlant 

•\tContract & Scope Management 

•\tQuality Assurance & Quality Control 

________________________________________

Soft Skills & Competencies

•\tLeadership and team management 

•\tStrong communication and interpersonal skills 

•\tPlanning and organizational capabilities 

•\tAnalytical thinking and problem-solving 

•\tResult-oriented mindset 

•\tCollaboration and teamwork 

•\tConflict management 

•\tOperational flexibility and adaptability 

•\tStress management and self-control 

•\tAttention to detail and methodical approach 

•\tAbility to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines 

•\tChange management attitude 

________________________________________

Education Requirements

•\tMaster’s Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification. 

________________________________________

Certifications

•\tChartered Engineer or equivalent professional registration is considered an advantage. 

________________________________________

Language Requirements

•\tFluent in English (written and spoken). 

•\tAdditional languages are considered an asset. 

________________________________________

Work Conditions

•\tEngineering Office and/or Site assignments depending on project requirements. 

•\tAvailability for international missions and site support activities if required. 

________________________________________

Other Specific Requirements

•\tFamiliarity with: 

o\tConstruction Management Systems 

o\tDocument Management Systems 

o\tProject Control Standards 

o\tEPC project execution procedures 

o\tInternational engineering codes and standards

Landfall Field Engineer / Onshore Works Lead

Position Details:

•\tStart Date: Q2 2026 

•\tLocation: Maputo, Mozambique

•\tDuration: 12 months+ (renewable)

•\tEmployment Type: Rotational / 28 calendar days on location followed by 28 days off (plus 2 days paid travel day) 

•\tProject : Mozambique LNG Project 

The position is for Mozambique LNG project. 

•\tUS $20 Billion investment, 17,000-acre LNG facility site that includes private airstrip, marine facilities, and 18 subsea wells - 5-year construction period, utilizing a staff of 1500+ employees and contractors based in Houston, Milan, Paris, Singapore and Mozambique

•\tMozambique LNG is a subsea (1,400m) to shore dry gas field development located in the norther part of Mozambique with 12.88 MTPA from 2 Initial Trains - 25-year production period

•\tThe subsea field will be developed via 18 subsea wells, 7-production manifolds, 1-MEG manifold, 3 x 22in trunk lines, a 6in and 8in MEG lines, 18 x 10in in-field flowlines, 2 x 4in in-field MEG lines, associated ILTs and PLETs for all pipelines, 25 control modules, 4 onshore umbilicals, 2 main tie-back umbilicals, 5 in-field umbilicals, 12 UTA assemblies, 189 electro hydraulic flying leads, 48 x 10” flexible jumpers, rigid jumpers and spools

Company Description

Our client is a global multi-energy company operating large-scale refining and petrochemical facilities. It transforms crude oil into fuels and essential industrial products through highly integrated and technologically advanced operations. The organisation is recognized for its strong HSE culture, operational excellence, and commitment to reducing environmental impact. Joining the company means contributing to complex international projects within a high-performance industrial environment.

Job Dimensions

The Landfall Field Engineer / Onshore Works Lead is reporting to the Afungi Upstream Installation/ Construction Manager and will oversee the contractors’ onshore activities in 

Afungi at the Beach Landing Area (BLA) or area A1-29. The scope of responsibilities includes land preparation, excavation, civil works, foundations, pipeline and umbilical pull-ins, onshore pipeline construction, BVS/BCA installation and connection, and all associated works. Some precommissioning activities will also be under the Landfall FE scope of work. The Contract has a value of circa 2.5 Bn USD and has been awarded in 2019 to a two-member consortium composed of Van Oord Offshore and TechnipFMC. The scope of the infrastructure to be installed under the contract can be summarized as; export pipelines (gas, 22in rigid pipelines), Service line (MEG, 8in and 6in rigid pipelines), rigid jumpers, flexible jumpers, manifolds (and piles), umbilical’s, PLETs / ILTsstructures(and foundations), sleepers, mattresses, flying leads and flexible pipe jumpers. The job holder is expected to assess, manage, and control the Landfall works of the project and ensure the readiness and preparedness of MTV for these activities. The job holder shall oversee the landfall works activities in line with agreed execution plans and the Project HSEQ management system. Initially in short missions to MTV offices in the Netherlands, the Landfall Onshore Works Lead is expected to be a 28/28 rotational schedule during the execution of the work in Afungi camp, Mozambique.

Job Description

 Project Management

\tProvide management and leadership at the Landfall Works location during all project phases.

\tEnsure safe, on time and within budget delivery of all Landfall Works related elements of the EPCI scope of work whilst ensuring a high level of quality consistent with a project design life of 30 years.

\tMonitor and manage all facets of work within the Landfall Works scope of work to ensure that schedule, cost / budget, technical, quality and HSES requirements are, as a minimum, met or improved upon.

\tBring to earliest attention of the Afungi Upstream Installation / Construction Manager issues which present a significant threat to the Project and in addition offer mitigating measures / work plans.

\tProvide reporting function towards all stakeholders for the Landfall Work activities.

\tEnsure that the readiness reviews inclusive of the equipment inspections are prepared and close out of the findings are performed.

\tEnsure that all Landfall Work activities are performed in compliance with project technical requirements and fit for purpose.

\tEnsure identification and resolution of detailed interface issues, in conjunction with other managers / senior discipline engineers, in an efficient and cost-effective manner.

 

Qualifications

\tMinimum of 15 years relevant track record in in offshore construction industry including landfalls, land pipelines. 

\tSound experience in management of onsite contractors.

\tAbility to develop good working relationships with contractors and contractor personnel and progress collaborative problem solving.

\tFluid communicator capable to represent the project in front of third parties and other stakeholders in a professional and organized manner.

\tA bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent is required with geotechnical civil or mechanical engineering preferred.

• Define and develop the Project quality performance indicator set (KPIs, Cost of Quality metrics, maturity indicators) in coordination with the

Assurance and Integration Manager, and maintain the indicator architecture through the Project lifecycle.

• Structure and manage the Project quality data architecture — ensuring integrity, accessibility, traceability and alignment with downstream reporting needs.

• Improve stakeholder KPI reporting flows to Home Office, ensuring clarity, relevance and alignment with TotalEnergies reporting standards.

• Act as Project Feedback Representative towards TotalEnergies Headquarters, owning the feedback loop on quality performance, lessons learned and improvement opportunities.

4983_5252_Rotating Supervisor

 Location: TotalEnergies- Mozambique LNG - Afungi - Cabo Delgado, Mozambique

Planned start date: 01/06/2026

Duration: 6 months to 1 YEAR 

Project context

·      Mozambique LNG is a major industrial project (~20 BUSD) executed through multiple EPC packages, with a peak site workforce of ~15,000 personnel.

·      The Rotating Supervisor covers the installation, inspection, preservation, alignment, and pre commissioning readiness of all rotating equipment across EPC work packages.

·      Rotating equipment includes: pumps, compressors, gas turbines, blowers, generators, and mechanical packages.

·      The scope spans site installation, daily field supervision, quality oversight, coordination with construction and commissioning teams, and readiness up to Mechanical Completion.

 Goals and deliverables

·      Daily Workfront Preparation & Coordination Attend daily coordination meetings with EPC Contractor and internal teams. Review daily look ahead plans, manpower allocation, equipment and tooling availability. Ensure workfront readiness: access, scaffolding, lifting plans, baseplate readiness, grouting materials, alignment tools. Identify productivity constraints such as vendor availability, preservation concerns, conflicting activities, and missing documentation. Field Supervision & Technical Oversight Maintain strong field presence to supervise the installation of pumps, compressors, turbines, blowers, and generators.

·      Oversee correct use of vendor drawings, P&IDs, layouts, 3D model extracts, ITPs, and approved procedures. Supervise equipment positioning, leveling, grouting, soft‑foot correction, and initial and final alignment checks. Ensure proper handling and preservation practices (lubrication, rotation, protective covers, storage conditions). Provide technical clarifications to EPC supervisors, foremen, and field technicians. Daily Quality Surveillance Conduct routine inspections on: alignment checks (initial & final) grouting and skid installation bolt torquing & tensioning lubrication systems & preservation status rotation checks and vibration acceptance conditions Follow up on NCRs, observations, and corrective actions. Ensure strict compliance with approved ITPs, procedures, and vendor requirements. Daily HSE Leadership Conduct daily HSE walkdowns and enforce safe practices. Ensure strict compliance with lifting plans, exclusion zones, lock out/tag out, confined space entry, and permit to work requirements. Stop any unsafe activity and promote strong safety culture across all teams. Daily Interface Management Coordinate with: Civil for foundations, grouting, dimensional checks.

·      Piping for stress free connections, supports, and routing.

·      E&I for motor cabling, instrumentation, and auxiliary systems.

·      QA/QC for inspections & documentation.

·      Commissioning for walkdowns, MC status, readiness tests Resolve day to day technical clashes and avoid schedule impacts. Pre Commissioning & Commissioning Support Track readiness of rotating equipment, including: lube oil flushing rotation checks coupling alignment vibration acceptance criteria auxiliary systems readiness Support Commissioning for functional tests, vendor assistance, and troubleshooting. Verify punch lists, MC dossiers, as built documentation, and turnover packages. Daily Reporting & Documentation Prepare daily discipline reports covering progress, key issues, constraints, HSE observations, and next priorities. Review and sign: alignment reports, torque logs, check sheets, quality documents, NCRs, and updates to test packs. Ensure all documentation is accurate and traceable for MC and commissioning stages.

 

Expected skills

·      Lift & Rigging Supervision Review and approval of critical lift plans; supervision of heavy-lift operations (compressor bundles, GT packages); certification of rigging hardware and crane operator coordination

·      Vendor FSE Coordination & Management Scheduling and management of OEM Field Service Engineers at defined installation milestones; preparation of scope of work, safety inductions, and documentation requirements for each vendor visit

·      Lube-Oil System Flushing Planning and execution of dedicated lube-oil flush circuits, temporary filter installation, flushing acceptance criteria per API 614/cleanliness NAS 1638 targets, and post-flush reporting

·      CMMS / Progress Tracking Systems Use of CMMS/construction management platforms (InEight, Procore, AVEVA PRISM or equivalent) for test-pack status, ITP hold-point tracking, and punch-list management

·      Gas Turbines & Aeroderivative Drivers Supervision of GT skid installation, combustion liner fit-up, exhaust system assembly, lube-oil module hook-up, and starter-motor pre-commissioning

·      API Standards Suite Applied knowledge of API 610 (centrifugal pumps), API 614 (lube-oil), API 617 (centrifugal compressors), API 671 (couplings), API 686 (machinery installation), API 670 (condition monitoring)

·      NCR Management & Corrective Action Tracking Raising, tracking, and closing Non-Conformance Reports; root-cause analysis, disposition (use-as-is, rework, reject), and lessons-learned capture

·      Coupling & Drive-Train Management Installation, torquing, and inspection of flexible, gear-type, and diaphragm couplings; verification of axial/radial clearances per API 671

Job Details

Job Title: Senior Materialsman

Business/Department: Finance, IT and Supply Chain

Reporting To: Warehouse Superintendent

II

Job Purpose

Responsible for receiving, storing, issuing, transporting, and recovering materials at the base in support of offshore platforms, drilling rigs, projects, and Repair & Return Workshops (RRW). Manages safe and compliant storage while maintaining stock accuracy, quality, and inventory control. Coordinates receipt and dispatch of materials, rental equipment, and cargo, including inspections, audits, and certifications. Ensures all operations comply with Dubai Petroleum Establishment (DPE) Health, Safety, Environment and Operational Integrity (HSEOI) policies, lifting procedures, and environmental requirements.

III

Dimensions

Number of Direct Staff: 0

Number of Indirect Staff (if applicable): 1

Number of Direct or Indirect Contractors (if applicable): 8

IV

Key Result Areas (Key Accountabilities)

1. Receive and inspect all incoming purchase order materials from both international (sea/air freight) and the local market. Ensure all items received are in good condition, of good quality, not damaged in any way, fit for purpose and in line with the Item Master description in Oracle. Supervise and help Materialsmen in the identification of materials which are not as per the item master specifications. Raise Quality Non-Conformances for sub-standard and incorrect materials received and initiates the return, refund, or replacement of such items with Procurement team in a timely manner. For international rejected materials, coordinate with the DPE Freight Team, and the overseas vendor in shipping these back to the country of origin.

2. Process all acceptable items as per Item Master in Oracle and take them into warehouse stock. Print the Goods Receipts report in Oracle for all the materials that are to be binned in the respective racks and bin locations. For any discrepancy reported during binning, work closely with the Inventory Planning and Cataloguing Coordinator in resolving these issues. Organise the proper preservation, binning and storage of all new and existing stock materials in the warehouse and external storage locations. Ensure that critical purchase order materials are promptly dispatched to operational areas as required. Coordinate and sends new purchase order items to the RRW workshop that require functional testing, technical inspections, hydro/pressure testing, sand blasting or special coatings.

3. Process and issue the relevant Desktop Transfer Requisitions (DTR) and Work Orders in Oracle of all outgoing materials to offshore, projects, the drilling rigs, RRW workshops and the main office complex. Download the outstanding Issues Report so such orders are dispatched as per the required date. All offshore projects and drilling rig materials are packed and sent in appropriate Cargo Carrying Units (CCU) - containers or baskets - via Jebel Ali Operations Support Base (JAOSB) Marine. For DPE vendor rental equipment, ensure that their CCU’s comply with the DPE

Senior Materialsman DP-HR-00032 Rev 5

Information Security Classification: Shared Confidential Page 3 of 4

Cargo Carrying Checklist. Coordinate with JAOSB Marine office, the offshore Warehouse coordinator and Admin/Logistics Supervisor of all items sent.

4. Recover unused items from offshore, the RRW workshops or main office and place the material back in stock. Create work orders in Oracle for that category of items that require specific inspection, before placing them in stock.

5. Audit and inspect the quality, count and condition of materials in the base and external storage locations. Download the inventory balance report from Oracle and perform the physical inspection, accurate counting and evaluating the condition of materials on hand. Conduct daily, weekly or monthly audits of all inventories and assist with the Inventory Planning and Cataloguing Coordinator in resolving discrepancies and quality issues. Assist both the company’s and external government auditors during audits of inventory stock.

6. Assist the Warehouse Superintendent in the disposal or surplus of items and equipment no longer required as per DPE operations. Provide coordination and support to all parties involved.

7. Ensure the warehouse and external materials storage locations are maintained in a neat, clean and safe manner. Help segregate waste (metal, plastic, wood) and assist in disposing it off appropriately.

8. Follow DPE HSEOI policies and procedures regarding Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), chemicals, radioactive materials, Task Risk Assessments (TRA) and Permit to Work (PTW). Report all incidents, near misses and potential safety hazards to the Warehouse Superintendent and assist in incident investigation, analysis and recommendations to avoid recurrences.

9. Supervise the contractor workforce, evaluate their job performance and provide necessary training to maintain overall productivity and quality of work. Ensure timely and accurate updating of contractor Time Sheet cards.

10. Oversee the forklift and crane operations, their operators and associate riggers. Ensure that all follow and observe DPE safety lifting procedures when performing lifts or transporting cargo appliances and heavy equipment. Get all the forklifts, cranes, pipe loaders and trailers regularly serviced for continuous operation.

11. Provide vacation relief for other Senior Materialsmen and Materialsmen.

12. Is a member of the JAOSB Emergency Control Team, JAOSB Emergency Response Team, JAOSB Medical Response Team, and JAOSB Area Wardens.

13. Participate in STAR (Stop, Talk, Agree, Review) tours, prepares safety topics for both the tailgate and monthly safety meetings.

V

Communication and Important Working Relationships

Internal Contacts:

Main office: Finance, IT and Supply Chain department, Rig and Well Operations Support department, Production Offshore department, Onshore Operations department, Engineering department, Marine team and Workshops team under Production Jebel Ali department.

Senior Materialsman DP-HR-00032 Rev 5

Information Security Classification: Shared Confidential Page 4 of 4

Offshore: Warehouse coordinators, Admin/Logistics supervisors, Drilling team, Well Intervention team, Production Fateh team, Production SWF team, Production Support team.

External Contacts:

International and local suppliers. DPE contract vendors.

VI

Knowledge, Skills, Experience and Job-Related Competencies

Educational Qualifications:

 Completion of secondary (12 Years) education.

 3 years’ additional technical or administrative training.

Experience Profile:

 10 years’ work experience with materials in Oil and Gas industry.

Information Security:

 Employees shall read, understand, and comply with DPE’s Information Security Policies, Standards, and Procedures.

 Employees shall promptly report any suspected or actual information security incidents to their respective line manager or the IT Department.

 Employees shall protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of DPE’s information assets.

Competencies/Skills/Others:

 Ability to work productively, efficiently and effectively with initiative and drive under tight timescales and pressure whilst maintaining attention to detail and quality.

 Fluent in oral and written English.

 Proficiency in Microsoft Office and sound knowledge of Oracle.

 Good analytical skills and prompt decision making.

 Leadership skills and an excellent team player.

 Willingness to learn, improve and adapt.

 Excellent personal organisation and business administration skills in accordance with the best modern practice methods.

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills for a demanding and customer focused working environment.

 Valid United Arab Emirates (UAE) Driving License.

coordinator(RSESD)"},"description":{"0":"

RSESD PS 1 Operations coordinator

Reporting line in organization

Start-Up Manager and Field Manager

Activities

HSE / RSESD role:

 Ensure a bridging document, endorsed by all parties, is developed to cover all routine and non-routine activities on Kabaale Hub, whether they are conducted by LA operators, by EACOP, by GMOC or by other Contractors, and therefore ensure full compliance with Affiliate and Site HSE Management Systems

 Contribute to the Emergency Response Plan development.

 Approve bridging document and Emergency Response Plan.

 Ensure all actions are implemented to meet Affiliate and site HSE Objectives (LTIF, TRIR, Environmental Discharges incl. flaring, Tier 1 and Tier 2 events, Observation reporting, Life Saving Checks, Joint Safety Tours, …)

 Ensure implementation and adherence to an Environmental Management System as per ISO 14001 requirement (including Waste management plan).

 Coordinate constitution of a single Site HSE dossier for the perimeter.

 Ensure all Integrity barriers (including SECEs) are always operational and maintained in a timely manner. Deviation or DGS raised if barriers are deficient.

 Define and implement all the safety measures to mitigate safety and environmental risks on site. Review and acknowledge all Risk Assessments.

 Declare and manage any downgraded situation. Define immediate mitigation measures and corrective actions.

 Approve SIMOPS dossiers. Ensure adherence to SIMOPS dossier requirement.

 Acknowledge all PTWs (co-signature with GMOC, LA operators, EACOP).

 Ensure adherence to defined external and internal audit schedule. Follow up on action plans post audit.

 Ensure site organization readiness to respond to any Emergency. Monitor adherence of GMOC to the following: personnel mandatory training, weekly drills, availability and functionality of all necessary resources

 Attend the Emergency Response on site as advisor and liaison officer to Tilenga site and Kampala. Ensure implementation of actions as dictated by Contingency plans (Oil Spill Response,…) (position as On Scene Commander still to be defined)

 Ensure accurate reporting of all HSE KPI, including HSE events through Synergi.

 Lead investigations following any recordable incident, HIPO, Tier 1 and Tier 2 incidents and as deemed necessary. Ensure REX is issued accordingly.

 Promote HSE culture on site through a high visibility on site on daily basis and through HSE meetings and talks.

 Ensure adherence of all personnel on site to Company Code of Conduct, Ethics and Site Internal Rules.

 Ensure best hygiene practices are enforced.

OPERATIONS.

 Represent the TotalEnergies EP Uganda Company / Tilenga operator in the field.

 Ensure smooth coordination and performance of all activities on site for all entities (Production, Maintenance, Inspection, Construction, Logistic, Hospitality and Catering, HSE, Security, Community relations, LA operators, EACOP, GMOC, other Contractors such as SMC…). Ensure resources are adequate. Identify and coordinate co-activities between all parties and ensure associated risks are well managed.

 Liaise with GMOC for the performance of specific activities: pig reception, metering skid line change-over, …

 Contribute to the activity planning, approve work programs and perform arbitration as deemed necessary. Lead the 5WLA planning.

 Implement the site management tours at all locations under his responsibility.

 Monitor the actual execution of the work programs versus plan.

 Monitor all site production activities, to meet efficiency and objectives (including OPEX).

 Approve main procedures and instructions.

 Ensure accurate daily reporting of activities.

 Ensure equipment failure are reported, documented and investigated, and that detailed action plans are issued and followed.

 Contribute to optimization and troubleshooting. Propose modifications or adjustment as deemed necessary to improve reliability or availability, as well as to reduce costs.

 Enforce recommendations from Affiliate Support team (Production Methods, Well performance, …)

 Participate to the definition and approval of scope for shutdown and major campaigns.

 Ensure adherence to Field Operations Management System, including to Meeting TOR and schedule, Management of Change Procedure.

 Contribute to evaluation of contractor performances.

 Care about the Welfare conditions of site personnel to ensure an acceptable standard is maintained.

 Implement reward and sanction policy.

 Mitigate the societal risks prevalent within the area of operation with the assistance of the community and security resources.

 Participate in budget preparation and maintain a cost control system on site. Ensure a clear and precise reporting and time keeping of activities performed by GMOC and under other contracts, for further cost allocation.

Context and environment

There is no equivalent project of such an industrial drilling magnitude in a remote and sensitive area within the Group today.

The Tilenga oilfields are partly situated in a protected National Park, partly beneath the river Nile wetlands area, and within densely populated area in a rural and remote part of Uganda. Activities exposed to the risk of major incidents with severe potential consequences due to local environment and important presence of NGO’s. Factory Drilling with a well delivered every 4 days using 3 drilling rigs simultaneously will necessitate standardization of equipment and procedures, strict enforcement of Drilling & Well instructions, safe and efficient logistic management on site. The project is focused on delivering the lowest possible cost, which requires challenging TOTAL design concepts as well as substantially challenging the TOTAL referential. Multicultural environment: Contractors are anticipated to be located in various parts of the world. Ugandan rules and regulations, administrative requirements and technical authorizations as well as International codes for onshore plant will apply.

The project FID was signed on Q1-2022 with a start of drilling operations on Q2 2022 and a Ready For Start-up (RFSU) target of JulyAccountable for compliance of all site activities with International and Ugandan Laws and Regulations, with Company Rules, Affiliate and site HSE MS.

 Guarantor of Personnel safety, Environmental protection and Property safeguard.

 Accountable Production target achievement while meeting HSE, budget and planning objectives.

Qualifications/Experience required

Qualification:

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent in engineering (i.e. Petroleum, industrial, mechanical) or degree in industrial chemistry.

Experience:

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent in engineering (i.e. Petroleum, industrial, mechanical) or degree in industrial chemistry.

 Minimum 10 years broad practical experience in the field of maintenance and production operations onshore or offshore sites and, Experience as Site Manager or Production Superintendent or HSE superintendent (medium / small site), or/and Head of Production Methods, HQ Exploitation Support Engineer are the minimum requirement.

 Recognized leadership in an oil and gas operating environment. Sound knowledge of TotalEnergies policies, rules and specifications. Demonstrated capacities in HSE, personnel management and technical / operational matters. English mandatory.

 ‘’OPERCAP +’’ evaluation passed.
