Lead Contracts Engineer

The job holder is responsible for:

 As a general manner, to manage all contractual and commercial activities related to the EI, Field Operations, EPC, Shared Service Contract, up to close-out, in the frame and with respect to procedural obligations as per Agreements with Ugandan Authorities, Decrees and Laws in force, Partners Agreement and in strict compliance of delegation of authorities and associated Contract and Procurement procedures.

 Ensure consistency & adequacy of documents such as Performance Bonds, Bank Guarantees, Invoices, Insurance certificates, Sub-contracts, Confidentiality Undertakings ...

 Preparation of official correspondence with Contractor.

 Attendance to monthly (/routine) meetings with Contractors as required.

 Assistance with the negotiation of Change Orders on contractual and commercial aspects.

 Provide support or assistance to the Contract Upstream Manager on claims management.

 Assists the Company Contract Representatives in the timely issuance of interim and final certificates.

 Be open to receiving contractor/supplier representatives and proactively build and maintain relationships with contractors/suppliers to secure positive, constructive and cost-effective commercial agreements for the Project.

General

 Assist the team in complying with Ugandan Law on aspects related to the Procurement processes.

 To adopt and demonstrate exemplary behavior with regard H3SE and H3SE rules implementation.

 To adopt and demonstrate exemplary behavior regarding ethics and project “code of conduct” policy

 To participate to meetings with partners, authorities and other stakeholders as required.

 To carry out any other duties or tasks that may be required by the position.

Context and environment

A Green Field Project, the Tilenga field is to be found in a remote location in UGANDA near lake Albert with particular sensitive environmental conditions.

A challenging project; heavy and waxy oils produced from 31 drilling pads, (with some of them located in a national park) and treated in a Production Center of 200,000bopd oil capacity and 650,000 bld of water treatment capacity. Reservoir pressure maintenance is ensured either by water injection or by polymer water injection depending on the reservoirs characteristics. The project also includes an extended interconnecting network with temperature preservation.

Multicultural environment: Contractors are anticipated to be located in various parts of the world. Ugandan rules and regulations, administrative requirements and technical authorizations as well as International codes for onshore plant will apply.

Accountabilities

 As a general manner, the job holder is responsible to manage all contractual and commercial activities related to the EI, SS, FOPS contract, up to close-out, in the frame and with respect to procedural obligations as per Production Sharing Agreement, Decrees and Laws in force, Joint operating Agreement and in strict compliance of delegation of authorities and associated Contract and Procurement procedures.

Qualifications/Experience required

Qualification:

 Degree qualified in Quantity Surveying, Law, Commercial or Engineering.

Experience:

 Minimum 15 years’ practical, relevant and progressive experience in preparation, negotiation, monitoring of complex technical contracts in the onshore and offshore oil or petrochemical industries. International project experience.

 In depth knowledge and understanding of different means of contractor remuneration and their commercial implications, practical experience of their use.

 Construction and civil works and experience with FIDIC contracts a plus.

 Knowledge and understanding of project services and contract processes including management, amendment & closing out of contracts.

 Demonstrable general knowledge & understanding of project control, commercial, legal and insurance issues affecting the Company in general.

 Basic understanding of the technical domain in which the Project operates.

 Good interpersonal, communication, managerial & organizational skills, capabilities to take workload & work under pressure, able to work in a multicultural environment.

 Take proper actions & decisions to respect targets, including reporting to his/her manager.

 Ability to adapt & to represent the Company in discussions / negotiations with Contractors.

 Ability and willingness to effectively and robustly challenge the views of contractors, suppliers and internal contact, and negotiate reasonable settlements whilst maintaining good relationships and sharing expertise and knowledge as appropriate.

 English as mother tongue or Fluent in English (speaking and writing)

Duration & Location

Kampala, Uganda

Job Description: The Revamping Coordinator is responsible for planning, supervising, and coordinating offshore structural repair, maintenance, and revamping activities on in-service facilities. This role ensures the safe and efficient execution of brownfield and modification projects (e.g., tie-backs, EHR, upgrades), in full compliance with project schedules, budget constraints, and quality standards.

The position involves overseeing fabrication and installation works, monitoring site operations and progress, and ensuring alignment with project specifications. The coordinator acts as a key interface between construction teams, engineering, HSE, and clients to ensure smooth project execution.

Additionally, the role includes planning and scheduling activities, participating in client meetings, coordinating subcontractors, conducting site assessments, and ensuring that all offshore activities are carried out safely and efficiently in accordance with company and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

•Planning & Scheduling: Develop, monitor, and update detailed project schedules for offshore maintenance, shutdowns, and brownfield modifications.

•Offshore Coordination: Serve as the focal point between construction, engineering, HSE teams, subcontractors, and clients.

•Operational Control: Supervise maintenance activities, retrofits, and modifications to enhance asset performance and longevity.

•HSE Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to health, safety, and environmental regulations in high-risk offshore environments.

•Logistics & Material Management: Coordinate mobilization of materials, tools, and heavy equipment to ensure operational readiness.

•Documentation & Reporting: Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including progress reports, Method Statements, and Job Safety Analyses (JSA).

Required Qualifications & Experience:

•Experience: Proven track record in offshore Oil & Gas maintenance, brownfield projects, or shutdown operations.

•Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of structural works, industrial maintenance techniques, EPC workflows, and technical documentation.

•Certifications: Relevant offshore and safety certifications (e.g., BOSIET).

•Skills: Excellent leadership, coordination, and communication skills, with strong problem-solving abilities.

•Tools: Proficiency in MS Office (particularly Excel) and project management tools (e.g., Primavera, ERP systems).

•Languages: Fluency in English is required; working knowledge of Portuguese is an advantage.

Status: Permanent, Direct staff

1/ Key objectives

  • Organize, manage and control goods and services procurement activities within the assigned scope.
  • Drive improvements to Procurement & Contracts processes.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of best practices across goods and services procurement for the segment.
  • Deliver high-quality service to Partner Entities, optimizing cost, quality and lead time.

2/ Key Responsibilities

Team leadership and activity coordination

  • Lead, support and coach team members.
  • Plan, anticipate and monitor the operational schedule for the assigned activity segment.
  • Represent the entity within HQ network and contribute to cross-entity coordination.
  • Benchmark processes and best practices across entities/subsidiaries and drive continuous improvement of service procurement within the activity segment.
  • Maintain and update procurement governance and reporting deliverables
  • Provide onboarding and mentoring to junior staff and new joiners.

Procurement delivery and contract management

  • Contribute to cost-optimization initiatives and savings delivery plans.
  • Ensure adoption and proper use of HQ framework agreements and FALTC arrangements.
  • Leverage Market Intelligence, cost models and market analyses to support sourcing decisions.
  • Define and execute contractual and tender strategies with Partner Entities and HQ, as required, including.
  • Ensure applicable Local Content requirements are integrated into sourcing strategies and contract awards.
  • Proactively propose framework contracts and innovative commercial solutions.
  • Prepare tender documentation in coordination with Partner Entities.
  • Launch, manage and coordinate tenders end-to-end.
  • Contribute to bid analyses, lead/participate in negotiations, and ensure clear allocation of responsibilities.
  • Draft award recommendations with Partner Entities and present them for Contracts Committee approval, where applicable.
  • Draft, review and finalize contractual documents.
  • Participate in supplier performance and evaluation processes.
  • Lead the resolution of claims in liaison with management and the Legal, Insurance and Finance functions, as well as the Head of C&P; propose response strategies and participate in negotiations.
  • Maintain an up-to-date supplier database.
  • Oversee contract administration for the assigned product line (handover, execution follow-up, claims management, etc.).
  • Contribute to local content reporting.

Compliance, ethics and governance

  • Ensure application of HQ Standard Contracts and General Terms & Conditions.
  • Promote and ensure compliance with ethics rules, conflict-of-interest requirements and the subsidiary’s code of conduct.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual policies and applicable laws/regulations, with a strong focus on ethics and transparency.
  • Ensure adherence to Procurement & Contracts rules and procedures in force.

Health, Safety, Security, Social, and Environmental (H3SE) responsibilities

  • Comply with the subsidiary’s H3SE framework and professional recommendations applicable to the role.
  • Implement appropriate precautions to prevent hazards, and report any identified risks or incidents without delay.

3/ Qualifications and skills

  • Education: Master’s degree (business school or equivalent).
  • Experience: 8+ years in services procurement within an International Oil Company or an Upstream Oil & Gas service provider and 3+ years in offshore logistics and/or drilling & wells contracts.
  • Experience in contract & procurement processes and methods.
  • Languages: Professional proficiency in English.
  • Tools: good knowledge of SAP procurement module
  • Strong professionalism, rigor and integrity.
  • Team leadership: ability to facilitate, coordinate and develop teams.
  • Strong organizational skills, structured approach, priority management, and ability to meet deadlines; effective problem-solving and conflict management.

Summary:

The HSE Advisor reports to the Afungi HSE Superintendent Manager and is responsible for the oversight and assurance of the HSE activities related to the onshore & nearshore activities. Support the management of HSE scope delivery and team during the project execution phase. Safe and on time delivery of the HSE scope of work within the onshore & nearshore locations at Afungi. Ensure compliance with Company HSE requirements within all work activities.

  • Responsibilities:
  • Monitor Contractor and Subcontractors activities and performance, providing support, advice and guidance required to maintain safe and efficient operations, in line with the Upstream HSE Plan, contractors HSE Plan and HSEMS and contractual obligations.
  • Represent Company and advise Contractor on HSE-related topics during weekly construction meetings.
  • Contribute to safety studies, audits and reviews, including MoC as required by Project Delivery Manager.
  • Participate in review of Contractors safe systems of work, including hazard ID, PTW, Risk Assessment & management techniques & TBT’s.
  • Support Contractor in incident investigation and ensure robustness of the entire process.
  • Ensure Contractors record and report accurate HSE statistics, and act as focal point for timely and quality HSE reporting to the Project.
  • Support HSE Initiatives and Programs and ensure effective ownership by Contractor to achieve desired results.
  • Support HSE assurance activity, ensure audit reports, progress reports and HSE performance reports are circulated to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Ensure that major risks arising from construction activities are mitigated by robust control measures, in activities such as transportation safety (>400 movements) and heavy lifting with floating cranes (2000T capacity).

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 10 years within the Oil & Gas industry and related HSE experience. With a recognized HSE qualification - NEBOSH diploma or equivalent.
  • Ability to lead & coordinate HSE Investigations to establish actual Root Causes, preparing & rolling out learnings and conducting detailed HSE Audits.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with capability to train, coach, mentor, support and successfully influence at various levels (including contractors).
  • Ability to develop effective working relationships with contractors and contractor personnel and progress collaborative problem solving. 
  • Fluency in the English language.

Notre client propose des services d’externalisation de business développement aux entreprises européennes qui recherchent un relais de croissance en Afrique. Responsabilites Principales:

• Comprendre l'offre, le positionnement, la stratégie des clients de la compagnie et analyser, proposer une approche de développement au CongoBrazzaville et Congo\u0002Kinshasa.

• Prospecter en B2B : identifier, lister, qualifier des partenaires potentiels locaux, importateurs/distributeurs, des projets.

• Réaliser des visites de prospection sur le terrain, organiser des vidéoconférences et développer un portefeuille de prospects, potentiels partenaires.

• Comprendre les complémentarités, le positionnement et les capacités (financières et humaines) des prospects locaux afin de leur proposer au mieux les solutions des clients de la compagnie

• Sélectionner et présenter les partenaires potentiels, les projets aux clients de la compagnie;

• Créer, développer et animer un réseau B2B au Congo-Brazzaville et au CongoKinshasa.

• Préparer, mener des missions pour les équipes et clients de la compagnie au Congo\u0002Brazzaville et au Congo-Kinshasa.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec un chargé d’affaires et être sous la supervision d’un responsable de zone (Afrique / France).

• Partager un compte rendu régulier des activités commerciales : retours de prospection, rapports, reporting hebdomadaire à réaliser. Compétences Techniques

• Formation requise : au moins trois ans d'études supérieures dans le domaine du développement commercial, du marketing ou de la vente.

Expérience :

au moins 5 ans dans le développement commercial en B2B.

• Une expérience dans le secteur eau ou industriel est différenciante.

Compétences :

techniques de développement commercial, capacité à représenter différentes entreprises, capacité à construire un argumentaire de vente, travail dans un environnement multiculturel.

• Compétences personnelles : bonnes relations interpersonnelles, sens de la communication, curiosité technique, méthodes de travail rigoureuses, autonomie, sens de l'observation, dynamisme, prise d'initiative, proactivité Rémunération : selon le profil, salaire fixe + package (transport + téléphone) + Commissions sur les ventes

Senior Contract Engineer

Project context

•\tThe Job holder participates to the process of Contracts and Procurement entity by performing the following tasks.

•\tWork closely with the DUET to create the contracts dossier, develop a clear definition of contractual responsibilities and discuss the agenda including.

•\tDevelopment of Contracting Strategy and issue Call for Tenders to find suitable expertise to support the different functions.

•\tNegotiation and analysis of commercial bids.

•\tDevelopment of Recommendations To Award (RTA) - Ensure that all insurance issues of TEPMA1 assets and personnel are dealt with.

•\tManage his/her performance by monitoring KPIs Ensure the update of the contract management tool - Keep informed of best practices in contracts procedures in other entities for improvement of contracts practices in TEPMA1.

•\tUse existing frame agreements.

Goals and deliverables

•\tPrepare and maintain an up-to-date list of qualified contractors/suppliers/potential tenders/contracts with updated information in order to perform market studies;

•\tAnalyze and assess all possible answers from the market.

•\tDevelopment of Contracting Strategy and issue Call for complex Tenders to find suitable expertise to support the different functions.

•\tLeading the presentation of RTA to the Contracts Committee or the appropriate DOA approver with a common recommendation with DUET.

•\tEstablish the technical contracts and contractual agreements, directly participate to the most complex contracts.

•\tConduct the commercial bid analysis and negotiation thereby creating a clear definition of responsibilities and documents together with the DUET.

•\tTake the leading role in Recommendation To Award (RTA) through Contracts Committee/DOA with common recommendation with DUET.

•\tEnsure the handover of contracts to the Partners’ Entities and monitor contractor’s performance with Duet.

•\tAssist C&P management in the settlement of claims and lawsuits, in relation with the Legal, Insurance, Finance and TEPMA1 Management by proposing strategies and actions and participating to the negotiations.

•\tEnsure monitoring on-going contracts status, participate in contract renewal and amendments discussions.

Expected skills

•\tProblem solving / planning / organising / coordinating

•\tTotalEnergies C&P tools certification level (e.g. UNISOL, IMPACT, SMART…)

•\tEnglish

•\tLNG technical/complex contracts

•\tManagement of contract portfolios of comparable value (700-900 MUSD/yr)

•\tRecommendation To Award (RTA) presentation to Contracts Committee / DOA

•\tContract drafting & review (T&Cs, SoW, pricing schedules)

•\tAdvanced Negotiation skills

•\tCross-functional stakeholder management (DUET/LEGAL)

•\tClaims & disputes settlement experience

•\tContract handover & performance monitoring

•\tCommercial bid analysis & negotiation

•\tConstruction Services Contracts experience

•\tKnowledge of TotalEnergies C&P procedures (CR-CP-xxx, GR-SSC, DOA matrix…)

Quality Surveillance Leader"},"description":{"0":"

Activities

 To adopt and to demonstrate an exemplary behavior with regard to Company \"Code of Conduct\" and HSE rules and regulations. To implement HSE rules and requirements within his area of responsibility, and to comply with HSE training requirements for the position.

 To coordinate the Package Quality Surveillance activities. To ensure that Contractor Quality activities are planned and performed in accordance with Project requirements and Criticality Assessment/Surveillance Plan.

 To define and develop a Package Surveillance program covering Contractors and Suppliers in coordination with concerned Package Managers, Project Quality Manager, Construction Manager and Engineering Manager.

 To define and develop the Packages Surveillance Plans and the associated organization and means. To assist the Package Manager in anticipating and planning of Surveillance resources and availability of necessary inspection/surveillance tools for performance of Package surveillance activities.

 To populate (with ITP information and updates) the digital tool selected by the project for the follow up and management of the inspection activities.

 To coordinate the activities of Package Quality surveillance and of the Construction QC Leaders. To monitor the performance of QC activities by Contractors, Suppliers and Vendors.

 To prepare the Surveillance services orders (using the digital tool) and to manage the inspection services contract for the package. To valid and sign then the related services time sheets.

 To review Contractor's PO's to verify that QA/QC contractual requirements are satisfactory considered.

 To participate when needed to KOM and PIM with subcontractors and vendors, and to specifically remind the Contractual commitments and Company expectations with regards to Quality.

 To review and approve the Contractor's Quality Control plans and Inspection and Test Plans. To verify that Contractor QC program is in line with the Company expectations and requirements. To ensure that surveillance activities are planned in accordance with said procedures/plans and that Contactor QC surveillance/inspection is planned as agreed. To ensure that 3rd party surveillance activities are satisfactory considered. To Mark up Inspection and Test plans with Company surveillance points, with specific focus on Hold points.

 To review and approve the other Quality related documents issued by the Contractors and Suppliers and to raise the necessary comments.

 To give advice to Contractors', Subcontractors' and Suppliers' on QA / QC activities for whole coherence and adequacy (format, document control and enforcement) to Quality Specifications and usual/satisfactory practices.

 To witness the Quality Audits performed by the Contractor on their Suppliers. To participate in

Contractor investigations of significant Quality failures or other work deficiencies.

 To review inspection reports and other quality records and deliverables issued by Contractor on completed works and activities.

 To sign when needed Quality records on behalf of COMPANY.

 To ensure that Material traceability requirements are properly implemented.

 To use visits to worksites to liaise with resident project personnel, and to review any QC problems or reported difficulties.

 To analyze and resolve issues and problems highlighted during the quality surveillance/ QC activities. To follow and expedite the remedial actions from Finding and observations during the Quality Audits or other Quality surveillance/QC activities.

 To interface with Third Party Authority for Contractor/Supplier assessment of conformity. To ensure that certification requirements are fully implemented

 To participate to regular Quality reviews and meetings with Contractor. To review quality KPI'S, improvement efforts, quality issues/failures, NCR trends, etc ...

 To monitor and review the regular reporting issued by the Construction QC Leaders, to ensure adequate and timely reporting to Package management and Quality Manager.

 To populate the Surveillance reporting system enabling reactivity in the management of Surveillance issues.

 To raise weekly & monthly status reports to Packages Managers and Project Quality Manager on quality activities. To maintain and monitor the Package Quality indicators (KPI's).

 To ensure confidentiality of all the documentation issued under his area of responsibility.

Accountabilities

The service holder is responsible, within the Project Surface perimeter, for coordinating the Quality Surveillance activities. The service holder ensures that:

 Project and Package Quality Surveillance procedures and plans are duly implemented by the Company’s project team.

 The EPC Contractor follow the contractual requirements related to the Quality Control and Quality Surveillance and in particular the requirements included in the Exhibit H of the contract.;

 The EPC Contractor cascades the QC and QS requirements to its suppliers and vendors.

The service holder will supervise the day-to-day activities of Contractor and witness the supervisors/inspectors activities during the Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Installation works carried out by contractor or subcontractors.

The service holder shall monitor, instruct, correct and report the working practices of Contractor as necessary. The job holder shall also liaise actively with the Surface Manager, the Engineering Manager, the Package Managers, and with the Project Quality Manager.

The service holder reports to the Packages Managers, highlighting concerns encountered during the performance of his duties.

The service holder is also accountable for demonstrating an exemplary behaviour regarding HSE rules & requirements and for implementing HSE rules within his area of responsibility.

Qualifications/Experience required

Qualification:

 Engineer Degree or equivalent

Experience:

 10 years in the oil and gas industry, at least 5 years post qualification experience in QC/Inspection within Oil & Gas Industry with relevant Project experience.

 English mandatory

Activities

 To develop and prepare Process & Piping Pre-commissioning & Commissioning Execution Plan.

 Manage preparation of Pre-commissioning & Commissioning in respect with OPERCOM and all applicable specification: Procedures, Requirement of Spares, Consumables & Tools, Vendors, equipment’s, manpower, etc and ensure that these resources will be mobilized on time.

 Manage interfaces with contractor through Contract Manager for all matter related to Pre-commissioning & Commissioning during the life of the project.

 Ensure appropriate channel of communication is maintained with management at all levels to ensure operational difficulties are focused on by the relevant expert and that problems are anticipated early and are solved in a timely manner

 Interface with Project Team to integrate Piping Commissioning Schedule into Project Schedule

 Prepare Progress monitoring tools for Pre-commissioning & Commissioning Preparation and Execution

 Identify and prepare all type of operational and organizational documents related to interfaces with other parties (both external and internal)

 Review of all pre-commissioning & commissioning documentation, procedures, engineering drawings, method statements, equipment, and proposed execution planning.

 Supervise and/or populate data base for Piping Pre-commissioning & Commissioning

 Prepare SS numbering and limit drawing with regards to Piping Pre-commissioning & Commissioning

 Review and/or approval of engineering documents and drawings produced by Contractors

 Ensure all Contractors Piping engineering and related documentation is produced in a timely fashion and in accordance with the project Contract

 Manage commissioning execution in a view to reach the targets with priorities in Safety, Quality and Schedule. Coordinate daily site activities with other parties.

 Mobilize and manage commissioning resources identified during Pre-commissioning & Commissioning preparation.

 Ensure regular preservation is performed & recorded for all equipment’s.

 Close liaison with EACOP for executing & approving relevant systems in Main Control Room.

 Ensure “TotalEnergies Referentiel” is implemented throughout TILENGA Project for all process & piping discipline related activities and liaise with metier as required.

 Ensure contractor spading & isolation plans are in line with company specification for SIMOPS operation & safe commissioning execution.

Context and environment

There is no equivalent project of such an industrial drilling magnitude in a remote and sensitive area within the Group today. The Tilenga oilfields are partly situated in a protected National Park, partly beneath the river Nile wetlands area, and within densely populated area in a rural and remote part of Uganda. Activities exposed to the risk of major incidents with severe potential consequences due to local environment and important presence of NGO’s. Factory Drilling with a well delivered every 4 days using 3 drilling rigs simultaneously will necessitate standardization of equipment and procedures, strict enforcement of Drilling & Well instructions, safe and efficient logistic management on site. The project is focused on delivering the lowest possible cost, which requires challenging TOTAL design concepts as well as substantially challenging the TOTAL referential.

Multicultural environment: Contractors are anticipated to be located in various parts of the world. Ugandan rules and regulations, administrative requirements and technical authorizations as well as international codes for onshore plant will apply. The project FID was signed on Q1-2022 with a start of drilling operations on Q2 2022 and a Ready for Start-up (RFSU) target of July 2026.

Accountabilities

 As a Piping Process Commissioning Engineer, the job holder will be required to anticipate or identify problem areas or potential areas of conflict (within company or between company and contractor) and effect resolution.

 To provide process & piping technical assistance/support during pre-commissioning and commissioning preparation activities during engineering phase and to directly supervise process & piping commissioning activities during commissioning execution phase on the site.

 Report to the management by identifying any actual or future slippage or blocking points in work progress.

 To ensure that all piping safety pre-requisites are in place before performing any pre-commissioning checks and/or commissioning tests

 To liaise with Construction team and witness all piping pre-commissioning activities.

 Be a leader to prepare & execute multidiscipline Operation Test Procedures (OTP’s).

 Ability to communicate with different Package representatives and ensure effective liaison between all parties.

Qualifications/Experience required

Qualification: Bachelors’ degree or equivalent diploma

Experience

 Minimum 10 years’ experience in the Oil and Gas industry with good knowledge of piping pre-commissioning and commissioning.

 Hands on experience on Piping flushing, cleaning, gauging, dewatering, drying, and inerting

 Management capability to effectively and safely lead a commissioning team of contractors and vendors towards successful project completion.

 Good communication skills and a team player able to function under the pressure of tight working deadlines.

 Able to manage a multitude of parallel and critical tasks by setting priorities to achieve the overall objectives

 Strong knowledge in TOTAL commissioning methodology OPERCOM™ and tool ICAPS©.

 Valid Medical Certificate which complies with Company standards.

Duration & Location

Location

Site, Buliisa, Uganda

Activities

• Strict application of TotalEnergies Company HSE rules and procedures and pro-activity on this matter by participating actively to the “stop card” system and by reporting all incident or potentially dangerous situation.

• Perform well data quality control and validation at the wellsite.

• Predict and evaluate the geological hazards such as formation pressure, gains, losses, caving, differential sticking, acid gas, swelling clay, shallow gas, etc.

• Detect reservoirs and evaluate the fluid content (quick look interpretation).

• Ensure correct data communication at the well site by reporting in due times any event with potential consequence on the project achievement.

• Supervise all well data acquisitions such as mudlogging, LWD, electrical logging, coring, solid and fluid sampling (cuttings, cores, side wall cores, gas, oil, formation water, mud, etc), pressure measurements, VSP, etc in accordance with the well data acquisition program as defined in the WSOR.

• Contribute to the full data recovery on rig site and participate to the complete and pertinent reporting and well data flow from the rig to the company’s operation representative (Operation Geologist Coordinator on site).

• Supervise contractor performance for all the services associated with geological operations i.e. mudlogging, MWD-LWD, wireline and pipe conveyed logging. This supervision should include the check of quality and reliability of equipment, necessary spare parts and consumables and the performance of the crew.

• Contribute, periodically or at reception of a new mudlogging/wireline unit, to technical audits to verify the compliance of contractor equipment and personnel to the contractual terms and conditions.

• Participate to the supervision and verification of the labelling, conditioning and shipment of samples and of all documents and reports issued by contractors.

• Work closely with any other supervisors, notably the drilling and mud supervisors, appointed by company in order to form a cohesive and efficient team.

• Organize and/or participate actively to pre-job meetings before each special operation such as wireline logging, open hole tests, etc...

• Actively participate to technical reports such as the Final Geological Well Reports or to any report related to the use of new technology or when uncommon environmental or operational conditions are encountered (REX).

Activities

 Strict application of TotalEnergies Company HSE rules and procedures and pro-activity on this matter by participating actively to the “stop card” system and by reporting all incident or potentially dangerous situation.

 Perform well data quality control and validation at the wellsite.

 Predict and evaluate the geological hazards such as formation pressure, gains, losses, caving, differential sticking, acid gas, swelling clay, shallow gas, etc.

 Detect reservoirs and evaluate the fluid content (quick look interpretation).

 Ensure correct data communication at the well site by reporting in due times any event with potential consequence on the project achievement.

 Supervise all well data acquisition such as mudlogging, LWD, electrical logging, coring, solid and fluid sampling (cuttings, cores, side wall cores, gas, oil, formation water, mud, etc), pressure measurements, VSP, etc in accordance with the well data acquisition program as defined in the WSOR.

 Ensure full well data recovery on rig site and guarantee complete and pertinent reporting and well data flow from the rig to the company’s operation representative (Operation Geologist Coordinator on site).

 Supervise contractor performance for all the services associated to geological operations i.e. mudlogging, MWD-LWD, wireline and pipe conveyed logging. This supervision shall include the check of quality and reliability of equipment, necessary spare parts and consumables and the performance of the crew.

 Realize, periodically or at reception of a new mudlogging/wireline unit, of technical audits to verify the compliance of contractor equipment and personnel to the contractual terms and conditions.

 Supervise and verify the labelling, conditioning and shipment of samples and of all documents and reports issued by contractors.

 Work closely with any other supervisors, notably the drilling and mud supervisors, appointed by company in order to form a cohesive and efficient team.

 Organize and/or participate actively to pre-job meetings before each special operation such as wireline logging, open hole tests, etc...

 Mentor junior/trainee well site geologists and therefore contribute to the development of operations geology skills especially for local new professionals.

 Actively participate to technical reports such as the Final Geological Well Reports or to any report related to the use of a new technology or when uncommon environmental or operational conditions are encountered (REX).

Context and environment

There is no equivalent project of such an industrial drilling magnitude in a remote and sensitive area within the Company today.

A Green Field Project, the Tilenga field is to be found in a remote location in UGANDA near lake Albert with particularly sensitive environmental conditions.

A challenging project: heavy and waxy oils produced from 31 drilling pads, (with some of them located in a national park) and treated in a Production Center of 200,000bopd oil capacity and 650,000 bld of water treatment capacity. Reservoir pressure maintenance is ensured either by water injection or by polymer water injection depending on the reservoir’s characteristics. The project also includes an extended interconnecting network with temperature preservation.

Multicultural environment: Contractors are anticipated to be in various parts of the world. Ugandan rules and regulations, administrative requirements and technical authorizations as well as international codes for onshore plant will apply.

Accountabilities

The Senior Wellsite Geologist is responsible for:

• Ensuring on the rig site that all geological operations are carried out in strict respect of the HSE regulations

• Ensuring on the rig site that the operations are performed in accordance with the well objectives as defined during the WSOR process.

• Contributing actively to the well safety through proper implementation of real time detection techniques of drilling hazards.

• Ensuring an accurate and detailed reporting of all matters related to geological operations on the rig site.

• Assuring the pertinence, reliability and quality of the data collected on the rig site.

Steel Fabricator

A fabricator, or fabrication technician, uses specialized equipment and hand tools to make components for large machines and vehicles. Common duties for a fabricator job description include interpreting blueprints and schematics, aligning components for welding and adhering to safety regulations.

In this article, we discuss the duties, responsibilities and background of a fabricator so you can write an effective job description for an open role.

Fabricator duties and responsibilities

Fabricators support the manufacturing process for large machines and vehicles by creating parts and components for final assembly. For example, they may make brackets that assemblers later use to mount car radiators in the engine bay. The role generally involves technical and documentation responsibilities.

Common duties include:

  • Interpreting blueprints, schematics and diagrams for complex machines and vehicles
  • Measuring, marking, cutting, trimming and shaping raw materials like metal
  • Welding, brazing and soldering pieces to create finished parts
  • Aligning parts and connecting them with bolts, screws and other fasteners to make large components
  • Conducting quality checks and identifying and correcting defects
  • Documenting batch numbers, completion times and measurements
  • Inspecting tools and equipment before and after use, and reporting any signs of wear and tear
  • Adhering to all government regulations, organizational policies and industry best practices related to safety and accident prevention

PRINCIPALES MISSIONS & RESPONSABILITÉS - Échafaudeurs

  • Monter et démonter les structures d’échafaudage en toute sécurité conformément aux exigences du projet et aux normes de sécurité.
  • Inspecter les matériaux d’échafaudage (tubes, planches, colliers de serrage, cadres) avant utilisation afin de s’assurer qu’ils sont en bon état et non endommagés.
  • Assembler les différents éléments d’échafaudage tels que les plateformes, garde-corps, contreventements et échelles.
  • S’assurer que les échafaudages sont stables, de niveau et correctement fixés afin de supporter les travailleurs et les matériaux.
  • Suivre les plans techniques, dessins d’ingénierie et procédures de sécurité lors du montage des échafaudages.
  • Effectuer des inspections régulières des structures d’échafaudage pendant toute la durée du projet afin de garantir leur sécurité et leur stabilité.
  • Étiqueter correctement les échafaudages (conforme pour utilisation, incomplet ou non sécuritaire).
  • Travailler en hauteur en utilisant les équipements de protection appropriés tels que les harnais et les lignes de vie.
  • Collaborer avec les superviseurs, ingénieurs et autres travailleurs du chantier afin de s’assurer que les échafaudages répondent aux besoins du projet.
  • Démonter les échafaudages en toute sécurité une fois les travaux terminés et veiller au stockage adéquat du matériel.

Compétences et expérience minimales requises

  • Bonne connaissance des systèmes et composants d’échafaudage
  • Capacité à lire des plans techniques simples
  • Bonne condition physique, force et sens de l’équilibre
  • Grande attention aux procédures et règles de sécurité
  • Capacité à travailler en hauteur

Rémunération

88,50 USD brut par jour

Organisation du travail

Rotation : 16 semaines consécutives de travail, suivies de 3 semaines de congé non payées

Horaire : 13 jours / 14 – 10 heures par jour

Main duties and responsibilities of the role

  • Erect and dismantle scaffolding structures safely according to project requirements and safety standards.
  • Inspect scaffolding materials (tubes, boards, couplers, frames) before use to ensure they are safe and not damaged.
  • Assemble scaffolding components such as platforms, guardrails, braces, and ladders.
  • Ensure scaffolding is stable, level, and properly secured to support workers and materials.
  • Follow engineering drawings, plans, and safety procedures when building scaffolds.
  • Perform routine inspections of scaffolding structures during the project to ensure ongoing safety and stability.
  • Tag scaffolding appropriately (safe for use, incomplete, or unsafe).
  • Work at heights using proper fall protection equipment such as harnesses and lifelines.
  • Collaborate with supervisors, engineers, and other construction workers to ensure scaffolds meet the needs of the project.
  • Dismantle scaffolding safely once work is completed and ensure materials are stored properly.

Minimum skills & experience selection requirements of suitable candidates

  • Knowledge of scaffolding systems and components
  • Ability to read basic technical drawings Physical strength and balance
  • Attention to safety procedures
  • Ability to work at height

Remuneration

USD 88,50 gross/ per day

Work Schedule: **16 consecutive weeks**, followed by **3 weeks of leave**. Schedule: **6 days per week – 8 hours per day**.

PRINCIPALES MISSIONS & RESPONSABILITÉS – Superviseurs Échafaudage

  • Veiller à ce que des évaluations des risques soient effectuées avant le début de tout travail pouvant exposer le personnel à des dangers.
  • S'assurer que les employés qui montent, démontent ou modifient des échafaudages sont formés, compétents et autorisés à appliquer les exigences de la procédure.
  • Vérifier que les qualifications et certifications de formation sont à jour et planifier les formations de recyclage avant les dates d’expiration.
  • Utiliser uniquement les équipements approuvés et veiller à leur utilisation correcte.
  • Inspecter tout l’équipement avant le début des travaux.
  • Effectuer des évaluations des risques avant chaque intervention.
  • Mettre en place un système de sauvetage sécurisé en cas de chute de hauteur.
  • Veiller à ce que tous les équipements soient correctement stockés et entretenus.
  • Inspecter régulièrement les équipements d’échafaudage avant et après leur utilisation.
  • Tenir à jour un registre électronique des échafaudages sur le chantier.
  • Assurer l’entretien et la réparation des équipements d’échafaudage conformément aux programmes de maintenance, aux spécifications des fabricants et aux normes du site.

• Act as the primary focal point for all technical interfaces between civil/structural teams and other disciplines (electrical, instrumentation, mechanical, piping, HSE, QA/QC, logistics, etc.).

• Lead and organise interface meetings, ensuring that issues are identified early, tracked, and resolved efficiently.

• Manage and develop civil/structural engineering and supervision teams.

• Foster teamwork and collaboration across disciplines. Context and environment

• The project entity is a multinational joint venture with a significant social performance component and is project-financed by high-profile lenders.

• Afungi Site is extremely remote in Northern Mozambique, with unreliable infrastructure and communications.

• The site is subject to mitigation measures for malaria and general security risks.

• Rotational position (4 weeks on 4 weeks off) Accountabilities

• Ensure the technical integrity and compliance of all civil/structural works up to commissioning.

• Supervise all civil/structural teams on site.

• Take responsibility for proactive interface management between disciplines and contractors.

• Report to project management and stakeholders. Qualifications/Experience required

• Minimum 12–15 years’ experience managing major industrial projects, ideally in oil & gas or LNG.

• Proven experience in multidisciplinary team management and supervision of complex construction sites.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); Portuguese or French is an advantage.

• Strong leadership, analytical skills, and decision-making ability in a multicultural, high-pressure environment.

• Excellent HSE culture and risk management awareness.

• Demonstrated skills in interface management and leading interdisciplinary coordination meetings.

Job Overview (Internal Recruitment)

The Operations Coordinator would be responsible to lead, monitor and implement the operational activities for Aldelia in the location specified. The person shall be a self-starter with the ability to work autonomously.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in creating, growing, and supporting the business entity.
  • Oversee daily operations of the entity and the work of relative departments.
  • Partner with the finance team to achieve favourable financial results with respect to sales, profitability, cash flow, systems, reporting and controls.
  • Ensure the office is running at full operational capacity.
  • Forge strategic partnerships and relationships with clients, vendors, and all other professional business relationships.
  • Manage relationship with major stakeholders (clients, partners, Group) in term of daily operations.
  • Manage all operations related to rotation system
  • Implements and ensures the application of all procedures related to the safety of our employees on site (onboarding, QHSE induction…)
  • Manage the planning, administering, implementation and controlling of weekly budgets for office operations purposes.
  • Improving operational management systems, processes and best practices whilst implementing the right practices in Aldelia in the specific location to improve performance.
  • Providing general support to line management to enhance efficiency as directed.

Key Relationships/ Stakeholders

External

  • Clients
  • Vendors/providers
  • Partners

Internal

  • Line Management
  • Contractors
  • Employees
  • Other Departments

Person Specification

Preferred Experience and Education

  • Bachelor’s degree qualified ideally in Social Sciences, Business Administration, Humanities, and Logistics etc.
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience in team management and project management is required for this role.
  • Familiarity with business and financial principles is essential.

Language Requirements

  • Proficiency in English and French is required.

Skills

  • Demonstrate high level of autonomy, fast thinking, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to think outside the box is a great advantage.
  • Demonstrate high level of interpersonal, analytical, and writing skills to effectively communicate.
  • Ability to think from a business perspective and make basic decisions on behalf of the company.
  • Demonstrate high level of proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Demonstrable competency in strategic planning and business development
  • Outstanding organizational and leadership abilities
  • Excellent interpersonal and public speaking skills

Behaviours:

  • Performance, Efficiency, Teamwork, Diligence, Congeniality.

•    Vacancy: Principal Installation Method Engineer/Principal Project Engineer (Installation Methods)

•    Mission duration: 12 months

•    Starting date: ASAP

•    Location: Paris Office – With offshore trips to vessels and potential visits to sites such as fabrication yards, etc.

•    Additional notes:

  1. Candidates will ideally have experience in Rigid Pipelay projects and as a minimum a clear understanding of subsea pipeline installation methods.
  2. Preferably with EU work permit or residency.

We are looking for a Principal Project Engineer (Installation Methods) under Pipeline Group (PG) team at Paris office.

Your role will involve working in, or leading, a diverse team of installation engineers, coordinating various methods of pipeline installation for work assignments on global projects either in progress or in the process of tendering. You will support the efficient day-to-day running of the installation engineering team and provide regular operational reports on general project engineering activities, technical subject matters, and resource management.

 

This will be a varied role but some of the main responsibilities will be:

 

  • Supporting, or leading, a team of method engineers to follow project scope(s) from early engagement with our internal and external clients through to offshore execution on board our reel lay/S lay or J Lay assets.
  • You’ll be a be a technical reference for pipeline installation and contribute to the sub-contractors selection.
  • Produce installation method statements and procedures, support procurement activities and subcontract follow up, proactively support HSEQ activities and prepare and deliver technical presentations.
  • Installation rigging calculations and rigging design.
  • Assist Tendering department with feasibility studies, method statements, manhour estimates, schedule inputs and costing support.
  • Supporting installation aid procurement, fabrication and testing follow up.
  • Follow your scope offshore on our installation vessels.

 

What experience would we like you to have?

  • Degree qualified in Engineering/Marine/Naval/Offshore Technology / Civil / Mechanical or equivalent
  • Extensive experience as a project engineer, the majority of this from within the offshore energy industry.
  • Experience in Leading engineering teams
  • Experience, or an understanding of, offshore pipeline installation methods, ideally within the reel lay discipline (i.e., Reel Lay, J-Lay, S-Lay)
  • Experience of guiding and leading teams of engineers in project scopes
  • You should be a clear communicator, able to speak with all levels within the business, who is comfortable working on their own and as part of a team

des opérations / Agribusiness"},"description":{"1":"

MISSIONS

  • Le Responsable des Opérations de l’abattoir supervise l’ensemble des activités quotidiennes de l’unité de production. Il garantit la conformité aux normes d’hygiène et de sécurité, optimise la performance opérationnelle, assure la qualité des produits et pilote les équipes. Le rôle requiert une solide expérience dans les opérations d’abattoir ou de transformation de viande, un leadership affirmé, ainsi qu’une maîtrise des processus techniques et réglementaires du secteur.

RESPONSABILITES

  • Superviser les opérations quotidiennes : réception, abattage, éviscération, découpe, conditionnement, refroidissement et expédition.
  • Garantir le respect du flux de production et de la continuité des opérations.
  • Suivre et analyser les indicateurs clés (KPI) : rendement, productivité, pertes, temps d’arrêt.
  • Coordonner la maintenance des équipements pour éviter les interruptions de production.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes qualité, les vétérinaires officiels et les autorités sanitaires.
  • Encadrer et animer les équipes de production, maintenance, qualité et logistique.
  • Former les équipes aux bonnes pratiques, procédures et standards de sécurité.
  • Organiser les plannings et assurer une gestion optimale des ressources humaines.
  • Coordonner avec l’approvisionnement, la logistique et les ventes pour assurer une chaîne fluide.
  • Gérer les stocks de matières premières, produits finis et consommables.

Efficacité stratégique

  • Contribuer à la stratégie opérationnelle de l’abattoir et aux plans d’investissement.
  • Proposer et mettre en œuvre des innovations techniques ou organisationnelles.
  • Renforcer la compétitivité, la fiabilité et la durabilité des opérations.

Efficacité operationnelle

  • Exécution fluide et disciplinée des opérations quotidiennes.
  • Coordination efficace entre production, maintenance, qualité et supply chain.
  • Reporting régulier des KPI et des performances opérationnelles.
  • Gestion proactive des incidents et résolution rapide des problèmes.

Efficacité organisationnelle

  • Développement d’une culture de rigueur, de sécurité et d’amélioration continue.
  • Mise en place et maintien de procédures opérationnelles standardisées (SOP).
  • Gestion optimale des équipes et développement des compétences.
  • Collaboration transversale efficace avec les autres départements.

COMPETENCES

  • Bac+5 en Production, Industrie Agroalimentaire, Sciences Animales, Qualité, Génie Industriel ou équivalent.
  • 10 à 15 ans d’expérience en gestion d’abattoir ou industrie de la viande / agroalimentaire.
  • Expérience confirmée dans la gestion d’équipes à forte intensité opérationnelle
  • Excellente connaissance des procédés d’abattage et de transformation.
  • Maîtrise des normes HACCP, ISO 22000, BPH, BPF, bien‑être animal.
  • Compétences en gestion de production, planification et analyse de KPI.
  • Bonne compréhension de la maintenance industrielle et du fonctionnement des équipements.
  • Leadership fort et capacité à gérer des équipes nombreuses.
  • Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et discipline personnelle.
  • Capacité à travailler sous pression dans un environnement exigeant.
  • Esprit d’analyse, prise de décision rapide et sens des responsabilités.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication.

Main duties and responsibilities of the role

Dimension The job holder is a part of the company Maintenance team and will report directly to the Instrumentation and ICSS Lead Engineer. They shall work as part of the Instrumentation discipline for the facilities preparing operational maintenance activities (procedure, contracts, spare parts requirements) for instruments and controls systems ensuring that they are technically accurate and can be executed in a safe and efficient manner in the production phase. They shall develop their understanding of the operational requirements and the discipline to be ready to support operations at start-up. After start up, he shall ensure support to site on all topics related to Instrumentation and Controls. He shall also ensure the continuous training of Instrumentation and ICSS Junior engineer. Reporting line in organization Lead ICSS/Instrument Engineer Activities Project Phase: · Participate to the review of documents and files in the Electronic Data Management System issued by the EPC to ensure they are of sufficient quality to be utilized for MIE activities and by Maintenance Personnel onsite during the Operational phase. · Participate in inter-discipline MIE activities including maintenance and criticality strategy development, global maintenance plan preparation, writing of maintenance plans and procedures. Ensure that all MIE deliverables are in line with National Legislation, Affiliate and COMPANY Specifications and Best practices. · Prepare complex site maintenance procedures for the testing of Safety Instrumented Functions (SIF) prepared with site supervision, ensuring incorporation of best practice. · Take active role into the Operating spare parts selection process and procurement activities and assist Spare Parts Coordinator as required with the detailed spares requirement per equipment, inspection, shipment, delivery, and storage of spares in COMPANY warehouse(s). · Participate in the review of documents and files in the Electronic Data Management System created and issued by the MIE Spares Contractor. · Ensure adequate preparation, review and validation of the Maintenance dossiers · Preparation of Company Management System (CMS) documents within area of responsibility · Attend SAT/FATs at vendor premises as required · Assistance with the Commissioning/start up teams and Production/Maintenance/Inspection COMPANY teams as required. · Develop Digital Tools and applications to that are required to effectively manage maintenance operations post Startup · Patriciate to development of affiliate procedures related to Industrial Cyber Security in accordance with Company Rules. · Develop technical Scopes of Work for Specialized Maintenance Contracts (SMCs) and be the technical duet for the Call for Tender process. Operational Phase (additional to Project activities) : · Provide specialist technical/engineering advice and guidance to site personnel on the operation and maintenance of instrument and control system equipment ensuring highest safety standards, a timely response to queries and minimal disruption to operations. · Ensure all instrument and controls equipment are maintained and kept in optimum working condition · Ensure a constant follow up of equipment regarding their obsolescence and prepare any required upgrade · Contribute to the ongoing monitoring of strategies for the maintenance and operation of plant/equipment to ensure that all plant and equipment meet verification and compliance requirements · Proactively monitor, review and analyze plant and equipment performance using Digital Tools and provide feedback to Line Management, identifying opportunities to maximize production and performance and share best practice · Ensure the Condition Based Maintenance is used to maximize Instrument equipment availability whilst maintaining the technical integrity of the equipment. · Prepare scopes of work for vendor services and repairs, make recommendations on preferred contractor

Minimum skills & experience selection requirements of suitable candidates

Qualifications/Experience required Qualification: · Degree in Instrumentation and Control engineering from an accredited university or equivalent. Experience: · Minimum 8 years’ experience in Instrument and Controls systems and maintenance in the Oil & Gas environment, two years of which must have been spent working on an operational plant. · A good working knowledge of office software packages such as Excel, and preferably experienced in a CMIMS (e.g. SAP, MAXIMO) · Good written and oral communication and interpersonal skills · Must have good working knowledge of codes and standards used in the industry (NEC, NEMA, ISO, IEC, ATEX, NORSOK, ASME, ASTM, API, ANSI etc…) · Awareness of current legislation and practices with respect to plant operation and compliance reporting · Fluent English is mandatory

Entreprise dédiée au financement et à l’accompagnement du secteur privé, est présente à l’international via un réseau de directions régionales. Elle est l’une des principales institutions financières au service du secteur privé et du développement durable.

La Direction Régionale Afrique de l’Ouest (DRAO) de l'entreprise est organisée autour d’un hub principal à Abidjan et de 3 antennes principales (Dakar, Accra et Cotonou). L’activité de la DRAO est organisée de manière sectorielle, par pôle d’activité et géographies. La DRAO intervient sur une palette large d’instruments et dans tous les secteurs d’intervention de l'entreprise. La DRAO est en charge des activités de prospection, de représentation et de suivi de portefeuille de la zone.

Au sein du pôle Institutions Financière et Inclusion, les chargés d’affaires contribuent au renforcement de l’offre des institutions financière ouest africaines en apportant des financements, du capital et des outils de partage de risques aux banques et institutions de microfinance. Elle dispose d’un portefeuille de garantie conséquent en Afrique de l’Ouest avec une dizaine de partenaires bancaires actifs et plusieurs centaines de millions d’euros d’encours.

L’activité de garanties consiste pour elle à partager le risque de crédit avec des institutions financières partenaires (banques, institutions de microfinance, sociétés de leasing, etc.), afin de faciliter le financement de segments prioritaires (PME, agriculture, climat, genre, infrastructures, etc.). Elle implique un suivi opérationnel, financier et contractuel rigoureux des portefeuilles garantis.

Quel sera votre rôle ?

Sous la supervision de la Direction Régionale et en lien étroit avec les Chargés d’Affaires du pôle FII, vous assurez le middle office de l’activité de garantie afin de contribuer au bon fonctionnement opérationnel, financier et administratif des opérations de garanties portées par la Direction Régionale Afrique de l’Ouest.

Vos missions principales seront les suivantes :

1. Support aux institutions financières partenaires

  • Assurer la formation continue des clients sur l’utilisation des garanties et les obligations de reporting ;
  • Accompagner les partenaires dans la préparation et la fiabilisation des reportings ;
  • Veiller à la qualité, la complétude et la conformité des informations transmises.

2. Suivi de la facturation et des commissions

  • S’assurer que les commissions de garantie sont payées dans les délais contractuels en coordination avec les agences AFD des pays d’Afrique de l’Ouest et le Back Office au siège de l'entretien ;
  • Mettre en place un suivi proactif des commissions impayées jusqu’à leur recouvrement ;
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des outils et processus de suivi des paiements.

3. Appui aux Chargés d’Affaires

  • Appuyer la collecte et la complétude des documents nécessaires aux opérations ;
  • Instruction des demandes de Garanties Individuelles (une dizaine de dossier par an)
  • Contribuer au suivi des expositions et des indicateurs de performance des opérations garanties.
  • Réaliser lorsque nécessaire des analyses financières préliminaires (analyse des états financiers, ratios clés, performance) pour les Garanties de portefeuille ;

4. Support au management régional (hors du scope garantie)

  • Créer et maintenir des tableaux de bord de pilotage mensuels (expositions, plan d’affaires, marges) ;
  • Produire des analyses synthétiques à destination du management ;
  • Proposer des améliorations visant à optimiser le pilotage des activités de la DRAO.

Qui recherchons-nous ?

1. Profil recherché

Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur, de commerce ou d’une université avec spécialisation en Finance (analyse financière), vous justifiez d’une expérience en middle office, en tant que gestionnaire de middle office ou assistant(e) chargé(e) d’affaires, au sein d’une institution financière ou d’un fonds de garantie.

Vous disposez de solides compétences en analyse financière, compréhension des mécanismes de crédit et gestion des risques. La maitrise d’Excel et ses fonctionnalités est obligatoire. La maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable.

2. Qualités humaines / relationnelles

Doté(e) d’un excellent relationnel, vous faites preuve de pédagogie et savez accompagner des partenaires financiers. Vous êtes rigoureux(se), organisé(e), orienté(e) solution et proactif(ve). Vous appréciez la polyvalence et démontrez une forte capacitée d’adaptation dans un environnement régional dynamique. Vous êtes force de proposition pour améliorer les outils et les processus existants.

Le poste est basé à Abidjan (Côte d’Ivoire) au sein de la Direction Régionale Afrique de l’Ouest. Des missions ponctuelles dans les pays couverts par la DRAO sont à prévoir.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Inspire safety commitment in all teams, including contractors and subcontractors, by demonstrating deep knowledge of HSE and leading by example.

- Ensure compliance with all relevant HSE requirements to promote a healthy and safe work environment.

- Analyse and report on the performance of contractors and subcontractors, identifying deviations or risks, and propose timely mitigations to the Project Management Team.

- Manage and ensure site works are executed by contractors and their approved subcontractors in accordance with contract agreements.

- Monitor and review contractor-related assurance activities and verification documentation.

- Ensure contractors perform works according to approved plans and procedures.

- Interface with other discipline superintendents, engineers, planners, authorities, contractors, and vendors to meet key contract deliverables.

- Deliverables include safety compliance, environmental management, budget control, project schedule, and adherence to project and national specifications, standards, and practices.

- Gather and validate 'lessons learnt' from the project team and provide feedback.

CONTEXT AND ENVIRONMENT

- The project is part of a multinational joint venture involving significant social performance objectives and project financing by high-profile lenders.

- The site is in a remote location in Northern Mozambique with unreliable infrastructure and communication.

- The position requires adherence to mitigation measures for Malaria, COVID, and general security risks.

- This is a rotational position.

ACCOUNTABILITIES

- Responsible for construction activities within the specified area, collaborating closely with the EPC contractor following project rules and objectives (including HSE, Quality, Schedule, and Cost).

- Coordinate with other departments to ensure safe and timely execution, aiming to deliver a fit-for-purpose facility.

REQUIREMENTS

- Education: Degree or diploma qualification (or equivalent) in a related discipline and/or experience on oil & gas construction projects.

Job Description – Project Manager (Onshore Turbine Installation)

Position: Project Manager – Turbine Installation

Location: Onshore Project Site

Industry: Energy / Oil & Gas / Power Generation

Contract Type: Project-based / EPC Project

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee the installation and commissioning of an onshore turbine within an EPC project environment.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing all phases of the project including engineering coordination, procurement interface, construction supervision, and commissioning activities, ensuring that the project is delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in compliance with contractual and technical requirements.

Fluency in French is mandatory as the role requires coordination with French-speaking stakeholders, contractors, and project teams.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management

  • Lead the execution of the turbine installation project from mobilization to commissioning.
  • Ensure compliance with EPC contract requirements, project specifications, and HSE standards.
  • Develop and monitor project schedules, milestones, and deliverables.

Engineering & Technical Coordination

  • Coordinate engineering interfaces related to turbine installation.
  • Ensure alignment between engineering, procurement, and construction activities.
  • Review technical documentation, drawings, and installation procedures.

Construction & Installation

  • Supervise turbine installation activities on site.
  • Coordinate subcontractors and ensure proper execution of mechanical installation works.
  • Monitor progress and ensure adherence to construction schedules.

Commissioning & Start-up

  • Support turbine commissioning and testing activities.
  • Coordinate with commissioning teams and OEM representatives.
  • Ensure readiness for start-up and performance testing.

HSE & Quality

  • Ensure full compliance with Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality standards.
  • Promote a strong safety culture across all project teams and contractors.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary interface between the client, EPC contractor, and subcontractors.
  • Provide regular reporting on project progress, risks, and mitigation plans.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 10–15 years of experience in project management within the energy or power generation sector.
  • Proven experience in EPC projects involving turbine installation or major rotating equipment.

Required Skills

  • Strong experience in EPC project execution
  • Experience in turbine installation or power generation equipment
  • Solid knowledge of construction management and commissioning processes
  • Excellent leadership and coordination skills
  • Strong problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and contractors.

Languages

  • French: Fluent (mandatory)
  • English: Professional working proficiency

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working on large-scale infrastructure or energy projects
  • Previous experience in Africa or international EPC projects
  • Experience working with OEM turbine manufacturers.

Contexte de la mission

The LCV Pre‑commissioning Engineer will support the Pre‑commissioning Lead in overseeing and assuring all pipeline and umbilical pre‑commissioning activities executed by contractors. The role focuses on technical review, coordination, and ensuring full compliance with COMPANY standards, project specifications, and regulatory requirements. This position is partly based in Paris with extensive rotations onboard the LCV and onshore in Afungi. Offshore, the engineer will work shifts and report to the LCV CSR, with functional reporting to the Pre‑commissioning Lead onshore. Key responsibilities include supervising pipeline pre‑commissioning operations (vacuum pull, MEG filling, flooding, cleaning, gauging, pressure testing, dewatering, drying, nitrogen packing, surveys, and installation/recovery of flooding caps and pig traps) as well as umbilical and optical fiber testing (pre/post‑loadout, installation monitoring, pre/post‑installation tests, and post hook‑up tests) across Phases 0, 1 and 2 via the EPCI Contractor.

Field Engineer / Onshore Works Lead"},"description":{"0":"

Afungi Landfall Field Engineer / Onshore Works Lead – Offshore Delivery Team, Upstream

Situation in organization 

N+1: Afungi Upstream Installation / Construction Manager

N+2: EPCI Installation Manager

Job dimensions

The Landfall Field Engineer / Onshore Works Lead is reporting to the Afungi Upstream Installation/Construction Manager and will oversee the contractors’ onshore activities in Afungi at the Beach Landing Area (BLA) or area A1-29. The scope of responsibilities includes land preparation, excavation, civil works, foundations, pipeline and umbilical pull-ins, onshore pipeline construction, BVS/BCA installation and connection, and all associated works. Some pre-commissioning activities will also be under the Landfall FE scope of work. 

The Contract has a value of circa 2.5 Bn USD and has been awarded in 2019 to a two-member consortium composed of Van Oord Offshore and TechnipFMC. The scope of the infrastructure to be installed under the contract can be summarized as; export pipelines (gas, 22in rigid pipelines), Service line (MEG, 8in and 6in rigid pipelines), rigid jumpers, flexible jumpers, manifolds (and piles), umbilical’s, PLETs / ILTs structures (and foundations), sleepers, mattresses, flying leads and flexible pipe jumpers. 

The job holder is expected to assess, manage, and control the Landfall works of the project and ensure the readiness and preparedness of MTV for these activities. The job holder shall oversee the landfall works activities in line with agreed execution plans and the Project HSEQ management system.

Initially in short missions to MTV offices in the Netherlands, the Landfall Onshore Works Lead is expected to be a 28/28 rotational schedule during the execution of the work in Afungi camp, Mozambique.

Activities

Project Management

•\tProvide management and leadership at the Landfall Works location during all project phases.

•\tEnsure safe, on time and within budget delivery of all Landfall Works related elements of the EPCI scope of work whilst ensuring a high level of quality consistent with a project design life of 30 years.

•\tMonitor and manage all facets of work within the Landfall Works scope of work to ensure that schedule, cost / budget, technical, quality and HSES requirements are, as a minimum, met or improved upon.

•\tBring to earliest attention of the Afungi Upstream Installation / Construction Manager issues which present a significant threat to the Project and in addition offer mitigating measures / work plans.

•\tProvide reporting function towards all stakeholders for the Landfall Work activities.

•\tEnsure that the readiness reviews inclusive of the equipment inspections are prepared and close out of the findings are performed.

•\tEnsure that all Landfall Work activities are performed in compliance with project technical requirements and fit for purpose.

•\tEnsure identification and resolution of detailed interface issues, in conjunction with other managers / senior discipline engineers, in an efficient and cost-effective manner.

Context and environment

Mozambique LNG is a subsea (1,400m) to shore dry gas field development located in the norther part of Mozambique close to the Tanzania border.

The shallow water and dredging scope of work is a section of the project where 3 trunklines, 2 MEG lines and 2 umbilical's come ashore in a pre-dredged trench of some 17 km in length.

Accountabilities

  1. Duration: Permanent
  2. Status: Resident
  3. Work location: Office and occasional site visits
  4. Open to Namibian citizens only

The Social Performance Lead plays a key role in building trust with stakeholders, managing social impacts responsibly, and driving socio-economic development around our operations.

Reporting to the HSSE Manager, this position is ideal for someone who thrives in community-focused work, brings strong engagement and leadership skills, and is committed to leaving a lasting, positive legacy in Namibia.

Activities

Pillar 1 — Stakeholder Engagement

Build trusted, continuous, structured dialogue with stakeholders to support operational acceptability and manage social risks.

Responsibilities:

- Lead the development, update, and implementation of the Stakeholder Engagement Plan (SEP) and Community Relations Plan.

- Conduct and supervise community meetings, consultations, workshops, and bilateral engagements.

- Maintain a robust grievance mechanism: ensure concerns are registered, investigated, resolved, and tracked.

- Support management with culturally appropriate communication and engagement strategies.

- Develop and ensure consistent messaging across all community-facing teams.

- Mentor and supervise Community Liaison Officer(s) / Social Performance Officer(s) to strengthen engagement practices and reporting quality.

Pillar 2 — Impact Management

Identify, assess, and manage social risks and impacts associated with operations and projects. Ensure compliance with Company requirements, local regulations, and international standards.

Responsibilities:

- Oversee and contribute to ESIA-related activities, including fieldwork, surveys, interviews, baseline studies, study review and consultant coordination on social aspects.

- Ensure compliance with Company social performance standards

- Lead the creation and implementation of social performance tools: checklists, templates, KPIs, dashboards.

- Monitor social impacts, non-conformances, risks, and mitigation measures.

- Provide regular social risk assessment updates to the HSSE Manager and relevant departments.

Pillar 3 — Socio-Economic Development

Design and deliver impactful social investment initiatives that support community needs and Company priorities.

Responsibilities:

 Lead development and implementation of the Social Investment Strategy, aligned with community needs and corporate objectives.

 Build partnerships with authorities, NGOs, community organizations, and development agencies.

 Ensure Social Investment projects are implemented effectively, sustainably, within budget, and demonstrate measurable outcomes.

 Review and adapt the Social Investment strategy based on lessons learned and feedback from communities and partners.

 Promote internal and external buy-in for social investment initiatives.

Monitoring, Reporting & Governance

Ensure transparent, accurate, and compliant social performance reporting.

Responsibilities:

- Develop and roll out Social Performance governance procedure aligned with Company standards

- Produce monthly, quarterly and annual Social Performance reports.

- Maintain accurate data and documentation on internal platforms.

- Track stakeholder engagements, grievances, commitments, and community expectations.

- Ensure compliance with internal reporting obligations and regulatory requirements.

- Promote HSE culture and adhere to ethical standards in all community interactions.

Leadership & Collaboration

Provide strong leadership to the Social Performance team and ensure seamless coordination across Company departments.

Responsibilities:

- Supervise and develop the Social Performance team, including Community Liaison Officer(s) / Social Performance Officer(s).

- Collaborate closely with all internal teams to ensure consistency throughout the Company.

- Represent the company in high-level engagements with authorities, NGOs/CSOs, communities, and institutional partners.

- Support internal capacity building on Social Performance principles, tools and best practices.

Other:

- Full respect for confidentiality in all matters

- HSE: actively participates in trainings, respects and applies internal HSE policies, reports on all anomalies, promotes HSE culture with stakeholders.

Accountabilities

- Deliver high-quality Social Performance across the 3 pillars.

- Accountable for grievance mechanism implementation, ensuring follow-up.

- Ensure social studies are performed in compliance with company requirements, local regulation and international best practices

- Accountable for the social investment strategy and meeting pre-defined social investment objectives from a developmental and a business perspective.

- Supervises and develops the Community Liaison Officer(s) / Social Performance Officer(s).

- Accountable for social performance monitoring and reporting in compliance with company requirements, local regulation and international best practices

- Contribute to the company’s positive legacy in its host communities and regions, through the successful implementation of the social investment initiatives.

Requirements:

- Post graduate qualification in a relevant discipline, e.g. Community Development/ Sustainability/ Anthropology/ Sociology/Communication/Social sciences

- A minimum of 15 years’ professional experience in social investment and stakeholder management either for an international development agency or within industry, including:

o Development and implementation of stakeholder engagement plan and community relation plan

o Engaging stakeholders to understand development needs and opportunities

o Identifying and recruiting implementing partners for social investment programs

o Implementing and monitoring social investment programs
