Summary:

Project induced in-migration (PIIM) is a phenomenon associated with the development of large-scale projects including extractive industries. The MozLNG Project has developed a Project Induced In-migration Management Plan that seeks to contribute to the effective management of the positive and negative impacts of in-migration, addressing areas such as spatial planning, urban planning, community health and village-level governance to manage change. The Project Induced In-migration Program Coordinator will assume primary responsibility for the field delivery of the PIIM Plan and oversight of implementation partners. The post holder is responsible for ensuring the field coordination and delivery of PIIM programs and represent the Project in the field in all matters related to PIIM Management Plan.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as primary point of contact for PIIM stakeholder engagement and program delivery in Palma District.
  • Build relations with District government departments to ensure awareness and understanding of PIIM and promote timely government leadership in addressing PIIM issues.
  • Organize, attend and participate in the multi stakeholder meetings at district level.
  • Documenting and following up on important actions and decisions from meetings.
  • Ensure stakeholder views at the district level are managed towards the best solution.
  • Participate in meetings with communities and households, as required.
  • Review and provide inputs to the implementation partners’ execution strategies, plans and procedures and monitor how successfully they are being executed.
  • Manage IPs (Implementing Partners) implementing the assessments and programs under PIIM.
  • Ensuring that IPs adhere to frameworks and all documentation is maintained appropriately for each program.
  • Coordinate program activities with inter-related activities of other programs, departments or staff to ensure optimum efficiency and compliance with appropriate policies, procedures and specifications.
  • Produce progress reports on the IP implementation of programs under PIIM.
  • Work with Social Performance Monitoring & Evaluation to collect data and measure the progress of the implementation of the PIIM programs.
  • Management of the IPs that will be delivering the agricultural, fisheries and diversified livelihood re-establishment programs.
  • Act as focal point between IPs, the Project, Government, affected households and the wider community.
  • Track fulfillment of fisheries livelihood obligations and advise the livelihood supervisor of adaptive implementation management required.
  • Conduct random field visits to monitor program implementation.
  • Build relations with District and Provincial governments to ensure awareness and understanding of PIIM and promote timely government leadership in addressing PIIM issues.
  • Define relevant Scopes of Work, identify and contract potential implementation partners to deliver key programs.

Qualifications:

  • University degree in social sciences or other relevant areas (e.g., Sociology, Rural Development, Agronomy, Community Development, etc.).
  • At least 5 years of relevant working experience in the development field, preferably in one or more areas of PIIM management, including spatial planning, urban planning, community health and/or community capacity building.
  • Good project management skills and results driven.
  • Field experience with large scale extractive industries preferred.
  • Experience in working in remote areas of Mozambique.
  • Experience of working under international standards and lender’s requirements.

Status: Fixed term contract

Duration: To be discussed

Start: ASAP

Location: Office, Accra, Ghana

Qualifications:

BSc Engineering Discipline or Equivalent Vocational Qualifications

10 years' experience in a similar role within the offshore Oil and Gas industry, with demonstrated involvement in non-routine maintenance, major works, or campaign-based execution activities.

Strong working knowledge of FPSO systems and operations, including topsides, marine, utilities, and supporting infrastructure, and an understanding of the operational constraints associated with offshore execution.

Broad understanding of multi-discipline trade knowledge provided by maintenance and execution contractors, enabling effective review and challenge of proposed execution methodologies.

Sound understanding of applicable industry standards and codes, including those relevant to company operations and offshore oil and gas facilities (e.g. API, ABS, ASME, and other recognised international standards).

Experience in brownfield modifications or life-extension works on operating assets

Experience supporting classification society or regulatory-driven scopes (ABS, Special Surveys, etc.).

Proven ability to review and assess job plans and work packs for completeness, constructability, and execution readiness

Experience working with Computerised Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), including participation in job plan development, work order execution, and planning processes; IBM Maximo experience is considered a strong asset.

Demonstrated ability to work effectively under tight deadlines, manage change in a dynamic execution environment, and maintain planning and operational discipline.

Experience interfacing with multiple contractors and vendors, including technical clarification, mobilisation planning, and execution readiness alignment.

Duties:

Accountable for the technical planning and development of complete, execution-ready work packs for assigned non-routine maintenance and major works scopes, in accordance with the approved intervention strategy and asset plans.

This role is a planning function, not a scheduling role. The Major Works Engineer is responsible for defining scope, developing detailed task methodologies, identifying technical requirements, assessing risks, specifying materials and services, and ensuring all engineering, logistical, and contractor interfaces are fully prepared to enable safe and efficient offshore execution. While alignment with the integrated schedule is required, the primary accountability is the quality and completeness of planning deliverables, not the production of schedules.

The role ensures execution readiness within the 28-day and 120-day planning horizons by preparing comprehensive, multi-discipline work packs that include technical documentation, job step breakdowns, resource requirements, materials take-offs, vendor support, permits, risk assessments, and defined hold points. This includes both planned campaign scopes and emergent or ad-hoc interventions.

Acting as the single point of contact for assigned scopes, the Major Works Engineer ensures that all prerequisites are in place before offshore mobilisation, eliminating avoidable rework, execution delays, and safety risk. The position requires close coordination engineering, supply chain, logistics, offshore execution teams, and contractors to ensure that scope definition is robust, risks are identified and mitigated, and work can be executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved plans.

Job Overview (Internal Recruitment)

The Business Development Manager would be directly responsible for the overall building of Aldelia’s market position in the country assigned, developing, defining, negotiating, and closing business relationships whilst achieving measurable financial growth for the company.

The person must have a thorough knowledge of the market, have the capacity to strategically plan and execute BD KPI’s. The person must have the ability to identify Aldelia’s untapped potentials and be able to develop unique selling propositions for the company in the marketplace. The person must be willing to network, pitch and convince potential clients to do business with the company. The person must possess reporting, business forecasting, presentation skills and can develop reports and work processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. To define long-term organizational business strategic goals, build customer relationships with existing clients, identify new business opportunities, negotiate, and close business deals and maintain extensive knowledge of current market conditions.
  2. Carry out extensive market survey, mapping and provide detailed report on trends.
  3. Responsible to increase sales opportunities and maximize revenue for the organization.
  4. Identify potential new customers, nurture them, and ultimately convert them into clients, and continue to grow the portfolio.
  5. Network, pitch and convince potential clients to do business with the company.
  6. Research and identify new business opportunities - including new markets, growth areas, trends, customers, partnerships, products and services - or new ways of reaching existing markets
  7. Responsible to grow and retain existing accounts by presenting new solutions and services to clients.
  8. At the fore front of developing the pipeline of new business coming into the company, responsible to prospect potential new clients and turn them into paying clients.
  9. Participate in pricing, quotations for clients and prospects as well as being familiar with policies and regulation in industries of interest to Aldelia’s business.
  10. Attend industry functions, such as association events and chamber of commerce conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  11. Present to and consult with senior level management on business trends, potentials, pipeline, targets and forecast.
  12. Track and record activity on accounts and help to close deals to meet business targets.
  13. Work with the operations team to ensure that prerequisites (like prequalification or getting on a client’s vendor list) are fulfilled within a timely manner.

Key Relationships/ Stakeholders

External

  • Clients
  • Chamber of commerce’s
  • Government regulatory bodies

Internal

  • Line Management
  • Contractors
  • Employees
  • Foreign Aldelia Offices

Person Specification

Preferred Experience and Education

  • Bachelor’s degree qualified ideally in Social Sciences, Business Administration and Humanities. Membership of a relevant Professional body is desirable.
  • 10 years of relevant experience.
  • A Masters or MBA is an added advantage.

Language Requirements

  • Full Proficiency in English is required.

Skills

  • Demonstrate high level of interpersonal, writing skills, presentation and effectively communicate skills.
  • Must be familiar with assigned country’s consulting environment.
  • Must have high knowledge of excel reporting, forecasting, business tools usage and Microsoft office.
  • Demonstrate high level of proficiency in pricing, quotation and proposal drafting • Can identify, allocate and monitor resources effectively and efficiently.
  • Can consistently meet competing demands through effective prioritising in a result oriented and client-focused environment.
  • Impeccable negotiation skills and a calculative risk taker.
  • Demonstrates emotional intelligence, leadership, and soft skills attributes.
  • Networking, Persuasion, Prospecting, Public Speaking, Research, Writing, Closing Skills, Identification of Customer Needs and Challenges, Territory Management, Market Knowledge and Meeting Sales Goals.
  • Good understanding of the businesses' products or services and be able to influence others about them.
  • Experience in the use of CRM, and clients/candidates’ databases.

Behaviours:

Performance, Efficiency, Teamwork, Diligence, Congeniality, Analytical, Organized

Job Overview (Internal Recruitment)

The Operations and Administrative Officer will support the Operations Manager to ensure the efficient day-to-day operations of the company.

He/ She will support in administrative, HR, and operational processes related to recruitment and manpower outsourcing services in Uganda, to ensure compliance with National Policies & Regulations, Ugandan labor laws, client requirements, and internal policies.

Responsibilities

1. Operations & Outsourcing Support

  • Support onboarding and deployment of outsourced staff to client sites
  • Request and administer employment contracts (fixed-term, outsourcing, secondment)
  • Support probation confirmations, contract renewals, and disciplinary documentation
  • Support tracking attendance, leave, and absenteeism for outsourced staff
  • Maintain updated staff records (NIN, CVs, certificates, medicals where applicable)
  • Track contract start/end dates and staff assignments per client
  • Support booking/modification/cancellation of flight ticket for staff
  • Act as first point of contact for outsourced staff on administrative matters
  • Coordinate staff exits, replacements, and redeployments

2. HR & Recruitment Administration

  • Support recruitment activities (interview scheduling, background checks, reference checks, documentation)

3. Payroll & Statutory Compliance

  • Support in submission of payroll inputs (timesheets, overtime, allowances, deductions)
  • Support reconciliation of payroll vs client billing
  • Liaise with finance on salary payments and payroll-related queries

4. Labor Law & Compliance

  • Support maintain compliance with the Uganda Employment Act (2006) and related regulations
  • Support handling of employee relations issues and basic disciplinary processes
  • Maintain and administer records for labor inspections and audits
  • Support work permit and immigration documentation for expatriate staff (where applicable)
  • Support ensuring compliance with client HSSE, site, and onboarding requirements

5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Support liaison with client HR or site representatives on operational and staffing matters
  • Support coordinating staff replacements, leave coverage, and performance feedback
  • Support preparation of client operational reports

6. Administration & Office Management

  • Manage office administration, filing systems, and document control
  • Support coordinating vendors, service providers, and office supplies
  • Maintain confidentiality of employee and client information

7. Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Prepare weekly and monthly operational reports
  • Support tracking of KPIs related to staffing, compliance, and service delivery
  • Support development and implementation of SOPs

Key Relationships/ Stakeholders

External

  • Clients
  • Vendors
  • Partners
  • Immigration Authorities

Internal

  • Management team
  • Directors
  • Contractor
  • Employees
  • Other Aldelia offices

Person Specification

Preferred Experience and Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or related field
  • Min 2 years’ experience in operations and/or administration
  • Basic knowledge of Labour Laws is an advantage
  • Basic knowledge of Payroll and statutory deductions is an advantage

Language Requirements

  • Proficiency in English is required.

Skills

  • Able to handle outsourced workforce
  • Strong organizational and coordination skills
  • High attention to detail and confidentiality
  • Strong communication and client-handling skills
  • Proficiency in MS Office
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

Behaviours

  • Performance, Efficiency, Teamwork, Diligence, Congeniality, Analytical.

  • Develop Electrical procedures dedicated to National Grid connection with interfaces with UETCL

3. The safe keeping of an engine room watch.

4. Assist Chief Engineer in the preparation of machinery for survey.

5. Ensure that any information entered in the Engine Room (ER) log, maintenance records, water condition logs and other records, shall be accurate.

6. Notify the Chief Engineer of spare gear and consumable requirements as applicable.

7. Keep the Chief Engineer fully informed as to the progress of any work which he has undertaken, and of any defects or problems in their area of responsibility.

8. Comply with the Company’s Safety Management System and Class, Flag and International Maritime rules and regulations.

9. Assist to Chief Engineer in emergency response.

  • Start Date: ASAP
  • Location: Ajaccio, Corsica, France
  • Duration: 3–5 years (with possible extension)
  • Employment Status: Residential
  • Salary: Open/Negotiable for qualified candidates
  • In addition to the salary, the following will be provided:
  1. Accommodation in single rooms
  2. Monthly flight ticket to allow for long weekends
  3. Transportation from home
  4. Lunch during working days
  5. PC and SIM card

Key Responsibilities

  • Construction Supervision: Support the Mechanical Superintendent in supervising and monitoring EPC Contractor/Subcontractor activities to ensure equipment installation conforms to design documents, specifications, and procedures.
  • Quality and Standards Compliance: Guarantee the quality of works and their compliance with contractual and engineering requirements. Ensure all work adheres to international codes and standards such as ASME, API, ISO, etc..
  • HSE Implementation: Ensure the implementation of all Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) procedures and standards within the area of responsibility and actively participate in site safety initiatives.
  • Planning and Scheduling: Participate in the elaboration of work schedules, monitor daily progress, and propose corrective actions to recover any delays.
  • Technical Support and Troubleshooting: Provide technical support and guidance, diagnose mechanical failures, and support alignment, balancing, and overhauling activities of equipment like pumps, compressors, turbines, and gearboxes.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate maintenance records, update the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) like SAP or Maximo, prepare non-conformity reports, and manage documentation for handover to operations.
  • Commissioning and Handover: Participate in pre-commissioning, commissioning, and start-up activities, including factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT), ensuring a smooth handover process to the operations department.
  • Resource Management: Check that adequate equipment and manpower are employed by the subcontractor and manage vendor specialists when required.
  • Training and Mentorship: Provide on-the-job training and guidance to junior technicians and foster a culture of safety and continuous improvement. 

Typical Equipment Involved

The supervisor oversees a variety of rotating and sometimes static equipment, including: 

  • Pumps (centrifugal, booster, feed)
  • Compressors
  • Gas and Steam Turbines
  • Gearboxes and Fans
  • Vessels, columns, and heat exchangers (during installation/maintenance phases) 

Requirements

  • Technical diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering
  • Experience in oil and gas or powerplant sectors, with a minimum of 5 years in EPC project phase.
  • EU residency or Valid EU work permit is mandatory.
  • Ability to read P&IDs and simple technical drawings.
  • Familiarity with CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD) and basic use of Excel or similar tools.
  • Good communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in French (mandatory) and English languages

Vacancies:

  1. Inspector Electrical & Instrumentation
  2. Inspector Mechanical
  3. Inspector Piping
  4. Inspector Painting and Isolation

We are seeking dedicated professionals to join our growing team. If you possess a valid EU work permit and are eager to make a significant impact, this role is designed for you!

Details:

•    Start Date: ASAP

•    Location: Corsica, France

•    Duration: 3–5 years (with possible extension)

•    Employment Status: Residential with monthly flights to home

•    Salary: Open/Negotiable for qualified candidates

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in oil and gas or powerplant sectors, with a minimum of 5 years in EPC project phase.
  • EU residency or Valid EU work permit is mandatory.
  • Proven experience in inspection roles, specifically in Mechanics, Piping, Painting, and Isolation.
  • Strong understanding of inspection methodologies and relevant industry standards.
  • Proficiency in both French (mandatory) and English is preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review project specifications, Quality Control Procedures (QCPs), and Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).
  • Conduct and witness inspections at various stages (hold and witness points) to ensure compliance with drawings and industry codes (e.g., ASME, API, ASTM, NACE, ISO).
  • Prepare detailed inspection reports, surveillance reports, and non-conformance reports (NCRs), then track them to closure.
  • Verify material receiving inspection, ensuring traceability and correlation with mill test certificates (MTCs) and approved submittals.
  • Liaise and coordinate with client representatives, third-party inspectors, and construction teams.
  • Ensure all work activities comply with Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) procedures. 

Electrical & Instrumentation Inspector

  • Inspection and Testing: Conduct on-site inspections of E&I installations, including wiring, cabling, grounding, lighting systems, switchgear, control panels, and field instruments. Witness and verify tests such as insulation resistance, continuity tests, loop checks, and functional tests of instruments and control valves.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and review Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, and quality control procedures. Issue quality records, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and punch lists, and verify that corrective actions are implemented. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inspection reports.
  • Standards and Compliance: Ensure all work is carried out according to approved drawings, industry codes (e.g., ISO, IEC, API, ASME), and client-specific standards (e.g., Aramco standards for relevant projects). Ensure adherence to safety and regulatory requirements, particularly in hazardous areas.
  • Coordination and Liaison: Coordinate inspection activities with construction teams, client representatives, and third-party inspectors. Liaise with manufacturers and vendors during Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) of equipment.
  • Material and Equipment Management: Inspect incoming materials and equipment deliveries to ensure compliance with specifications and proper handling/storage. Verify that all test and measuring equipment used on-site is properly calibrated and has valid certificates. 

Mechanical Inspector

  • Inspect installations of mechanical systems and equipment such as pumps, tanks, heat exchangers, and HVAC systems.
  • Verify equipment installation, alignment, and cleanliness.
  • Monitor and witness mechanical testing and pre-commissioning activities.
  • Ensure all equipment is installed according to approved engineering documents and layouts.
  • Check that all tools and equipment used on-site are properly calibrated. 

Piping Inspector

  • Perform visual and dimensional inspections of piping fabrication and installation, including fit-up, alignment, and pipe support installations.
  • Monitor and record welding activities, ensuring compliance with the approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS) and Welder Performance Qualification (WPQ).
  • Coordinate and witness Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) such as Radiographic Testing (RT), Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Magnetic Particle (MP), and Penetrant Testing (PT).
  • Witness pressure testing (hydrostatic or pneumatic testing), line flushing, and leak tests.
  • Review and compile piping test packages and final mechanical completion dossiers. 

Painting and Insulation Inspector

  • Inspect surface preparation (blasting, cleaning) to ensure compliance with standards like SSPC, NACE, or ISO.
  • Verify environmental conditions (temperature, humidity, dew point) before and during coating application.
  • Conduct testing such as Wet Film Thickness (WFT) and Dry Film Thickness (DFT) checks, adhesion tests, and holiday detection (pinhole testing).
  • Inspect insulation and cladding installations, ensuring correct material application and compliance with specifications.
  • Maintain comprehensive records of coating and insulation performance and durability.
  • Liaise with paint/insulation manufacturers to ensure the correct material specifications are used and applied.

Intitulé du poste : Team Leader, Operations

Missions principales / Responsabilités clés :

  • Assurer la supervision quotidienne d’un groupe d’agents, incluant le suivi du travail et de l’assiduité, conformément aux politiques internes et aux exigences légales.
  • Encadrer les collaborateurs de manière régulière, au minimum chaque semaine, afin de garantir l’atteinte des objectifs de performance.
  • Identifier les écarts de performance, élaborer un plan d’amélioration, mettre en place les actions correctives, pouvant aller jusqu’à la rupture du contrat si nécessaire.
  • Veiller à ce que les services fournis aux clients respectent les KPIs contractuels et les objectifs financiers.
  • Communiquer clairement les attentes et fournir des mises à jour régulières.
  • Apporter une expertise technique pour gérer les appels clients escaladés lorsque requis.
  • Organiser des réunions d’équipe pour partager les informations importantes et recueillir les retours des collaborateurs ; planifier et coordonner les activités d’équipe.
  • Se tenir informé des processus internes, politiques et procédures. Participer aux formations de développement pour managers.
  • Promouvoir les valeurs du client à travers son comportement et son attitude, et agir en véritable soutien pour les membres de l’équipe.

Profil recherché :

  • Diplôme de niveau Bac+2 dans un domaine connexe, avec deux à quatre ans d’expérience pertinente.
  • Forte motivation et capacité à former, accompagner et faire progresser les membres de l’équipe.
  • À l’aise dans les environnements exigeants, avec une capacité à mener les tâches jusqu’à leur aboutissement.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, y compris auprès de différents niveaux hiérarchiques.
  • Capacité à gérer une équipe en contexte multitâche, à prioriser et à respecter les délais.
  • Maîtrise de Microsoft Office ;
  • Large disponibilité horaire.

 Description du niveau de carrière :

Reçoit des missions sous forme d’objectifs opérationnels et supervise les collaborateurs pour définir les priorités et mener les tâches à bien. Coordonne et supervise les activités quotidiennes d’équipes de support commercial, technique ou de production. Responsable d’une ligne de service simple ou de taille moyenne. Les décisions sont guidées par les politiques, les procédures et le plan d’activité ; bénéficie de l’appui et de l’encadrement de son supérieur.

Fait progresser son équipe vers l’atteinte des objectifs et des indicateurs grâce au coaching, au mentorat et au feedback régulier. Consacre généralement moins de 20 % de son temps aux tâches qu’il supervise. Gère les escalades. Supervise du personnel non-cadre réalisant des tâches uniques ou des tâches multiples mais étroitement liées.

Duration: To be confirmed

Starting date: ASAP

Vacancy status: Open to Locals and Expats

 

Mission

Supervise, plan, and control preventive and corrective mechanical maintenance activities on rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, gearboxes) to ensure their availability, reliability, and safety, while guaranteeing compliance with HSE standards and company procedures.

Main Responsibilities

Supervision and Organization

  • Lead and coordinate teams of technicians and team leaders in charge of expertise, dismantling, reassembly, and testing of rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, gearboxes, etc.).
  • Plan, organize, and control preventive and corrective maintenance operations together with the Workshop Manager.
  • Allocate human and material resources according to priorities, in coordination with the Workshop Manager.
  • Ensure effective communication between teams and the Workshop Manager.

Technical Follow-up

  • Guarantee the technical compliance of interventions on pumps, compressors, and gearboxes in accordance with API 610 / 682 standards and client requirements.
  • Inspect the quality of mechanical works (alignment, balancing, diagnostics) carried out by Team Leaders and Technicians.
  • Identify and analyze recurring failures; propose corrective action plans.
  • Monitor the condition of spare parts and consumable stocks, anticipating critical needs.
  • Receive and inspect spare parts provided by clients and/or the Procurement Department.
  • Use and update the CMMS/SAP system to plan and track maintenance activities.

Management & Reporting

  • Prepare and validate detailed technical reports after interventions, including equipment data, metrology/balancing reports, final test results, photos, observations, and recommendations.
  • Report to the Workshop Manager on maintenance performance and key findings.
  • Ensure full documentation traceability (reports, reception forms, entry/exit notes).
  • Supervise and contribute to the skills development of Team Leaders and Technicians (training, mentoring).

HSE & Quality

  • Ensure compliance with HSE procedures and work permits.
  • Guarantee the correct use of PPE/EPC by all personnel.
  • Identify risks related to mechanical operations and propose corrective measures.
  • Promote a culture of safety and quality within the teams.
  • Encourage continuous improvement within the workshop (methods, best practices, etc.).

Profile Required

Education

  • Technical diploma or degree in Mechanics (Bac+2 to Bac+3 level or equivalent).

Experience

Poste : Chauffeur Sénior Poids Lourds - BTP

Lieu de travail : Dakar (déplacements fréquents dans tout le territoire)

Rattachement hiérarchique : Responsable Logistique

1. MISSIONS PRINCIPALES

Sous l'autorité directe du Responsable Logistique, le chauffeur a pour mission principale d'assurer le transport sécurisé, efficient et dans les délais du matériel, des équipements et parfois des équipes, en support direct des activités des chantiers de BTP. Il est le garant de l'état et de la disponibilité opérationnelle de son véhicule.

2. RESPONSABILITÉS ET ACTIVITÉS CLÉS

A. Transport et Livraison :

  • Conduire en toute sécurité des poids lourds (camions bennes, porteurs, semi-remorques) pour le transport de matériaux (granulats, sable, ciment, enrobés), d'engins (mini-pelles, chargeuses) et/ou d'équipements.
  • Assurer le chargement et le déchargement des marchandises en coordonnant avec les équipes de chantier et en veillant au respect des consignes de sécurité et à la bonne répartition des masses.
  • Respecter scrupuleusement les itinéraires et les plannings de livraison établis par le Responsable Logistique.
  • Effectuer et rapporter les formalités administratives liées aux livraisons (bons de livraison, fiches de pesée) au Responsable Logistique.

B. Sécurité, Conduite Préventive et Conformité :

  • Adopter une conduite préventive et respectueuse du code de la route sénégalais et des autres usagers.
  • Effectuer les vérifications techniques quotidiennes (pré-route et post-route) du véhicule et signaler immédiatement toute anomalie au Responsable Logistique.
  • S'assurer du bon arrimage et de la sécurisation de la cargaison conformément aux procédures.
  • Appliquer et respecter toutes les consignes de sécurité de l'entreprise et des chantiers.

C. Entretien, Gestion du Véhicule et Reporting :

  • Assurer la propreté et l'état général du véhicule.
  • Effectuer l'entretien courant de premier niveau (vérification des niveaux, pression des pneus, etc.).
  • Tenir à jour avec rigueur le carnet de bord du véhicule (kilométrage, consommation, entretiens, incidents).
  • Rendre compte quotidiennement de son activité et de l'état du véhicule au Responsable Logistique.

3. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Formation et Expérience :

  • Certificat d'Aptitude Professionnelle (CAP) Conducteur Routier Marchandises ou une formation équivalente est un plus.
  • Permis de conduire en cours de validité : Permis EC (Poids Lourds + Remorque) ou équivalent sénégalais.
  • Minimum 5 ans d'expérience avérée en tant que chauffeur poids lourds, impérativement dans le secteur du BTP.
  • Une expérience préalable au Sénégal ou en Afrique de l'Ouest est un atout majeur.

Compétences Techniques :

  • Maîtrise parfaite de la conduite de poids lourds et des techniques d'arrimage.
  • Connaissances mécaniques de base pour détecter les pannes courantes.
  • Maîtrise des procédures de chargement/déchargement.
  • Connaissance des règles de transport et de circulation au Sénégal.

Compétences Comportementales :

  • Sérieux, ponctualité et fiabilité irréprochables.
  • Sens aigu des responsabilités et de la sécurité.
  • Autonomie dans l'exécution des missions et rigueur dans le reporting.
  • Bonne résistance au stress et à la fatigue.
  • Excellente capacité d'adaptation aux conditions de route et de chantier.
  • Bon relationnel pour une intégration efficace au sein de l'équipe logistique et avec les chantiers.

Langues :

  • Français : Maîtrise courante impérative (lu, écrit, parlé).
  • Anglais : Notions opérationnelles requises (compréhension des documents basiques, communication simple). Un atout pour les chantiers ou partenaires internationaux.

Conditions de travail :

Travail sur chantiers BTP

Horaires variables selon les besoins du chantier.

Fiche de poste : Secrétaire BTP

Intitulé du poste : Secrétaire BTP / Secrétaire technique

Département :

Administration / Direction technique / Chantier

Supérieur hiérarchique :

Chef de projet, Directeur technique ou Conducteur de travaux

Mission principale :

Assurer le suivi administratif, technique et logistique des chantiers.

La secrétaire BTP assiste l’équipe travaux dans la gestion des dossiers techniques, des documents contractuels, et dans la coordination entre les différents intervenants (fournisseurs, clients, sous-traitants, équipes internes).

Responsabilités principales :

  • Assurer le secrétariat courant : gestion du courrier, accueil téléphonique, rédaction de courriers, classement et archivage.
  • Préparer et suivre les dossiers administratifs de chantiers (marchés, contrats, devis, bons de commande, livraisons, factures, attestations, etc.).
  • Gérer le suivi des contrats et des sous-traitants (collecte de documents administratifs, attestations sociales et fiscales).
  • Participer à la préparation des appels d’offres (montage des dossiers, relecture, mise en forme).
  • Assurer la mise à jour des plannings de chantiers et le suivi des livraisons.
  • Tenir à jour les tableaux de bord (avancement, dépenses, suivi du personnel de chantier).
  • Appuyer le service comptabilité dans le suivi des factures fournisseurs et clients.
  • Organiser les déplacements, réunions et comptes rendus.
  • Veiller à la conformité documentaire selon les exigences du chantier et du client.

Compétences requises :

  • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
  • Bonne connaissance des documents techniques du BTP.
  • Capacité d’organisation et de gestion des priorités.
  • Sens de la rigueur et de la confidentialité.
  • Bonne communication écrite et orale.
  • Esprit d’équipe et réactivité.

Profil recherché :

  • Formation : Bac à Bac+2 en secrétariat, gestion administrative, ou équivalent.
  • Expérience : 2 à 5 ans minimum dans le secteur du BTP ou environnement technique.
  • Langues : Français (bon niveau écrit et oral), anglais apprécié.

Conditions de travail :

  • Horaires de bureau, avec possibilité d’horaires variables selon les urgences.
  • Collaboration avec les services techniques, comptabilité, achats et RH.

7. Periodically visits the work sites within his area ensuring PTW compliance.

9. Stop work immediately if any changes or unsafe conditions arise, ensuring risks are assessed before resuming tasks.

10. Ensure that the performed Isolation Certificate are attached on the permits are correct and safe to allow performing authority to perform the task.

11. Verify the worksite is clean and safe, signing off the relevant sections of the PTW.

Job Overview (Internal Recruitment)

The Operations Manager would be responsible to lead, monitor and implement the operational activities for Aldelia in the location specified. The person shall be a self-starter with the ability to work autonomously.

She/he shall manage, analyse, and improve organizational processes, and work to improve quality, productivity, and efficiency. The person shall oversee the running of the office and overall support to the business. 

Key Responsibilities

  1. Assist in creating, growing, and supporting the business entity.
  2. Oversee daily operations of the entity and the work of relative departments.
  3. Drive company results from both an operational and financial perspective working closely with the country head.
  4. Partner with the finance team to achieve favourable financial results with respect to sales, profitability, cash flow, systems, reporting and controls.
  5. Manage relationships with local unions
  6. Provide accurate and timely reports outlining the operational condition of the entity.
  7. Ensure the office is running at full operational capacity.
  8. Forge strategic partnerships and relationships with clients, vendors, and all other professional business relationships.
  9. Manage relationship with major stakeholders (clients, partners, Group) in term of daily operations, including reporting, accommodations, travel, medical visit, insurance, ID06…
  10. Manage all operations related to rotation system
  11. Implements and ensures the application of all procedures related to the safety of our employees on site (onboarding, QHSE induction…)
  12. Manage the planning, administering, implementation and controlling of weekly budgets for office operations purposes.
  13. Improving operational management systems, processes and best practices whilst implementing the right practices in Aldelia in the specific location to improve performance. 
  14. Interpret, analyse, and implement data to make informed decision to enhance efficiency.
  15. Providing general support to line management to enhance efficiency as directed.

Key Relationships/ Stakeholders     

External

  • Clients
  • Vendors/providers
  • Partners
  • Unions

Internal

  • Line Management
  • Contractors
  • Employees
  • Other Departments 

Person Specification

Preferred Experience and Education 

  • Bachelor’s degree qualified ideally in Social Sciences, Business Administration, Humanities, and Logistics etc. 
  • Experience in project management is an added advantage.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in team management and project management is required for this role.
  • Knowledge of organizational effectiveness and operations management 
  • Experience budgeting and forecasting.
  • Familiarity with business and financial principles is essential.

Location: Kampala Office, Uganda

Start Date (Estimated): Q1 2026

Duration: 12months (with possibility of renewal/extension)

Status: RESIDENT (requires relocation to Kampala)

Benefits: Family status, or Single status on 8weeks/2weeks rotation

Required certification: Cause-Tree Analysis (Guarantor)

Qualifications:

  • Willing to work on resident (Family or Single) or 8 weeks/2 weeks rotation (Single status)
  • 3 years University (BSc minimum).
  • HSE Background preferred, but candidates with proven track record on Drilling and wells operations will be considered.
  • Required certifications: Cause-Tree Analysis (Guarantor)
  • Certification preferred: Risks & Human factor; Respect for the environment in operations, Oil Spill Clearance.
  • Profile: 8 - 10 years’ experience in O&G operations.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in Drilling and Wells operations with significant experience in a HSE supervisory level, and previous experience in a similar position.
  • English language: Upper Intermediate to Proficient level

Job scope:

Methods

  • Define and execute the Drilling & Wells (D&W) HSE plan for the project, consistently with company's HSE management system and D&W and HSE referential.
  • Manage the diffusion, implementation, and update of Bridging Documents, SIMOPS dossiers, Blow out Contingency plan and Technological Risk Assessment.
  • Lead Operational Risk Assessments for complex operations (SIMOPS, Downgraded Situations, well testing…)
  • Assist RSESs in identification, assessment, reporting and follow-up of Downgraded Situations (DGS)
  • Prepare and lead HSE Steering Committees in town
  • Preparation & participation to partners, contractors, and local authorities HSE forums.

Management

  • Manage 6 rotational positions as direct reports, including one junior position in the office. Ensure objectives are clearly defined, means are available to reach them, and deadlines are met.
  • Ensure coordination with OSE Coach for application & diffusion of HSE policy, Referential, procedures, initiatives & programs.
  • Maintain daily contact with OSE Coach to provide support, guidance and mentoring on the HSE subjects.

Operations and reporting

  • Lead audits of rigs & all 3rd party contractors working for the project. Ensuring implementation of contractor safety management systems, compliance with contracts, company rules, international best practices / standards, and compliance with ISO 14001.
  • Ensure supervision in timely reporting of Events into the SYNERGI data base; follow up actions progress.
  • Lead the HSE Committees on rig sites & control the quality of the Rig site induction.
  • Implement, in partnership with Drilling Contractors, company E&P Safety Initiatives on the rig sites.
  • Ensure assistance to OSE Coach for Incident or Accident Cause Tree Analysis and High Potential events investigation. Lead Cause Tree Analyses as required.
  • Control the HSE performance and the related KPI Objectives benchmarking; Control the reliability of HSE Report.

Role Overview (Internal Recruitment)

The Regional Business Development Manager (AWA) would oversee all business growth functions within the Anglophone West Africa region(s) and will be responsible for: Nigeria, Ghana, Sierra Leone, Liberia and any other assigned country. He/ She will identify business opportunities, targeting business leads, building a pipeline of customers, and maintaining successful relationships with prospects and existing clients whilst collaborating with Leadership to develop and execute strategic growth objectives across the Regions.

Primary Responsibilities:

Networking:

  • Identify potential clients in the target markets, complete appropriate research on the prospective client’s need and devise means of building a business relationship that leads to business opportunity for the company.
  • Have an existing strong network within the business ecosystem within the Region(s) responsible for.
  • Strong willingness to network and make networking a lifestyle.
  • Develop business across the Region(s) within set goals.

Management:

  • Responsible to manage at a high level the activities of country BD teams under the Regions(s).
  • Own, hit and exceed on the annual sales targets set in the assigned Region(s) and respective countries.
  • Find solutions and deliver results within a rapidly changing, entrepreneurial and performance-driven culture.
  • Develop and execute strategic plan to achieve sales targets and expand the clients’ portfolio.
  • Become a subject matter expert on Aldelia’s business services and remain up to date on industry news.
  • Effectively communicate Aldelia’s value proposition and processes through proposals and presentations to potential clients.
  • Take charge of clients interaction and interface on sales activities across the Region(s).
  • Understand the competitive landscape and market trends to support Leadership in making strategic informed decisions.
  • Understand and report on trends that shift strategic direction of sales forecast and provide initiatives on how to secure the forecasted revenue.
  • Manage and control the respective regional BD teams and propose relevant trainings where applicable:

o Identify existing or recruit the BD teams in regions assigned.

o Put in place the sales strategy and the relevant KPI’s for the respective teams.

o Train, motivate and manage BD teams in region(s) assigned.

  • Create strong relationships with key client stakeholders at both senior and mid-management levels.
  • Work with the Sales, Recruitment and Operations teams on cross-territory opportunities and implement targeted sales strategy.
  • Work with internal teams on behalf of clients to ensure the highest level of customer service.
  • Analyse pipelines and leads, deliver weekly reporting to the line management showing key business insights.

Key Relationships/Stakeholders

External

  • Clients
  • Networking events

Internal

  • Regional Director
  • Countries BD Team
  • Leadership
  • Sales & Recruiters
  • Operations & Finance Teams
  • Aldelia global offices

Person Specification

Preferred Experience and Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration or another relevant field.
  • 12+ Qualitative experience in Sales, Business Development, or any similar field.
  • Demonstrated achievement in B2B sales.
  • Proficiency in pricing, quotation, and proposal drafting.
  • Innovation and problem-solving skills that include the ability to identify, allocate and monitor resources effectively and efficiently.

Language Requirements

• Full Proficiency in English is required. Proficiency in French or Portuguese is an added advantage.

Skills

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with management and cross-functional teams.
  • Advanced MS office skills.
  • Strong organizational, negotiation, and networking skills.
  • Decisive, committed, and analytical thinker.
  • Demonstrate a high level of customer service skills.
  • Ability to communicate, present, and influence all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
  • Demonstrate teamwork skills and pay high attention to details.
  • Proven sales executive experience, meeting, or exceeding targets.
  • Must live in Africa and willingly travel at least once a month.

Behaviours:

• Performance, Efficiency, Teamwork, Diligence, Congeniality, Analytical.

Job Overview (Internal Recruitment)

The Legal Officer will provide legal and compliance support to the firm’s outsourcing and recruitment operations.

The role will focus on drafting, reviewing, and managing contracts; ensuring compliance with relevant labor, employment, and corporate laws; and supporting the Legal Specialist in safeguarding the firm’s legal and regulatory interests.

Responsibilities:

  • Draft, review, and vet standard contracts and agreements (employment, consultancy, vendor, and client service contracts).
  • Support the Legal Specialist in managing compliance with local laws, regulations, and statutory requirements relating to outsourcing and recruitment.
  • Maintain and update a database of all active contracts, agreements, and legal documents.
  • Conduct legal research on labor, employment, and corporate regulations and provide summaries/reports for the Legal Specialist’s review.
  • Assist in preparing correspondence for government agencies, clients, vendors, and employees (e.g., compliance letters, contract notices, and regulatory filings).
  • Monitor changes in labor and employment laws, highlighting implications for the business and supporting policy updates.
  • Support dispute resolution and litigation management by liaising with external counsel when required.
  • Ensure accurate documentation and filing of legal instruments and provide timely retrieval of records.
  • Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to the Legal Specialist.

Key Relationships/ Stakeholders

External

  • Clients
  • Suppliers

Internal

  • Employees
  • Management
  • Head of functions
  • Global Aldelia offices

Person Specification

Preferred Experience and Education

  • Bachelor/ Master degree in Law; must have been called to the Nigerian Bar.
  • 1–3 years’ post-call experience in corporate/commercial law, preferably with exposure to outsourcing, HR services, or recruitment firms.
  • Legal and contract management skills are essential.

Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Nigerian labor laws, corporate governance, and compliance frameworks.
  • Excellent legal drafting, research, and analytical skills.
  • High attention to detail with strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to work under supervision and take initiative when required.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to identify and analyze complex legal issues situation and recommend and implement solutions.
  • Strong attention to details along with the ability to discover potential risks the company might be exposed to.
  • Demonstrate excellent level of interpersonal, verbal and writing skills to effectively communicate.
  • Can consistently meet competing demands through effective prioritising in a result orientated environment.
  • Ability to effectively work under pressure in a client-focused demanding environment.

Behaviours

  • Performance, Efficiency, Teamwork, Diligence, Congeniality, Analytical.

Position Title RETAIL TRAINING ASSISTANT

Incumbent (Name)

Reports to (Name and job title)

Retail Operations Manager

Date

1. JOB PURPOSE:

1. Ensure Retailer Induction training and OPC/other standardised training is offered within the country in a consistent and

standard format.

2. Ensure new Retailers are well trained and inducted before they start operating a Shell site and effectively deliver Shell’s

Customer Commitment

3. Liaise with Sales & Operations team to identify Retailer and site staff competency gaps and agree on learning priorities

for the OU.

DIMENSIONS:

a) Annual training budget: To be confirmed.

b) Staff: nil direct reports.

c) Other:

ORGANISATION:

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Summarise in 5-7 statements the principal results expected from the job. Should cascade into the purposes of any subordinates’ roles

1. In liaison with Sales Operations and Marketing, drawing up and implementing an annual Retailer and site staff training

program

2. Effectively manage and deliver training activities to meet local needs and in alignment with the Global Retail Academy

guidelines and requirements.

3. Ensure that learning & development interventions for Shell Retail staff, Retailers and Site Staff as appropriate are

delivered according to plan and within budget.

4. Actively take part in and administer training tasks and manage logistics for learning events. 5. Develop a network of quality assured retail trainers on various subjects (both internal and external as appropriate) 6. Monitor SUL Retail training budget and submit a T&R report to the Operations Support Mgr and the Retail Manager on a periodic basis. 7. Monitor and report training KPIs to the Operations Support manager and the Retail Manager on a quarterly basis. 8. As and when requested, and in agreement with Sales & Operations Manager, contribute to the development of Global Retail Academy Training 9. Participate as an active member of the regional retail training community. 10. Ensure all Training records and materials are up to date.

KEY CHALLENGES:

1. This is a new position in the organisation and the incumbent will have to be a self-starter and highly motivated in order.

to develop this role to its full potential.

2. Change management and successfully supporting the OPC implementation.

3. Managing interfaces with ABM’s and Marketing effectively

4. Interfacing with HR Training to ensure synergy and avoid duplication.

JOB KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

1. Demonstration of the aspired Enterprise First behaviours (Leadership, Accountability, Teamwork) and Shell core values

(Honesty, Integrity, Respect for People)

2. Strong leadership of Training resources.

3. Strong team member with excellent communication and planning skills.

4. Understanding of Retail business with significant previous Retail experience and Competence, particularly in Sales &

Operations

5. Demonstrable competence in implementing standard processes, achieving training targets, building relationships with

Shell Retailers, and delivering the service element of Retail Customer Commitment.

COMPETENCIES REQUIRED

Sales & Operations Competencies – Site Level:

Manage Site/Cluster Operating Standards & Processes – Knowledge

Manage Platforms and Agreements – Knowledge

Recruit, Select and Develop Retail People – Skill

Manage Customer Service Processes – Skill

Manage Relationships with Retailers – Skill

Manage Site/Cluster Performance & Administration – Knowledge

Manage Fuel Pricing Process – Knowledge

Manage Fuel Pricing Execution – Knowledge

Manage Retailer Value Proposition (RVP) - Skill

Retail Fundamentals:

Understand and Apply Retail HSSE Standards - Skill

Understand and Apply Retail Economics - Skill

Understand and Apply Shell Retailing Principles & Processes – Knowledge

Overview (Internal Recruitment)

The position holder is responsible for supporting the Tendering Supervisor & Manager with the internal coordination of RFQs and tender responses. The person will assess tender requirements and create adequate, well-researched responses for review and approval. This position will also manage the tender repository and other databases to ensure that all information used for tender purposes is current and accurate.

The Tendering Specialist will work closely with internal stakeholders to support all business initiatives across various entities.

The individual will reinforce the team by interfacing, coordinating, executing, reporting and monitoring tenders and diverse business operations activities of Aldelia at the group level, including but not limited to vendor registration, business cases.

Responsibilities:

Tenders, BIDS, RFQ

  1. Identify, clarify, and compile technical/commercial qualifications, clarifications, and deviations across service lines to align with customer requirements.
  2. Prepare and submit competitive technical and commercial responses to tenders.
  3. Conduct research and brainstorm key points to include in the tender submissions.
  4. Ensure all tender deadlines are met by liaising with internal stakeholders and contributing departments.
  5. Conduct team briefings once tenders have been received and reviewed to facilitate Go / No-Go decisions.
  6. Review RFQ/RFP received from existing or prospective clients, manage & assign tasks according to priorities using the Tasks Dispatch Template
  7. Lead tender kick-off meetings with BD, Recruiters, and Operations Teams to set bid strategy and preparation guidelines when assigned.
  8. Support the overall performance of the tender process team to obtain maximum efficiency, quality, service and profitability for the organization.
  9. Oversees the collation of tender documents and ensures multiple tasks are prioritized effectively.
  10. Attend Pre-bid and clarification meetings.
  11. Responsible for collecting information and documents, e.g., Signed Contracts, POs, Reference Letters, Award Letters, to grow and maintain the tendering database.
  12. Effective liaison and support for a smooth tender process among all stakeholders in the organization.
  13. Support in the completion and responding to client request for vendor registrations, RFP’s, Bids and Tenders.

Business Support

  1. Responsible for drafting proposals to support the business teams where necessary.
  2. In charge of designing and redesigning business proposals and commercial templates, with the support of a design agency as applicable.
  3. Responsible for reworking the process methodologies slides, periodically collecting information for business cases and client references.
  4. From time to time, you will be expected to participate in special projects, such as writing meeting minutes and collecting information for the administrative file.
  5. Responsible for vendor and supplier registration with clients.

Key Relationships/ Stakeholders

External

  • Clients
  • Vendors
  • Sub-Contractors

Internal

  • Line Management
  • Employees
  • Aldelia offices
  • All stakeholders

Person Specification

Preferred Experience and Education

  • A Degree in Engineering, Business Management, Operations and Administration, or other relevant field is required.
  • A minimum of 4 years of continuous prior tendering experience is required for this role. Cumulative years of experience may vary; however, additional years in the same role will be an advantage.
  • Previous tendering experience in the staffing & recruitment industry is desirable.
  • An appreciable level of proposal drafting, and management techniques is required.
  • Prior experience in an Audit firm, Legal firm, financial institutions and or consultancy firm, preferably any of the big four or equivalent, is highly desirable.

Language Requirement

  • Proficiency in English – Required & Mandatory
  • Proficiency in French – Highly desirable & advantageous, not Mandatory.

Skills

  • Demonstrate a high level of interpersonal and writing skills to communicate effectively.
  • Demonstrate a high level of confidentiality and professionalism.
  • Must have planning, organising, reporting and budgeting skills.
  • Demonstrate a high level of proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite
  • Can identify, allocate and monitor resources effectively and efficiently.
  • Must be familiar with Project Management conduct and procedures.
  • Can consistently meet competing demands through effective prioritizing in a result-oriented and client-focused environment.

Behaviours

  • Performance, Efficiency, Teamwork, Diligence, Congeniality, Analytical.

Job Title: Office Manager

Main Roles:

Contribute to the smooth running of the agency by carrying out all or part of the administrative, financial, budgetary and/or logistical management, and in particular: 

-\tIn liaison with and under the authority of Administration and finance in Nairobi, act as the Kampala agency's focal point on various issues (accounting, budget, real estate and HR administrative aspects).

-\tHandle budget construction, monitoring and evaluation

-\tAdministrative management of HR issues

-\tBe the Local IT correspondent for the office

Tasks

Finance :

Bank accounts management :

  • Prepare payments to suppliers, local authorities etc by bank transfer, cheques, direct debit etc… 
  • Track and process replenishments
  • Send monthly bank statements to the regional accounting platform
  • Follow up on the change of account signatories whenever management changes.
  • Prepare VAT reimbursement claims and follow up with URA
  • Make payments and ensure invoices received are proper, with all the relevant elements
  • Maintain an excel dashboard for tracking expenses, indicating the description, amount paid, the date…And ensure the printed version for the concerned period is signed by the authorized person. 
  • Prepare accounting pieces to be shared with the regional accounting platform
  • Monitor paper and archiving and the shared folder in accordance with the defined nomenclature

Budget :

  • Preparation of initial budget and the HR budget file on BUDGEO
  • Preparation of risks and opportunities report
  • Preparation of end of year forecasts and adjustments
  • Preparing the turn over for the end of year

Job Title: RETAIL ACADEMY ADMINISTRATOR 

Reports to: RETAIL TRAINER 

1.  Job Purpose:

  • The Training Academy Administrator is responsible for overseeing the scheduling, coordination, and administrative functions of the Training Academy. This role ensures the smooth operation of training programs and supports the professional development of all participants.

Principal Accountabilities 

OPERATION EXCELLENCE

· Training Coordination

  • Schedule and coordinate training sessions, including arranging equipment, and preparing materials.
  • Communicate training schedules to facilitators, participants, and relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure that all training logistics are in place and sessions run smoothly.

· Administrative Tasks

  • Handle all administrative duties related to the training academy, including record-keeping, correspondence, and filing.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date training records, attendance logs, and participant feedback.
  • Prepare and distribute training certificates and other relevant documentation.

· Operational Management

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of the training center, ensuring a conducive & clean  learning environment.
  • Liaise with trainers, participants, to support training activities.
  • Address any issues or concerns that arise during training sessions promptly and effectively.

· Communication and Reporting

  • Regularly update management on training activities, progress, and outcomes.
  • Prepare reports and presentations as required to highlight training achievements and areas for development.
  • Maintain open and effective communication channels with all stakeholders involved in the training process.  

Job Knowledge, Skills & Experience

· Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Human Resources, Education, or a related field.

· Experience: Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in an administrative or coordination role, preferably within a training or educational setting.

· Skills:

  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and other relevant software.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in administrative tasks.
  • Problem-solving skills and the ability to handle unexpected situations.
